Title: Program Manager, Data Center Construction
Description:
Candidates must be able to work 100% onsite.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program or project management.
* 6 years of experience with data center equipment/environments, including electrical switchgear, generators, chillers, cooling towers, air handling units, controls, security monitoring systems and fire safety systems, and experience with start up/commissioning processes.
* 3 years of experience in a leadership role.
* Experience managing vendor relationships and standard practices in the design and construction industry, including track design build processes and associated documents and agreement.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical or Industrial Engineering, Construction Management or related technical field.
* 8 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* 8 years of work experience with data center equipment/environments, including electrical switchgear, generators, chillers, cooling towers, air handling units, controls, security monitoring systems and fire safety systems, with an understanding of start up/commissioning processes.
* Knowledge of large-scale facility electrical and mechanical systems.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a highly motivated Program Manager, you have demonstrated experience with data center design, development, construction and commissioning projects. You will provide management of large-scale data centers, computer farms, networking, AC and DC power distribution/conversion, and cooling methods at multiple scales. You will be tasked with juggling and coordinating the desires and needs of multiple partner teams, while managing changes and maintaining a focus on keeping the project on schedule and budget.

You will have experience managing large scale technical projects in a rapidly changing industry, ability to thrive in ambiguity and demonstrated problem-solving leadership with limited oversight. You should be able to conceptualize and describe the delivery of a data center facility from start to commissioning and understand the nuances and risks that you and your team will need to manage.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $188000 - $274000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage data center projects from inception through to completion.
* Support special research and development experiments, renovations, and upgrades of existing facility.
* Be responsible for gathering internal requirements and delivering solutions that satisfy customer needs.
* Maintain end-to-end responsibility from construction to deployment.
* Resolve highly critical issues within matrix organization while maintaining rigorous adherence to project timelines and costs.

Title: Director, Delivery CX AI
Description:
**Director, CX AI Delivery**
**Who We Are**
Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture
  
  
With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.
  
  
From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.
  
  
**Location & Flexibility**
This role will operate remotely in the
**United States**
or
**Canada**
OR be based out of one of our major North American office locations - Charlottesville, VA, Durham, NC, Columbus, OH, Boston, MA, Toronto, ON, or Vancouver, BC.
  
  
This role may involve travel of up to 25% to contact center and client locations.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a
**Director, CX AI Delivery**
: a consultant and delivery expert who can turn complex contact center and AI programs into predictable, measurable outcomes. You will lead delivery across our CX AI portfolio, spanning Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platforms, conversational and agentic AI, agent assist, and CX intelligence, and serve as a trusted advisor to client executives. You will manage a portfolio of client engagements (generally ~$15–20M in revenue), directly lead delivery, product, and engineering leaders, and step in to stabilize and recover programs when needed.
  
  
This is a delivery-first leadership role with an AI lens. You will bring the rigor of a seasoned delivery executive together with a working command of how AI is changing CX: from AI-driven routing and virtual agents to copilots, knowledge, and agentic automation. You will help clients adopt these capabilities responsibly, at scale, and in iterative releases that get value into production quickly. You will also help evaluate vendor and partner solutions and decide how and when new tools enter the ecosystem.
  
  
This position reports to the Managing Director, CX AI Delivery and typically manages 8–12 direct reports, including senior managers, managers, and principal-level delivery and technical leaders. It is primarily evaluated on delivery success, client and team feedback, forecast accuracy, portfolio profitability, and growth of key accounts. This is an opportunistically billable position.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Strategic Account Governance & Growth**

* Be the executive partner. Act as the primary escalation point and strategic advisor for client executives, ensuring TELUS Digital is viewed as a “Doctor” (consultative partner), not a “Waiter” (order taker).
* Run portfolio health. Drive the commercial success of a ~$15–20M portfolio, leading Quarterly Business Reviews that connect delivery progress to the client’s long-term CX and business goals.
* Grow organically. Identify expansion opportunities in existing accounts by understanding client pain points and bringing a relevant point of view on CX and AI. Support renewals, upsell, and expansion in partnership with strategic sales and customer success teams.
* Extend into managed services and advisory as the practice matures: shape Day 2 support models, operational readiness, and advisory engagements that keep clients engaged after go-live.

**Delivery Excellence & Risk Mitigation**

* Lead a global, multidisciplinary team across multiple concurrent workstreams, ensuring product, engineering, and delivery leaders operate as a cohesive unit to deliver measurable outcomes.
* Manage risk proactively. Identify “red” and “yellow” programs early; step into recovery situations to provide clarity, reset expectations, and stabilize teams and client relationships.
* Push for iterative delivery. Favor smaller releases and faster cycles over big-bang launches, especially for AI capabilities where learning in production is essential.
* Optimize delivery models, balancing onshore/offshore teams, automation, and repeatable assets to improve margins and scalability.
* Manage vendor and partner ecosystems. Work with CCaaS and AI platform partners (e.g., Genesys, Google, AWS, Zendesk, Five9, ElevenLabs, Cresta, Parloa) to deliver joint solutions as well as surrounding services in the client ecosystem.
* Partner on pre-sales. Support the commercial team to shape innovative solutions and lead scoping, estimation, and handoffs into delivery so engagements start with clear requirements and goals.

**Leadership & Talent Development**

* Coach and mentor delivery, product, and engineering leaders on leading their own teams and navigating complex client dynamics.
* Build a high-performance culture with regular 1:1s and performance reviews grounded in radical candor and growth, delivering feedback upward, across, and down with grace and clarity.
* Raise the bar on talent. Participate in senior-level hiring, contribute to the Delivery Playbook, and build career paths and skill development (including AI and platform certification pipelines).

**Operational & Financial Stewardship**

* Own portfolio financials: gross margin, utilization, and effective billable rates.
* Forecast accurately. Maintain precise revenue and resource forecasts so the business can plan hiring and growth with confidence.
* Influence with data. Use reporting language, data visualization, and storytelling to influence internal and external decisions and inspire confidence in stakeholders.
* Collaborate across the business with peers and practice leaders to improve internal processes and operational efficiency, and bring energy to moments that matter: new relationships, key presentations, and recovery situations.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years in the technology industry, including 4+ years in a senior leadership role in a professional services, consulting, or agency environment.
* Proven record managing a diverse portfolio of client accounts (ideally $10M+ in annual revenue) with a focus on retention and organic growth.
* Experience delivering large-scale CX or contact center transformations that influenced VP- and C-level decision making.
* Working knowledge of how AI is applied in CX: conversational and voice AI, agent assist and copilots, AI-driven routing, knowledge and content for AI, and CX intelligence; ability to discuss architecture, risk, and ROI credibly with both technical and executive audiences.
* Hands-on delivery experience with one or more leading CCaaS or CX AI platforms (e.g., Genesys, Amazon Connect, Zendesk, Google); platform certifications and experience across multiple verticals are a plus.
* Deep understanding of the SDLC and Agile delivery, with a track record of leading complex, custom-built software solutions from discovery to launch, and comfort with iterative, experiment-driven delivery.
* Experience managing and coaching leaders across Product, Engineering, and Delivery, and leading large, globally distributed teams.
* Strong command of professional services metrics, including gross margin, utilization, forecast accuracy, and effective billable rates.
* Exceptional ability to navigate “recovery situations” and high-stakes client conversations with poise, clarity, and a solution-oriented mindset.
* Ability to translate complex delivery data into compelling narratives for QBRs and executive stakeholders.
* Understanding of regulatory requirements in contact center operations (e.g., PCI, HIPAA, TCPA, PIPEDA) is a plus.

**Location:** Based in Dubai

**Account coverage:** Entire Etisalat Group globally, with particular emphasis on the Middle East, Africa and Europe.

The role brings together two complementary growth strategies: sell-to, expanding Fortinet’s contribution to the Group’s own cybersecurity and infrastructure priorities; and sell-with, building joint propositions and go-to-market programmes that bring Fortinet-powered services to its customers.

The successful candidate will own the overarching global account strategy, build executive sponsorship and lead coordinated execution across Fortinet teams, Group functions, business units and operating companies. The role requires the ability to translate a complex multinational relationship into a focused business plan, strategic commercial agreements and measurable growth.

The Global Account Manager provides strategic leadership across local quota-carrying account owners, aligning priorities and enabling execution without replacing their direct sales accountability. Local account owners retain responsibility for their assigned quotas, opportunities and forecasts; the Global Account Manager leads the consolidated Group strategy, executive engagement and cross-market growth agenda.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Account Leadership**

Develop and lead an integrated, multi-year global account strategy spanning the Group’s internal technology requirements and customer-facing services businesses.

Build trusted executive relationships across Group leadership, operating companies and technology, security, commercial, product and procurement functions.

Establish joint priorities, executive sponsorship and governance to advance strategic initiatives and remove barriers to execution.

Translate Group-level priorities into coordinated local account plans, with particular emphasis on the Middle East, Africa and Europe.

**Sell-To: Strategic Customer Development**

Position Fortinet against the Group’s cybersecurity, network modernization, cloud, data-centre and operational resilience priorities.

Identify strategic opportunities through a deep understanding of investment plans, architectures, decision-making processes and business objectives.

Lead Group-level engagement and support local account owners in complex sales pursuits, commercial negotiations and executive alignment.

Drive adoption and expansion across business units and operating companies through compelling business cases, shared reference architectures and demonstrated customer outcomes.

**Sell-With: Joint Solutions and Go-to-Market**

Co-develop a global growth strategy for Fortinet-powered offerings across the Group’s enterprise, SMB and managed-services businesses.

Work with product, commercial and technical teams to turn capabilities into market-ready propositions with defined customer segments, value propositions, commercial models and launch plans.

Develop joint sales plays, account targeting and demand-generation programmes with Group stakeholders, operating companies and Fortinet field teams.

Drive partner-sourced and co-sell opportunities from proposition development through pipeline creation and commercial execution, alongside the relevant local account owners.

Scale successful offerings across markets and operating companies, adapting to local demand, regulation and delivery capabilities.

**Commercial Frameworks and Executive Governance**

Lead the development and advancement of strategic framework, managed-services and other relevant agreements with Fortinet Legal, Finance and commercial stakeholders.

Establish joint business plans with clear objectives, accountable owners, milestones and success measures.

Lead executive business reviews and steering committees, translating strategic alignment into decisions, actions and business outcomes.

Maintain clear engagement and opportunity-ownership arrangements across global-account, local sales, alliance and channel teams.

**Cross-Functional Execution and Enablement**

Mobilize Fortinet Sales, Systems Engineering, Product and Marketing around agreed account priorities.

Coordinate across regions to provide a consistent global-account approach while enabling effective local execution.

Develop targeted enablement programmes that equip the Group’s sales, presales, product and delivery teams to position, sell and support joint offerings.

Share customer insights and successful practices across markets, bringing strategic requirements into Fortinet’s solution development and planning.

Maintain a consolidated global view of account performance, strategic opportunities and pipeline across sell-to and sell-with activities.

Align local account plans and forecasts with the overarching Group strategy, while preserving local quota and opportunity accountability.

Drive disciplined opportunity qualification and CRM reporting with local account owners; identify execution gaps and coordinate corrective actions.

* Proven experience managing complex customer engagements across sales, pre-sales, delivery, and the customer lifecycle.

* Demonstrated ability to lead business growth, manage senior customer relationships, and deliver commercial results in a complex matrix organization.
* Experience managing or influencing large, geographically distributed, and cross-functional teams.

* A collaborative leadership style and the ability to create alignment across organizational boundaries.

* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

### **What you’ll be doing...**

The Senior Manager, VEC Project Engagement serves as the critical connective tissue between Consumer Sales and Network Project Management teams. This role owns the translation layer between commercial priorities and network build/enablement execution, ensuring that sales commitments, market opportunities, and customer experience goals are matched to realistic, well-sequenced network capacity and infrastructure delivery.

This person is equally comfortable in a sales strategy conversation and a network engineering status review, and can move fluidly between the two, converting business urgency into engineering-ready requirements, and converting network constraints into sales-ready guidance.

* **Serve as the primary liaison** between VEC leadership and Network Project Management/Engineering teams, ensuring both sides operate from a shared view of priorities, timelines, and constraints.
* **Translate sales demand into network requirements**, working with network and sales leaders to understand market opportunity, promotional pushes, and customer commitments, then converting these into clear, prioritized asks for both teams.
* **Own the project engagement lifecycle** for VEC-related initiatives, from intake and scoping through execution tracking, risk escalation, and post-launch review, applying formal project/program management lifecycle discipline (SDLC/PMLC) to ensure consistent governance and delivery quality.
* **Manage cross-functional governance**, running regular joint forums (e.g., weekly/biweekly syncs, steering committees) between sales and network stakeholders to review pipeline, blockers, and enablement status.
* **Build and maintain enablement roadmaps** that align network build-out, capacity upgrades, and market readiness with sales go-to-market timing.
* **Identify and resolve friction points** where sales expectations outpace network readiness (or vice versa), proactively flagging risk and negotiating trade-offs with data-driven recommendations.
* **Develop reporting and dashboards** that give sales and network leadership visibility into project status, coverage/capacity readiness, and enablement milestones, leveraging AI-driven tools to automate data aggregation, surface insights faster, and reduce manual reporting effort.
* **Own process improvement** across the sales-to-network handoff, reducing rework, miscommunication, and delayed launches.
* **Lead and support escalation management** for high-priority markets, accounts, or launches where network enablement is on the critical path to sales targets.
* **Partner with Finance/Strategy** as needed to model the ROI and prioritization trade-offs of competing network investment requests driven by sales demand.

***This is a remote position with standard working hours from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET) and up to 25% travel to support new market launches.***

### **What we’re looking for...**

### **You’ll need to have:**

* Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.
* Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
* Six or more years of relevant work experience in partnership management, business development, channel sales, or a related field.
* Experience negotiating and managing third-party vendor or partner agreements.
* Experience leading teams or managing complex cross-functional initiatives.
* Experience in MDU, multifamily, property management, real estate, or proptech.
* Knowledge of the telecommunications, broadband, or connected-home landscape.
* Experience building a partner program or new sales channel from early stage to scale.
* Strong analytical skills, including building business cases and working with performance data to drive decisions.

### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* A degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, or an MBA.
* Excellent executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders both inside and outside the company.
* Comfort working in ambiguity and moving quickly from idea to pilot to scaled program.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

### **Where you’ll be working**

In this remote role, you'll work from home with occasional in-person trainings and meetings.

### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

### **Equal Employment Opportunity**

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

### **Benefits and Compensation**

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. Title: Partner Account Executive
Description:
The Role
  
  
The MSP Sales& Go-to-Market Lead – MEA-TRC East is an individual contributor responsible for accelerating and scaling Splunk’s business with Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) across the region.
  
  
This role translates the broader EMEA MSP strategy into a focused regional go-to-market and sales execution plan. The successful candidate will support the development and growth of strategic MSP partnerships that generate sustainable pipeline, recurring revenue, and new customer acquisition for Splunk.
  
The role will drive the adoption and execution of the Splunk MSP Program and ensure that Splunk is embedded or “designed in” within partners’ managed security, observability, infrastructure, and digital-resilience service offerings.
  
The MSP Sales& Go-to-Market Lead does not own or manage the partner relationship. Partner ownership and accountability remain with the respective Partner Development Manager (PDM) or Partner Sales Manager (PSM). This role provides MSP expertise, direction, and execution support to help partner and sales teams build and scale successful MSP motions.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
Regional MSP Strategy and Go-to-Market
  
  

* Develop and execute the regional MSP sales and go-to-market plan, aligned with the overall EMEA MSP strategy and regional business priorities.
* Ensure that priority partners have a clear MSP strategy and execution plan embedded within the broader partner plans owned by the respective PDMs and PSMs.
* Support PDMs and PSMs in defining MSP growth plans, revenue ambitions, enablement requirements, service-development priorities, and joint go-to-market activities.
* Build a clear scale plan to expand the regional MSP ecosystem by onboarding new partners, growing existing MSP capabilities, and driving new customer acquisition.
* Identify priority markets, customer segments, industry verticals, and MSP propositions with the strongest potential for scalable growth.
* Maintain a strong understanding of regional market dynamics, competition, regulation, customer demand, and emerging managed-service trends.

Sales and Business Development
  
  

* Support and drive MSP-related sales and business development activities across the region in close collaboration with PDMs, PSMs, and Splunk sales teams.
* Develop campaigns and initiatives that create MSP pipeline, generate net-new logos, and support recurring-revenue growth.
* Maintain visibility of the regional MSP pipeline and regularly review progress, performance, and execution with sales and partner teams.
* Support joint account planning and opportunity development with key strategic MSP partners.
* Work closely with regional and global MSP sales teams to align priorities, share best practices, and accelerate strategic opportunities.
* Support complex MSP opportunities and collaborate with the EMEA team to remove commercial, operational, contractual, or organizational barriers.
* Ensure that partner ownership, execution accountability, and opportunity follow-up remain clearly assigned to the relevant PDM, PSM, and sales teams.

Splunk MSP Program and Enablement
  
  

* Lead the regional adoption and execution of the Splunk MSP Program.
* Act as the regional MSP subject-matter expert and advocate for the program across partner and sales organizations.
* Advise internal teams and partners on MSP commercial models, pricing, contracting, licensing, and partner economics.
* Educate and enable Splunk sales, partner, and technical teams on the MSP route to market and how to position and execute the program.
* Work closely with the EMEA MSP team to identify program improvements required to address regional market needs.
* Partner closely with the MSP Partner Technical Manager (PTM) to ensure that the regional plan is technically aligned and supported by the required enablement, service-development, and delivery capabilities.

GTMDevelopmentandCross-FunctionalAlignment
  
  

* Build trusted relationships with key MSP stakeholders across executive leadership, sales, technical, service-development, operations, and marketing teams.
* Support partners in developing and launching differentiated Splunk-powered managed services.
* Help ensure that Splunk is designed into partners’ service catalogues across security, observability, infrastructure monitoring, and digital resilience.
* Support the development of partner value propositions, business cases, sales plays, campaigns, and customer-facing propositions.
* Align with Splunk Regional Sales Directors, Regional Sales Managers, AVPs, partner leadership, and other senior stakeholders.
* Work closely with PDMs, PSMs, PTMs, marketing, legal, finance, operations, and the EMEA and global MSP teams.
* Prepare and deliver MSP business reviews and updates to regional, EMEA, and partner leadership teams.

Commercial Leadership and Negotiation
  
  

* Support commercial discussions and negotiations with MSP and MSSP partners.
* Work with the EMEA MSP team, legal, finance, pricing, operations, and deal-desk teams to develop scalable and commercially viable agreements.
* Help resolve complex pricing, licensing, contractual, and route-to-market considerations.
* Apply strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills to accelerate strategic opportunities.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Extensive experience working with MSPs, MSSPs, service providers, cloud providers, or technology partners.
* Deep understanding of the regional MSP and MSSP landscape, business models, customer requirements, and competitive dynamics.
* Demonstrated success in sales, business development, partner development, or go-to-market roles.
* Proven ability to translate regional strategies into executable partner and sales plans.
* Strong understanding of recurring-revenue, consumption-based, managed-service, and partner-led business models.
* Experience developing and launching partner-led managed services or technology-based service offerings.
* Strong commercial acumen and experience supporting complex pricing, contracting, and negotiation discussions.
* Ability to influence stakeholders across partner, sales, technical, executive, regional, and global teams without direct ownership.
* Strong pipeline management, forecasting, business-planning, and executive communication skills.
* Knowledge of security, observability, infrastructure monitoring, cloud, or digital-resilience markets is highly desirable.
* Fluency in English

Preferred Qualifications/Skills
  
  

* Arabic or another relevant regional language would be an advantage.

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Title: Head, HR Operations, Transformation & Service Delivery
Description:
Imagine working at the forefront of innovation in fluid-flow technology, with over 1,600 colleagues across the globe, and contributing to a legacy of excellence that spans eight manufacturing facilities on four continents. Armstrong Fluid Technology is more than just a leader in our industry; we are a community of the brightest and most creative minds, driven by a shared mission to engineer the future and safeguard our planet.

The **Head, HR Operations, Transformation & Service Delivery** provides enterprise leadership for the design, delivery and continuous improvement of Armstrong's HR operations and service delivery model. The role is accountable for creating a simple, scalable, employee-centered and operationally disciplined HR environment, ensuring that core HR services are delivered consistently, efficiently and with clear ownership across the employee lifecycle.

Leading HR Operations, HR transformation, process excellence and service delivery, the role translates people strategy into practical operating models, standardized processes, service standards and measurable business outcomes.

A core mandate is to continuously challenge how work is performed through simplification to improvement philosophy, ensuring technology enables well-designed processes rather than automating unnecessary complexity.

**Key Accountabilities**

**1. HR Operations & Service Delivery**

* Lead Armstrong's enterprise HR Operations and service delivery capability, establishing clear service ownership, operating standards, controls and performance expectations.
* Establish consistent processes across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee changes, transfers, promotions, leaves, organizational changes and offboarding.
* Define and maintain HR service levels, escalation protocols, service ownership and operational performance measures.
* Establish HR knowledge management standards, ensuring employees, managers and HR teams have access to accurate and current policies, procedures and guidance.
* Build operational controls that strengthen compliance, data integrity, documentation quality and execution consistency.
* Identify recurring service issues and resolve root causes rather than relying on manual workarounds.
* Develop dashboards and performance reviews covering transaction quality, service volume, turnaround time, SLA achievement, employee experience and process effectiveness.

**2. HR Transformation**

* Lead the enterprise HR transformation portfolio, translating strategic people priorities into structured programs, projects and implementation roadmaps.
* Establish disciplined transformation governance including scope, objectives, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, resource requirements and decision rights.
* Manage cross-functional HR transformation initiatives from concept through design, implementation, stabilization and benefits realization.
* Maintain an integrated transformation roadmap identifying interdependencies across people, process, technology, data and organizational change.
* Establish portfolio prioritization methods ensuring HR resources are focused on initiatives delivering the highest organizational and employee value.
* Provide clear executive-level reporting covering milestones, outcomes, risks, decisions, capacity and transformation benefits.
* Ensure transformation initiatives transition effectively into sustainable business-as-usual ownership following implementation.

**3. HR Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish the enterprise methodology for HR process design, documentation and continuous improvement.
* Lead end-to-end process reviews across the employee lifecycle.
* Facilitate current-state assessment, process mapping, root-cause analysis, requirements definition and future-state design.
* Apply lean, continuous-improvement and structured problem-solving principles where appropriate.
* Eliminate unnecessary handoffs, duplicative activities, manual intervention and unclear ownership.
* Establish standard work, operating procedures, process controls, decision rights and performance measures.
* Create and maintain an enterprise HR process catalogue identifying process owners and supporting technology.
* Develop an HR continuous-improvement pipeline using employee feedback, service data, operational metrics and business requirements.
* Partner with HR Technology & Data to determine where workflow automation, system optimization, AI or self-service can eliminate administrative work and improve service.

**4. HR Service Delivery Model & Operating Model**

* Define which activities should be centralized, standardized, automated, delivered regionally or remain within specialist COEs.
* Establish clear roles, responsibilities, handoffs and escalation points.
* Develop service catalogues and service-level expectations.
* Establish appropriate governance between enterprise People & Organizational Capability teams and regional HR.
* Reduce role ambiguity and duplicate activity across HR.
* Ensure HRBP capacity is increasingly directed toward business partnership rather than transactional administration.
* Establish scalable service models capable of supporting future organizational growth.

**5. Change Management & Adoption**

* Embed structured change management into major HR transformation initiatives.
* Develop stakeholder, communications, training, readiness and adoption plans appropriate to each initiative.
* Assess organizational readiness and identify adoption barriers before implementation.
* Equip managers and HR teams to successfully implement new policies, processes, systems and ways of working.
* Establish adoption measures and monitor whether implemented changes are delivering intended outcomes.
* Reinforce new ways of working through governance, measurement, leadership accountability and ongoing improvement.
* Capture lessons learned and incorporate them into future transformation programs.

**6. Digital Enablement & Partnership with HR Technology**

* Define business requirements and future-state process requirements.
* Identify automation and digital workflow opportunities.
* Establish process priorities for system improvements.
* Participate in technology investment and enhancement prioritization.
* Support testing, implementation, change readiness and adoption.
* Ensure technology solutions support efficient processes and meaningful employee/manager experiences.
* Partner on data-quality improvements arising from process or operating-model issues.

**7.** **Governance, Risk & Controls**

* Establish appropriate operational governance across HR services and processes.
* Maintain clear process ownership, decision rights and approval authorities.
* Ensure HR operational practices comply with applicable organizational policies, employment requirements, privacy expectations and internal controls.
* Partner with Legal, Finance, IT and other control functions where required.
* Establish issue-management and escalation processes for material employee-service or operational risks.
* Ensure documented procedures and controls remain current as processes, systems and organizational structures change.
* Lead periodic reviews of HR operating effectiveness and identify required corrective actions.

**8.** **Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Build and lead a high-performing HR Operations and Transformation capability.
* Establish clear priorities, accountability and development expectations for the team.
* Partner closely with HR Business Partners and People COEs to improve end-to-end delivery.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on HR transformation, operating model and process effectiveness.
* Facilitate decision-making across stakeholders with competing priorities.
* Translate complex operational challenges into clear options, decisions and implementation plans.
* Develop organizational capability in process thinking, continuous improvement, program management and change leadership.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, curiosity, simplification and evidence-based decision-making.

  

**Role Requirements**

* University degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Business Transformation or a related discipline.
* CHRP/CHRL, PMP, PROSCI, Lean Six Sigma or comparable professional certification is an asset.
* Typically,10–15+ years of progressive HR, transformation, operations, shared services, program management or process-improvement experience.
* Significant experience leading complex HR transformation initiatives across functions and geographies.
* Demonstrated experience designing or improving HR service delivery and operating models.
* Strong understanding of employee lifecycle processes and HR operational controls.
* Experience with HRIS platforms, workflow automation, digital HR and employee/manager self-service.
* Demonstrated program and portfolio management capability.
* Strong process design, continuous-improvement and problem-solving skills.
* Experience establishing governance, performance measures and service standards.
* Demonstrated change-management and organizational adoption experience.
* Strong executive communication, facilitation and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Ability to translate strategy into practical and sustainable operating solutions.
* Experience working across HR, IT, Finance, Legal and business functions in a complex or global organization.

Description:
**Overview Of The Role:**  
  
  

* The Operations Manager will lead the day-to-day operational delivery across Moov's mobility products. This role is central to ensuring reliable customer fulfilment, vehicle readiness, and effective customer service while maintaining operational controls. As the company rapidly expands its fleet, the manager will focus on building teams and processes to scale efficiently. Identifying AI and automation improvements is critical, as is presenting these to the Head of Transformation & Subscription.

  
**What You Will Do:**  
  
  

#### **Operational Leadership**

  
  

* Own daily execution across the operational functions with clear responsibilities, escalation paths, and management routines.
* Build capabilities from zero to one, establishing SOPs, service standards, controls, training, and repeatable workflows that support rapid growth.
* Translate growth plans into operational capacity and resource requirements, anticipating bottlenecks and maintaining service continuity.
* Lead and develop the internal operations team through clear objectives, coaching, cross-training, and succession planning.
* Run operating reviews, resolve cross-functional issues, and track corrective actions through closure.
  

  

#### **Fleet Operations & Readiness**

  
  

* Maintain readiness, availability, and condition of the operating fleet.
* Coordinate preparation, inspections, preventive maintenance, and repairs with service providers to reduce downtime.
* Monitor and coordinate registration, insurance, and operating requirements.
* Maintain accurate operational vehicle statuses and physical-to-system reconciliation.
* Ensure returned vehicles are inspected, documented, and prepared for their next use.
  

  

#### **Logistics & Yard Operations**

  
  

* Oversee customer deliveries, collections, swaps, and operational vehicle movements.
* Maintain effective yard organization, vehicle custody, key controls, and movement records.
* Ensure consistent handover and return inspections, with documentation and customer acknowledgement.
* Improve movement reliability, turnaround, and cost efficiency, investigating incidents and discrepancies.
  

  

#### **Contract & Customer Operations**

  
  

* Fulfill from approved booking through handover, in-life administration, and operational closure.
* Ensure required customer documents and approvals are complete before fulfillment.
* Oversee contract activation, amendments, and renewals within approved policies and commercial terms.
* Ensure accurate and timely billing inputs for contractual charges, resolving disputes efficiently.
  

  

#### **Customer Service & Call Center Provider Governance**

  
  

* Own the operational relationship with the outsourced call center provider, holding it accountable for SLAs and service quality.
* Conduct regular KPI and service reviews, tracking corrective actions through closure.
* Listen to sampled calls and conduct QA checks for information accuracy, process adherence, and resolution effectiveness.
* Address recurring failures with the provider and internal teams, ensuring scripts and materials are up-to-date.
  

  

#### **Collections & Recovery**

  
  

* Monitor overdue accounts and customer follow-up, tracking payment commitments and collections queues.
* Maintain accurate records of contacts, disputes, and escalation decisions.
* Coordinate billing-dispute resolution with Finance and validate outstanding balances.
* Coordinate approved vehicle recovery and escalate cases with complete documents when necessary.
  

  

#### **Operational Cost, Controls & Risk**

  
  

* Manage the operations budget, monitor costs, and validate supplier charges against terms.
* Reduce avoidable expenditure and operational leakage without service quality compromise.
* Maintain controls over vehicle custody, documentation, customer records, and billing inputs.
* Ensure adherence to policies, procedures, and support audits with contingency arrangements.
  

  

#### **AI, Automation & Improvement Opportunity Identification**

  
  

* Identify recurring pain points and opportunities for AI and automation.
* Document operational problems, workflows, customer impacts, and expected benefits.
* Present recommendations to the Head of Transformation & Subscription for backlog consideration.

* Proven leadership and ability to manage operational functions in an automotive or similar industry.
* Strong analytical and communication skills, with proficiency in operational systems and reporting tools.
* Hands-on problem-solving skills with customer focus and ability to manage competing priorities.
* Practical awareness of AI and automation opportunities in operations.

  
**What Qualifies You For The Role:**  
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Logistics, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* Proven operations leadership in automotive rental, leasing, subscription, or similar asset-intensive service business.
* Experience in building operational capabilities from scratch and scaling during rapid growth.
* Strong operational cost and control discipline, with experience in fleet readiness, logistics, and customer operations.

Title: Business Unit Head – Security Systems & ELV (B2B)
Description:
**Company:** Qonnect

**Location:** Doha, Qatar

**Employment Type:** Full-time, Permanent

**About Qonnect**

Qonnect is a Qatari-owned technology integrator delivering ELV systems, security systems, and smart home solutions across residential and commercial sectors.

With a growing portfolio of completed projects and an established presence in the B2C market, we are expanding our operations to establish and scale a leading Security Systems and ELV business in Qatar, with a strong focus on MOI-regulated security solutions and B2B commercial opportunities.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an entrepreneurial and commercially driven Business Unit Head with proven experience in establishing, developing, and scaling Security Systems and ELV businesses in Qatar.

The successful candidate must have direct experience working with the Ministry of Interior (MOI), particularly the Security Systems Department (SSD), and a strong understanding of the licensing, regulatory, technical, and operational requirements of establishing and operating a security systems integration business in Qatar.

This is a senior player-coach role — not a traditional management position. You will own the business unit end-to-end, including regulatory readiness, P&L, business development, team building, and project delivery.

The role is structured in two phases:

**Phase 1 – Establish & Build (Months 1–12)**

* Establish the business unit's regulatory, technical, commercial, and operational foundations.
* Lead MOI licensing, approvals, and compliance activities.
* Personally develop the B2B sales pipeline, acquire customers, close contracts, and oversee project delivery.
* Build the organizational capabilities required to support sustainable growth.

**Phase 2 – Scale (Year 2 onwards)**

* Transition into full business unit leadership.
* Build and manage a growing commercial and technical team.
* Drive strategic growth, market expansion, operational excellence, and profitability.

Compensation & Earning Potential

* **Base salary:** QAR 8,000–13,000 per month.
* **Commission:** 3.5% on division revenue.
* **Earning potential:** Performance-linked and uncapped.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Unit Establishment & Regulatory Compliance

* Establish, develop, and scale the Security Systems and ELV business unit in Qatar.
* Lead company licensing, registration, accreditation, and regulatory compliance activities with the Ministry of Interior (MOI), particularly the Security Systems Department (SSD).
* Establish the organizational structure, technical capabilities, staffing, processes, and operational infrastructure required to meet applicable MOI requirements.
* Manage regulatory submissions, technical approvals, inspections, certifications, and license renewals, as applicable.
* Establish relationships with relevant technology manufacturers, distributors, consultants, and industry stakeholders.
* Develop the business unit's service portfolio, commercial strategy, and go-to-market approach.
* Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable regulatory and technical requirements.

2. B2B Revenue Growth & Business Development

* Build and own the B2B sales pipeline, targeting contractors, developers, MEP consultants, commercial establishments, facility management companies, and government entities across Qatar.
* Identify and pursue commercial opportunities for MOI-compliant security systems and ELV solutions.
* Leverage Qonnect's existing customer base, project portfolio, technical capabilities, and vendor relationships to generate new business opportunities.
* Personally manage the full sales cycle, including prospecting, lead generation, tendering, proposals, pricing, negotiation, and contract closure.
* Develop recurring revenue streams through annual maintenance contracts (AMCs), support services, and long-term customer relationships.
* Achieve agreed quarterly and annual revenue and profitability targets.

3. P&L and Financial Accountability

* Own the business unit's P&L, including revenue, gross margin, operating costs, and profitability.
* Develop annual business plans, budgets, revenue forecasts, and growth strategies.
* Monitor project financial performance, cash flow, collections, procurement, and subcontractor costs.
* Ensure commercially viable pricing and sustainable project margins.
* Report directly to company leadership with performance updates, forecasts, risks, and strategic recommendations.

4. Project Delivery & Operations

* Ensure high-quality, compliant, and timely delivery of security systems and ELV projects.
* Oversee technical proposals, system designs, BOQs, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning, and project handover.
* Ensure applicable MOI requirements are incorporated throughout the project lifecycle.
* Manage suppliers, technology partners, subcontractors, and technical delivery teams.
* Establish operational processes, project tracking tools, quality standards, and performance KPIs.
* Ensure customer satisfaction and effective after-sales support.

5. Team Building & Leadership

* Establish and develop the commercial, technical, and operational capabilities of the business unit.
* Lead recruitment and development of qualified sales, engineering, and technical personnel.
* Define clear roles, responsibilities, performance targets, and accountability mechanisms.
* Build a commercially driven, customer-focused, and results-oriented culture.
* Develop a scalable operating model that reduces dependency on individual resources as the business grows.

**What We're Looking ForExperience – Mandatory Requirements**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Security Systems and ELV integration in Qatar, preferably 8 years or more.
* Previous experience working within an MOI-licensed security systems integration company in Qatar.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience dealing with the Ministry of Interior (MOI) and its Security Systems Department (SSD).
* Direct experience managing company licensing, registration, accreditation, technical submissions, approvals, and inspections, as applicable.
* Proven track record of establishing, developing, or significantly scaling a Security Systems or ELV business unit in Qatar.
* Demonstrated experience building commercial and operational capabilities, including teams, processes, vendor partnerships, and customer portfolios.
* Proven ability to personally generate, negotiate, and close B2B contracts in Qatar.
* Established professional network across contractors, consultants, developers, commercial customers, and relevant industry stakeholders.

**Preferred Experience**

* Previous experience establishing an MOI-licensed security systems company or division from the ground up.
* Previous P&L ownership or business unit leadership experience.
* Experience developing annual maintenance contracts and recurring service revenue.
* Experience managing government and large-scale commercial security systems projects.

**Technical Knowledge**

Strong working knowledge of security systems and ELV technologies, including:

* MOI-compliant CCTV and video surveillance systems.
* Video Management Systems (VMS).
* Access control systems.
* Intrusion detection and alarm systems.
* Structured cabling and networking.
* Intercom systems.
* Public Address (PA) and Audio Visual (AV) systems.
* Fire alarm and related ELV systems.

The candidate must be capable of reviewing technical proposals, system designs, specifications, and BOQs independently.

**Skills & Attributes**

* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build a business from the ground up.
* Strong commercial acumen and sales-closing capabilities.
* Strong understanding of Qatar's security systems market and regulatory environment.
* Excellent leadership, negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to operate independently in a lean, entrepreneurial organization.
* Strong financial awareness and understanding of business profitability.
* Fluent in English; Arabic is a strong advantage.
* Valid Qatar driving license is mandatory.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Relevant professional, technical, or project management certifications are an advantage.

Title: Director, Cybersecurity
Description:
Strengthen the security resilience of one of the few environments where research, clinical care, and hospital operations converge. As a Director, Cybersecurity at Sinai Health, you will lead the tactical and operational work needed to turn an established security roadmap into lasting safeguards. This is a hands-on leadership role where you actively steer risk assessments, security operations, and technical controls alongside team members and external partners. You will pair advanced security tooling and industry-leading partners to protect corporate systems, health services, personal information (PI), personal health information (PHI), research data and intellectual property. Few sectors face the scale, complexity and potential consequences of cyber threats that healthcare does. Your work keeps those systems safe preserving the trust of the communities we serve.
  
  
Is this you?
  
Bringing people together around a shared goal is how you advance risk posture across complex environments. Cybersecurity is a shared responsibility that no single team can carry alone, so the relationships you build matter as much as the controls you put in place. Working in close collaboration with IT, privacy, clinical, and corporate teams allows you to apply security controls in ways that support everyday work. Whether you are shaping a new policy or rolling out a control, you build support across teams by showing how it protects the work they already care about. The shared ownership you cultivate helps a culture of security take root across the organization.
  
Are you proactive about keeping current about new technologies and emerging threats? This field moves quickly, so staying effective means understanding what’s trending and what it means for the systems you protect. Industry research, threat intelligence, and strong partner relationships keep you informed about where the field is heading. Whether you are evaluating a new tool or a vendor’s latest offering, you weigh the investment against the organization’s needs and priorities to ensure it’s the right use of our investments and time. The knowledge you build keeps the organization ahead of emerging threats and keeps you growing as a professional.
  
A practical command of security technology gives you a clear understanding of how systems behave. This is a role where you work with the systems yourself, so your knowledge stays current and applied. Whether you are reviewing how access is configured in the Epic electronic health record platform or tuning the detection rules behind your monitoring, you are at ease working in the technology directly. This is where deep technical skill and senior leadership reinforce each other, keeping you engaged with the technology on a daily basis.
  
Strong problem-solving skills are essential in a role like this, where the decisions you face rarely come with an obvious answer. This position sits at the point where business priorities and technical demands converge, requiring someone with the confidence and critical thinking to arrive at solutions that work for both. The impact of your judgment extends well beyond the security team, shapes outcomes that matter across the whole organization, making your work widely visible.
  
  
**In this role you will:**  

* Lead the development and maintenance of information security policies and standards, owning and maintaining the enterprise cyber risk register and governance framework
* Lead compliance activities under PHIPA and the Ontario Cyber Security Framework/Regulation, coordinating evidence collection, control testing, and gap remediation
* Integrate cyber governance, risk, and compliance activities with other hospital risk management and advisory functions, including Enterprise Risk Management, Privacy, Legal, and Internal Audit, to ensure a coordinated approach to risk, incident response, and regulatory obligations
* Prepare and present risk and compliance reporting for various committees, senior leadership, and internal/external auditors
* Lead third-party risk assessments from a governance perspective, including privacy and contractual risk considerations, in partnership with Procurement, Privacy, and Legal
* Own and mature the cyber threat and vulnerability risk management program, including threat intelligence, threat management tools and risk-mitigation processes
* Direct prioritization, tracking, and reporting of vulnerability and threat remediation across endpoints, servers, network, and cloud/SaaS environments
* Own selection, configuration, and lifecycle management of risk management tooling (e.g., GRC platform, vulnerability management, threat intelligence feeds)
* Lead risk assessments for new systems, vendors, and technology changes, and maintain associated risk treatment plans
* Conduct direct day-to-day security operations, including SIEM/SOC monitoring, detection, and incident response, delivered through internal staff and managed security service providers
* Own the incident response process end-to-end: triage, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident/lessons-learned review
* Direct endpoint security strategy (EDR/anti-malware, hardening baselines) and identity/access security operations, including Cloud Identity Services federation, Epic EHR access, and Microsoft 365/Entra ID security
* Coordinate vendor-delivered assessments (penetration tests, tabletop exercises) and ensure findings are integrated into the risk register
* Supervise direct reports (e.g., Cyber Security Analyst and IAM/Operations Analyst), including performance management, coaching, and development planning
* Perform other duties consistent with the job classification as required

**Job Requirements:**  
Mandatory
  

* 7 years of related experience in a cybersecurity leadership position
* College Diploma or bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or a related technical field

Preferred
  

* Previous experience in a clinical or hospital environment

Skills and Knowledge
  

* Expert knowledge of cyber security frameworks and standards (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls) and Ontario health-sector requirements (PHIPA, Ontario Cyber Security Framework/Regulation)
* Expert working knowledge of security operations tooling: SIEM, EDR/endpoint protection, vulnerability management, and MSSP/MDR service models
* Strong technical knowledge of identity and access management, access models, and Microsoft 365/Entra ID security configuration

The Product Manager - Digital Enterprise Solutions Governance & Portfolio Performance is responsible for the financial, commercial, governance, and portfolio performance management of Digital Enterprise Solutions. Title: Director, Technology Operations
Description:
**Director, Technical Operations (Platform)**
**Job Type:**
Permanent Full Time
  
  
**Location:**
Hybrid - Toronto, Ontario
  
  
**Reporting to:**
Chief Technology Officer
  
  
**Salary**
: $160,000 – $190,000 CAD
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Director, Technology Operations owns the operational health of the platforms Goway sells and services travel on: our reservations platform, the infrastructure it runs on, the supplier, air and distribution integrations it depends on, and the automation and data pipelines built around it.
  
  
This is a practice-building role. You will define and own Goway's technical operations discipline: service levels, incident management, change control, observability and operational readiness, and you will make them the standard across our technology organisation. You will work alongside other Technology leaders. You will own the technology operations of our platform. You will have the CTO's mandate and backing to build the practice.
  
  
**What will be your key responsibilities?**
Reliability and service management
  
  

* Define, publish and report service levels and service-level objectives for revenue-critical services, starting with quoting, booking, payment and traveller servicing.
* Own incident management end to end: severity definitions, escalation, incident command, communication during an incident, and post-incident review with corrective actions.
* Own RCA and problem management.
* Own change and release management as a company standard, balancing delivery throughput against change failure rate.
* Build observability sufficient to detect degradation.
* Own disaster recovery and business continuity for platform services, tested and documented on a stated cadence.

Integration and supplier platform operations
  
  

* Monitoring of integration paths, error and failure-rate thresholds, and defined fallback behaviour when a partner degrades.
* Maintain a dependency map of the external platforms our revenue-generating flows rely on, with assessed operational risk and mitigation for each.
* Own operational readiness for new integrations and new product lines entering the platform.
* Own the operational reliability of automation and data pipelines in production.

Platform and cloud operations
  
  

* Day-to-day operation of the AWS and managed hosting infrastructure serving our platform estate: environments, provisioning, patching and lifecycle management.
* Own hosting cost governance: visibility by service, a unit-cost measure, and an annual optimisation target.
* Lead capacity planning against forecast booking and travel volumes.
* Reduce manual, repeatable operational work through automation.
* Address seasonal capacity planning, change freezes and enhanced coverage aligned to our booking and departure peaks and to new product launches.

Vendors, partners and compliance
  
  

* Platform, hosting and integration partner relationships: SLA definition, enforcement and structured performance review.
* Reduce single points of dependency, whether on a vendor or an individual.
* Partner with security on vulnerability management, patch compliance, access control and audit readiness.

Practice leadership and stakeholder engagement
  
  

* Build and maintain a multi-year technical operations roadmap aligned to Goway's growth plans.
* Report operational performance, risk and investment needs to the CTO and executive team in business terms.

**What are we looking for?**
**Required**

* 8 or more years in platform operations, technical operations, infrastructure or site reliability engineering, including 5 or more years in a lead or leadership capacity.
* Demonstrated accountability for the availability and performance of a revenue-critical transactional platform.
* Evidence of having built operational practice where little existed: SLOs, incident management, change control and observability introduced from the ground up, with measurable improvement to show for it.
* Hands-on depth in AWS, including cost management and multi-environment operation.
* Substantial experience operating and governing third-party platforms and integrations, including holding vendors to service levels.
* Ability to set standards and drive adoption across teams.
* Ability to communicate operational risk and performance.

**Preferred**

* Experience stabilising and operationalising new systems.
* Infrastructure-as-code and container orchestration experience.
* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer (Professional), or AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer (Associate). Solutions Architect certifications are welcome, but less relevant to this role than the operations-focused ones.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering or equivalent practical experience.

**What can you expect from Goway?**

* Imagine working for a company where your career feels like an adventure. At Goway, you’ll join a global community that supports one another:
* We offer a competitive salary accompanied by performance incentives, and we place real importance on time away from work, such as paid personal days for when life calls for them and your birthday off each year.
* Our commitment to professional growth means you’ll have access to continuous learning and industry-leading training that keeps you at the forefront of travel innovation.
* You’ll enjoy generous paid time off, including [three] weeks of vacation, [six] personal days, and a dedicated day off to celebrate your birthday.
* Travel is in our DNA, so you’ll enjoy exclusive perks and discounts on worldwide getaways.
* Since we operate across Toronto, Vancouver, Los Angeles, Manila, Sydney, and beyond, you’ll collaborate across cultures and shape a career path that reflects your ambitions.
* Goway is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate differences and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace for everyone. We appreciate every applicant’s interest. Please be advised that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

**How To Apply**
If this role feels like your next step, click "Apply Now" to create your profile, upload your CV, and share a few details about yourself. Our talent team reviews every application, and if your experience aligns with our needs, we will reach out to set up the next step.
  
  
**AI Screening Disclosure**
To help us fairly and efficiently review applications, we use an automated screening process to assess responses to pre-determined questions. This initial step ensures all candidates are evaluated consistently. Qualified applicants will be reviewed by our recruitment team for further consideration.
  
  
**Additional Notes**
Goway Travel Ltd will retain applications, notifications, and records related to this posting for three years, reflecting our commitment to fair and equitable hiring practices.
  
  
**Recruitment Scams & Fraud Warning**
Please be aware of any suspicious emails or WhatsApp activity from individuals pretending to be recruiters or senior personnel at Goway Travel. We will never ask you to install an app during the recruitment process. If you receive a message of this nature, please ignore it and report it to Goway.
  
  
**About Goway**
Founded in Toronto in 1970 by Australian economist Bruce Hodge, Goway has evolved from a one-person dream into a family-owned global leader in tailor-made travel. With our headquarters in Toronto and hubs in Vancouver, Los Angeles, Sydney, and Manila, our team of over 800 talented employees designs travel experiences in more than 115 countries across all seven continents. We’re united by a passion for travel and are committed to doing the right thing: supporting diversity, equity, inclusion, and sustainable tourism that enriches local communities. Whether working remotely or side by side in one of our offices, we operate as one forward-thinking team, transforming wanderlust into life-changing adventures for our fellow Globetrotters. Discover more at goway.com.

****Job Description**
:**
The
**Technical Program Manager**
will join the Project Management Office and drive a complex, multi-year strategic government program involving hardware platform NPI, concurrent software releases, private cloud infrastructure deployment, and international compliance certification. The role requires strong technical program management skills, disciplined execution, executive stakeholder management, and the ability to coordinate across Hardware Engineering, Firmware Development, Networking Software (cloud management, security, controller platforms), QA, Product Management, Manufacturing, International Compliance, and government customer teams across multiple time zones.
  
  
The individual will own program visibility and governance, identify and drive resolution of complex cross-functional dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams, ensure customer commitments are met, manage compliance/certification critical paths, maintain executive stakeholder alignment, and escalate risks early with clear impact analysis and mitigation options.
  
  
****KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:****
**Executive Stakeholder Management & Program Governance**

* Own program governance structure; establish and maintain executive steering committee cadence with clear decision-making authority
* Provide weekly executive reporting on program health, milestone status, critical risks, and pending decisions
* Communicate program status to SVP-level leadership and customer steering committee with clear, actionable insights
* Escalate risks and resource conflicts to leadership with impact analysis, mitigation options, and recommended actions
* Ensure executive visibility into program timeline, customer commitments, and go/no-go readiness
* Manage executive decision-making on trade-offs (scope vs. schedule vs. quality) with full context

**Release & Program Management**

* Manage multiple concurrent software and hardware release programs across cloud management, security, controller, networking software, and manufacturing components
* Drive releases through development completion, QA, release readiness, and GA milestones
* Track release scope, feature readiness, must-fix defects, testing completion, and release criteria
* Lead release readiness meetings, ensuring actions, risks, dependencies, and decisions are documented
* Ensure release artifacts (release notes, technical documentation, customer guides) are completed before GA
* Identify schedule risks early and drive mitigation plans with responsible teams

**Hardware NPI & Manufacturing Coordination**

* Manage new hardware platform NPI program through development, manufacturing, QA verification, and GA
* Track development, firmware/image readiness, QA verification, manufacturing readiness, and GA milestones
* Ensure hardware engineering and software feature commitments remain aligned with manufacturing timeline
* Coordinate hardware-firmware-software dependencies required for platform launch
* Drive BOM finalization, manufacturing-image readiness, and ODM partner coordination to ensure hardware ships with appropriate firmware
* Coordinate dependencies across Hardware Engineering, Firmware, Software teams, Manufacturing, ODM partners, and other supporting organizations

**Quality & Defect Management**

* Participate in recurring defect/bug scrubs across multiple software platforms and hardware validation
* Track must-fix defects and ensure critical issues are resolved before release
* Work with Engineering and QA to prioritize defects based on release impact and schedule
* Monitor automated and manual test results; escalate failures threatening release readiness
* Ensure comprehensive end-to-end testing for features spanning multiple platforms (cloud management, security, controller, networking software)

**Dependency, Risk & Escalation Management**

* Maintain visibility into complex cross-functional dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams
* Proactively identify schedule, resource, technical, testing, compliance, and manufacturing risks
* Maintain centralized risk register with probability/impact assessment and mitigation tracking
* Drive owners toward resolution of blocking issues rather than simply reporting status
* Escalate unresolved risks and resource conflicts to leadership with clear impact, options, and recommended actions
* Coordinate commitments when multiple programs compete for shared Engineering or QA resources
* Ensure critical dependencies have clearly defined owners, dates, and closure criteria

**International Compliance & Certification Management**

* Coordinate compliance deliverables required for government product release
* Track regulatory and international compliance dependencies (FCC, CE, telecom certifications, government security requirements)
* Ensure compliance requirements and certifications do not block customer deployment
* Coordinate dependencies involving external certification bodies and ODM partners
* Track certification timelines and identify delays or blockers early
* Assess and communicate release impact of delayed certifications or compliance deliverables

**Program Tracking & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate program plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and status using Jira and portfolio management tools
* Use Jira epics, features, defects, and dashboards to assess program health across all workstreams
* Develop concise program status reports for PMO and executive leadership
* Clearly communicate milestone health, risks, decisions required, and leadership attention areas
* Use AI tools to generate automated reports, trend analysis, and program health dashboards
* Leverage AI-driven monitoring tools to track program metrics and flag risks proactively
* Manage program coordination and reporting across multiple time zones to support global teams and customers

****REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS****

* 5+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Project Management, or Engineering Program Management in technology organizations
* Demonstrated experience managing complex hardware NPI programs (design through manufacturing, QA, GA)
* Demonstrated experience managing concurrent software releases across multiple platforms with independent release cadences
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (development, integration, QA, defect management, release readiness, GA)
* Strong understanding of hardware NPI lifecycle (design, manufacturing, BOM, image readiness, production ramp, GA)
* Experience coordinating programs involving Hardware Engineering, Firmware Development, Software teams (cloud, security, controller), QA, Product Management, Manufacturing, Compliance, and other cross-functional organizations
* Strong experience managing milestones, dependencies, risks, and critical-path activities across multiple concurrent programs
* Demonstrated ability to drive teams toward committed dates without direct management authority
* Experience leading release-readiness meetings, program reviews, defect reviews, and cross-functional working sessions
* Executive communication experience – ability to present program status, risks, and recommendations to VP/SVP-level leadership
* Program governance experience – ability to establish program decision-making structures and executive steering committees
* Strong Jira experience including epics, features, defects, dashboards, queries, and program tracking
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to communicate effectively with technical teams and senior leadership
* Demonstrated ability to recognize when a program is at risk, determine underlying cause, establish action plan, and escalate appropriately
* Risk management experience – ability to identify, assess, prioritize, and track mitigation of program risks
* Ability to operate effectively in fast-moving environment with multiple simultaneous releases and changing priorities
* Experience managing programs with resource support across multiple time zones
* Ability to use various AI tools to generate reports, analyze program data, monitor program metrics, and identify trends

****PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS****

* Experience in networking, enterprise infrastructure, cloud-managed platforms, or telecommunications
* Experience managing programs that combine hardware, firmware/software, cloud services, and management/control applications
* Experience with hardware NPI including manufacturing readiness, BOM management, software-image readiness, and ODM/OEM partner coordination
* Familiarity with international product compliance processes (FCC, CE, country-specific certifications)
* Familiarity with government or regulated-industry customer procurement processes and approval workflows
* Experience managing cloud platform deployments, controller-based software releases, and private infrastructure configurations

**execution-oriented**
rather than primarily administrative. This person should be comfortable going deep enough into technical programs to understand what is blocking hardware development, software integration, manufacturing readiness, or compliance certification; challenging dates or assumptions when necessary; and driving teams toward resolution.
  
  
They should be able to simultaneously manage hardware NPI and multiple concurrent software releases while maintaining clear understanding of what must happen, who owns it, when it must happen, what dependencies exist, what could cascade delays, and what needs leadership attention.

* Strong ownership – Takes responsibility for program health, governance, and escalation
* Executive presence – Communicates with confidence to senior leadership; gains executive trust and credibility
* Persistence – Drives resolution of blocking issues rather than accepting "will figure it out later"

* AI adoption mindset – Comfortable leveraging AI tools to enhance reporting, analysis, and decision-making
