Title: Associate Director, Operations & Maintenance (O&M)
Description:
**Job Purpose**

Dedicated to Pactive, the Associate Director, O&M is accountable for the safe, reliable and profitable operation of Pactive's installed asset base, including solar PV, battery energy storage, LED lighting, BMS and metering, HVAC and chiller plant, EV charging and energy performance (ESCO) contracts across Aldar Group and third-party clients. The role turns O&M from a cost-to-serve activity into a recurring-revenue and margin business. It leads the O&M team and subcontractors, guarantees contractual availability, performance ratio and energy savings, protects warranties and performance guarantees, builds the remote monitoring and command-and-control capability, and grows the O&M order book through renewals, upsell and new long-term service contracts.

**Job Details**

**Roles, Responsibilities, Duties**

Associate Director, Operations & Maintenance (O&M)

* **O&M Portfolio Leadership:**
  Own the end-to-end delivery of all Pactive O&M contracts, including preventive, corrective and predictive maintenance, for solar PV (rooftop, carport and ground mount), BESS, lighting, BMS, metering, HVAC, EV chargers and energy performance contracts. Set annual maintenance plans, resource plans and budgets for each contract and ensure delivery against scope, SLA, cost and quality.
* **Asset Performance & Availability:**
  Guarantee contractual availability, performance ratio (PR), yield and response and resolution times. Lead root-cause analysis of under-performance, equipment failures and generation losses, and drive corrective actions. Track and report performance against guaranteed values and minimise liquidated damages and performance penalties.
* **Energy Savings & M&V Guarantees:**
  Working with the M&V team, ensure that energy performance and shared-savings contracts deliver verified savings in line with IPMVP and contractual guarantees. Coordinate operational changes, set-points and maintenance practices that protect and grow savings, including multi-owner and owners association portfolios.
* **Remote Monitoring & Command Centre:**
  Build and run Pactive's remote monitoring and command-and-control capability (SCADA, inverter and BMS platforms, CMMS). Define alarm management, escalation and dispatch protocols, use data analytics for predictive maintenance, and deliver live performance dashboards to clients and management.
* **Commercial Growth & Recurring Revenue:**
  Grow the O&M order book through contract renewals, scope extensions, retrofits, repowering and upsell of additional services. Support Growth & Key Accounts on O&M pricing, proposals and bids, and convert Pactive's EPC handovers into long-term O&M agreements. Develop O&M offerings for third-party and developer-owned assets, including Aldar Group and joint venture portfolios.
* **Contract, Cost & Margin Management:**
  Own the P&L of the O&M portfolio. Manage contract scope, variations, claims, invoicing milestones and collections with Commercial & Controls. Monitor cost to serve, labour productivity, spare parts consumption and subcontractor spend, and protect gross margin on every contract. Holds approval authority only within the Pactive Delegation of Authority.
* **Warranty, Spares & Subcontractor Management:**
  Manage OEM warranties and performance guarantees for modules, inverters, batteries and other critical equipment, including claims and replacements. Maintain strategic spares holdings and stock levels. Select, manage and performance-review O&M subcontractors and specialist service providers in coordination with Procurement.
* **Handover & Lifecycle Engineering:**
  Define O&M requirements at design and tender stage, and lead the acceptance of new assets from Project Delivery (punch lists, as-built documentation, testing and commissioning records, training and spares). Plan mid-life refurbishment, component replacement and end-of-life strategies for the asset base.
* **Team Leadership & Capability:**
  Lead, develop and organise the O&M managers, engineers, supervisors and technicians across Dubai, Abu Dhabi and other regions. Set clear roles, KPIs and competency frameworks, plan succession, and build technical skills in solar, storage, electrical HV/LV and building systems. Foster a culture of safety, ownership and client service.
* **Client & Stakeholder Management:**
  Act as senior O&M point of contact for key clients, asset owners, Aldar Group entities, Khidmah/FM partners and authorities (DEWA, ADDC/TAQA and other utilities). Lead periodic performance reviews, manage escalations and maintain high client satisfaction and renewal rates. Agree the boundary of services with Khidmah and other group FM providers.
* **Executive & Monthly Reporting:**
  Prepare concise executive-level reports, monthly management packs and dashboards covering asset availability and PR, energy yield and savings, SLA compliance, incidents, backlog, cost, margin, order book and renewals, key risks and agreed O&M metrics. Convert complex operational data into clear actions and recommendations.
* **Standards, Compliance & Continuous Improvement:**
  Develop and maintain O&M policies, procedures and method statements aligned with OEM requirements, IEC and applicable UAE codes and authority regulations. Maintain audit-ready maintenance records in the CMMS. Drive standardisation, digitalisation, process discipline and ISO 9001/14001/45001/55001 alignment across the portfolio.
* **Key Performance Indicators:**
  Contractual availability and PR achieved; verified energy savings against guarantee; SLA response and resolution compliance; preventive maintenance completion; zero lost-time incidents; O&M revenue growth and renewal rate; gross margin per contract; warranty claims recovered; client satisfaction scores.
* **Occupational Health, Safety & Environment:**
  Adhere to all Pactive and Khidmah HSE policies, procedures, practices and applicable legal and statutory requirements, and remain current with updates. Ensure safe systems of work for all O&M activities, including permit to work, LOTO, working at height and electrical safety, and lead incident investigation and corrective actions.
* **Information Security responsibilities:**
* Comply with Pactive and Khidmah Information Security policies,
* Be aware of and fulfill their information security responsibilities
* Ensure whoever handles sensitive company information have taken the Security Awareness Training
* Know how to report a security incident (to IT ServiceDesk or InfoSec).
* Not Disable his/her OS firewall and/or Antivirus
* Restrict use to authorized purposes, Protect access accounts, privileges and associated passwords.
* Accept accountability of his/her individual user accounts and maintain confidentiality.

**Qualification:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Energy or Renewable Energy Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Professional engineering registration or certification (e.g. CEng, PE) and CEM, CMVP or asset management (IAM/ISO 55001) qualification is strongly preferred.
* DEWA and/or ADDC solar PV or electrical certification, NEBOSH or IOSH safety qualification, and a postgraduate business or management qualification are an advantage.

**Experience and Skills:**

**Experience:**

* Approximately 12-18 years of progressive experience in O&M, asset management or technical services, including at least 5 years leading multi-site O&M portfolios and teams.
* Proven experience operating utility-scale and/or distributed solar PV assets; experience with BESS, energy efficiency, ESCO or building systems (BMS, HVAC, lighting) is highly desirable.
* Track record of delivering contractual availability, performance ratio and energy savings guarantees, and of managing O&M contracts with SLAs and liquidated damages.
* Experience in the UAE or GCC, with working knowledge of DEWA, ADDC/TAQA and other authority requirements, net metering and grid connection rules.
* Demonstrated P&L ownership of a service or O&M business, including growth of recurring revenue through renewals and new contracts.

**Technical & Commercial Capability:**

* Strong understanding of PV, inverter, BESS and electrical HV/LV systems, monitoring platforms (SCADA, CMMS) and data-driven predictive maintenance.
* Able to interpret contract terms, cost to serve, budgets, forecasts, actuals and variances, and to price O&M scopes competitively and profitably.
* Advanced analytical capability, with confidence developing performance analytics, management information and executive reporting.

**Skills & Behaviours:**

* Inspiring, hands-on leader able to build and motivate field teams and hold subcontractors to account.
* Uncompromising commitment to safety and service quality.
* Credible with clients and senior management; strong negotiation skills.
* Excellent communication; able to distil complex technical information into concise recommendations.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint capability; experience with CMMS, SCADA/monitoring and ERP (SAP) tools is expected.
* Fluent professional English; Arabic is an advantage. Valid UAE driving licence required.

Title: Delivery Program Director
Description:
Position Overview:

We are creating a new leadership role that brings Customer Success and Product Support together under one owner.

On the Customer Success side, you will be accountable for the full client experience after contract signature, from onboarding and go live through adoption, satisfaction and renewal.

On the Support side, you will have direct responsibility for the Product Support team and overall accountability for support service excellence. This includes defining support processes, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and coordinating with shared support and maintenance functions to ensure seamless collaboration and the delivery of reliable 24/7 customer support within SLA targets.

Your mandate is simple to state and demanding to deliver: every client should be well supported, getting real value from our products, and happy to recommend us. You will build the Customer Success function largely from the ground up, give the business a clear, data driven view of client health and raise the standard of our support operation.

The role is deliberately hands-on in the first year. Alongside building the team and the operating model, you will personally manage key customer relationships, lead critical escalations and work directly with the support team on day-to-day operations until the new processes and team are fully established.

Responsibilities:

**Lead Product Support**

* Define and run support processes covering triage, prioritization, SLAs, incident and problem management, root cause analysis and knowledge management, in close alignment with SaaS Operations and Engineering.
* Improve the speed and quality of incident and problem management, as well as how customers perceive it.
* Use monitoring, data and AI to move support from reactive to proactive, increasing self service and first contact resolution.
* Build a support model that scales with the customer base.

**Build and run the Customer Success function**

* Define and run the customer success operating model: customer segmentation and coverage, engagement playbooks, a common account plan and a customer health score.
* Set the rhythm of customer engagement, including onboarding reviews, regular service reviews, executive business reviews and renewal planning.
* Build a joint customer success model across SBS product lines and regions.

**Orchestrate the customer experience**

* Act as the single point of accountability for the customer experience across Support, Customer Success and delivery teams.
* Ensure customer experience responsiveness, predictability and transparency on incidents, releases and roadmap commitments.
* Own escalation management, personally leading critical escalations through to resolution and clear communication with the client.
* Work with Professional Services to ensure a smooth handover from project to run, so every go live lands well.

**Elevate customer satisfaction and retention**

* Run proactive health reviews and early risk detection, with clear recovery plans for accounts at risk.
* Own the voice of the customer: CSAT and NPS programs, app store ratings and structured feedback loops into Product.
* Contribute to the SBS Customer Satisfaction Program and embed the Golden Disciplines across customer-facing teams.
* Protect renewals by working with Account Managers well ahead of renewal dates, so there are no surprises.

**Maximize product adoption and realized value**

* Track usage and adoption across products and modules, and identify underused features and adoption gaps.
* Run adoption plans with customers to unlock more of the value they have already bought.
* Measure and demonstrate tangible ROI to client executives through regular value reviews.
* Bring structured customer insight into roadmap prioritization with Product Leaders.

**Surface growth opportunities**

* Identify new use cases, additional modules and upgrade opportunities within the installed base.
* Channel qualified upsell and expansion leads to Account Managers, and build a pipeline originated by the CSM team over time.

Qualifications:

* At least 10 years in enterprise software or fintech, including at least 5 years leading Customer Success, Support or Service Delivery teams.
* Strong track record in banking or financial services software, ideally in digital banking, open banking, payments or lending.
* Experience managing both SaaS and customer managed (on premise) clients, including SLA governance and major incident management.
* Credible with bank executives and comfortable leading difficult conversations when things go wrong.
* Experience across the Middle East and Africa, ideally with exposure to the US and Europe. Knowledge of the GCC banking market is a strong plus.
* Comfortable working in a matrix organization and influencing teams that do not report directly to them.
* Hands-on leader who can operate at executive level while confidently diving into the operational and technical details as required.
* Commercially astute, technically capable, and credible in banking conversations with both business and technology stakeholders.

Skills

* Operational discipline and a data driven approach to managing a client portfolio.
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices, support tooling such as Jira Service Management or ServiceNow, and customer success platforms such as Gainsight or equivalent.
* Technical enough to engage with Engineering on root causes across APIs, cloud platforms and mobile applications.
* Genuine interest in using AI and automation to improve support and customer success at scale.
* Strong understanding of banking operations, banking products and the realities of running software in regulated financial institutions.
* Clear, confident communicator in writing and in person.
* Fluent English. French or Arabic is an advantage.

Education

* Degree in business, engineering, computer science or a related field. ITIL or customer success certification is a plus.

Title: Digital Product Manager

* Demonstrate innovation and solutioning using Customer experience mapping and technical engineering knowledge.
* Oversee AI and digital product development, driving continuous improvement based on customer feedback.
* Coordinate activities, including virtual collaboration, to achieve business objectives.
* Adhere to technology governance policies and processes.

#### **Performance Management**

* Establish and follow-up on digital delivery performance indicators aligned with IKEA's business KPIs.

* Strong communication skills with business and technical stakeholders.

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in digital product development.
* Proven experience in Product Owner or similar roles related to AI products.

Title: Senior Delivery Manager
Description:
Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.  
We've earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

**Position Overview**

As a Senior Delivery Manager, you are the senior delivery authority on a cross-functional engagement: owning execution from kickoff through release, leading distributed onshore-and-offshore teams, and serving as the primary delivery partner to the client. You bring the judgment to navigate ambiguity, the discipline to keep complex programs on track, and the instinct to make every engagement a foundation for the next one.

  

**Why This Role Matters**

Senior Delivery Managers are where Robots and Pencils' promise of "production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days" actually has to hold. On the engagements you run, you set the pace of delivery, the discipline behind it, and the trust that decides whether the client comes back for more. The work moves only as fast as someone is willing to own the plan, surface trade-offs early, and keep distributed teams pulling in the same direction.

**What** **You'll** **Do**

**Craft & Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-phase engagements, ensuring alignment across scope, budget, timeline, and quality to meet delivery commitments and achieve successful outcomes

* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, and delivery execution across one or more cross-functional teams

* Manage phased releases, production readiness, and transitions into operations and maintenance models

* Identify and proactively manage dependencies, risks, scope changes, and escalations before they become blockers

* Define, track, and report delivery KPIs, using data to guide decisions, manage delivery health, and inform tradeoffs across scope, timeline, and budget

* Support QA and UAT efforts, ensuring quality is validated and outcomes meet agreed acceptance criteria

* Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and stakeholder communications

**Collaboration & Communication**

* Serve as the primary delivery contact for clients, building trusted relationships through transparency, consistency, and clear communication while identifying opportunities to expand value within the engagement

* Lead stakeholder working sessions, roadmap alignment discussions, and delivery forums with confidence

* Communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to executive and non-technical audiences

* Partner with Client Partners to spot expansion opportunities inside the engagement (scope, follow-on work, new use cases) and help shape the case for what's next

* Translate delivery progress into business impact for client stakeholders (ROI, milestones, decisions) so executives see ongoing value, not just status

**Leadership & Influence**

* Lead distributed delivery teams across onshore and offshore locations, fostering accountability, collaboration, and delivery excellence

* Coach junior delivery managers with concrete feedback and stretch opportunities, contributing to their development plans

* Foster a culture of transparency, continuous improvement, and high performance across the engagement

* Contribute to improving delivery practices, tools, and frameworks across engagements

* Assess team strengths and gaps on your engagements, and partner with Client Partners to flag staffing needs and high-potential talent for the firm

* Conduct executive interviews for engineers, designers, and other roles joining your engagements, and serve as an essential voice in go/no-go hiring decisions across the firm

  

**What** **You'll** **Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in software delivery, technical project management, or engineering leadership

* Strong understanding of agile delivery practices across complex, multi-team engagements (e.g., Scrum, SAFe, Kanban)

* Experience managing distributed teams across onshore and offshore locations

* Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-platform digital systems in agile environments

* Strong client-facing communication and relationship management skills

* Experience with delivery tooling (e.g., Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines)

* Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and AI-enabled platforms

* Demonstrable usage of AI tools to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and documentation (e.g., Claude)

* PMP, Scrum Master, SAFe, or equivalent certification preferred

* Experience in regulated environments (e.g., utilities, government, finance) is a plus

* Instinct for spotting where an engagement can grow, and the credibility with clients to bring those conversations forward with Client Partners

  

**Helpful Extras and Unique Skills**

* Vertical depth in one or more of Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing

* Experience delivering agentic, AI co-worker, or applied-AI initiatives in enterprise

* Prior career experience in client-facing roles (engagement management, consulting, account leadership) that informs growth conversations

**You'll** **Do Well Here if You Are**

* **A doer.** You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.

* **A fast learner who knows you don't know everything.** The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.

* **Direct in a way that makes the work better.** You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.

* **Obsessed with craft.** You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.

* **Built for ownership.** You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.

* **All in.** You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.

* **Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight.** Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.

* **Calm when it gets hot.** When scope, timeline, and stakeholders pull in three directions, you slow the room down enough to make the right call. You'd rather raise the hard trade-off in week two than absorb it in week eight.

* **Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do.** Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

This range may be modified in the future. An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. Description:
**It’s not a package. It’s a promise®.**
As Canada’s leading integrated freight, package, and logistics provider, we’ve been helping promises get where they need to be for more than 60 years. How does the magic happen?
**The journey starts with you**

**it’s all possible because of our people.**
So, whether you’re looking to build new skills, make an impact in your community, or inspire your team,
**we go there**
for you.
  
  
**Description**
Purolator relies on a broad portfolio of production applications to support employees, customers, terminals, transportation, and business operations. We are seeking a technology manager to lead the team accountable for application support, reliability, lifecycle management, and enhancements across these services.
  
  
This role will strengthen the operating model for production support by ensuring that projects, support queues, knowledge, monitoring, incidents, vulnerabilities, maintenance, and improvement work are managed with discipline. The successful candidate will combine strong leadership with technical judgement to deliver on new functionality and projects, improve service health, reduce repeat issues, and make support work visible and sustainable.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop application support employees, contractors, and vendor resources across onshore and offshore locations.
* Own service health and support outcomes for assigned production applications, including availability, performance, security, supportability, and lifecycle risk.
* Establish clear queue ownership, triage standards, priorities, service targets, escalation paths, and workload reporting across incidents, requests, problems, defects, and enhancements.
* Ensure knowledge base articles, runbooks, support procedures, dependency maps, recovery steps, and escalation contacts are accurate, current, usable, and reviewed on a defined cadence.
* Drive strong incident and problem management practices, including major incident leadership, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, trend analysis, and prevention of repeat failures.
* Embed SRE practices such as service-level indicators and objectives, actionable monitoring, alert quality, capacity planning, error budgets, automation, resilience testing, and toil reduction.
* Partner with development teams to improve production readiness, operational acceptance, handoffs, release quality, deployment safety, and early-life support.
* Plan and deliver small enhancements, defect corrections, automation, maintenance, and technical-debt work without compromising operational support.
* Own application security hygiene, including vulnerability intake, CVE assessment, remediation planning, patch coordination, exception tracking, and executive reporting.
* Maintain lifecycle and technical-risk registers covering unsupported components, aging platforms, expiring certificates, capacity concerns, critical dependencies, and recovery gaps.
* Use ServiceNow, Jira, dashboards, and other systems of record to provide accurate visibility into work, aging, service performance, backlog health, and risk.
* Partner with Service Desk, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Cloud, Architecture, Product, Development, and business teams to resolve issues and improve end-to-end service ownership.
* Manage vendor service levels, statements of work, deliverables, escalations, invoices, budgets, contracts, and resource plans.
* Monitor and report AWS consumption, forecasts, optimization opportunities, and financial risks for supported applications.
* Set team goals, complete performance reviews, provide regular feedback, and support career development and succession planning.
* Provide concise reporting to the Director on service health, incidents, backlog, reliability, vulnerabilities, financials, people, risks, and decisions required.

**Additional Responsibilities**
Leadership expectations
  
  
You will create clarity, set measurable expectations, coach with candour, and build an inclusive team culture. You will balance delivery speed with security, reliability, cost, and long-term maintainability, while providing the Director with timely visibility into outcomes, risks, dependencies, capacity, vendor performance, and financials.
  
  
Operating model focus
  
  

* Clear ownership from intake through resolution, prevention, and knowledge capture
* Reliable queues, service targets, escalation paths, and stakeholder communications
* Measurable service health using logs, metrics, traces, synthetic checks, dashboards, and business signals
* Disciplined vulnerability, patch, certificate, dependency, and application lifecycle management
* A balanced backlog across incidents, defects, small enhancements, automation, reliability, security, and technical debt

**Education**

* Post-secondary diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* SRE, ITIL, DevOps, cloud, cybersecurity, architecture, or agile delivery certification are assets.

**Experience**

* Progressive experience in application support, production operations, software engineering, SRE, DevOps, or service management, including several years leading technical teams.
* Strong technical understanding of enterprise applications, APIs, integrations, databases, cloud services, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and common failure modes.
* Demonstrated success improving incident, problem, change, knowledge, monitoring, and vulnerability-management practices.
* Experience managing operational queues, support metrics, service targets, backlogs, small enhancements, and technical-debt priorities.
* Ability to use data to identify service trends, explain risk, prioritize investments, and hold teams and vendors accountable.
* Experience managing mixed employee, contractor, and vendor teams across locations and time zones.
* Strong financial, vendor, stakeholder, and executive-reporting skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with a calm and structured approach during incidents and escalations.
* Experience supporting logistics, transportation, mobile, customer-facing, or 24x7 operational applications.
* Hands-on exposure to AWS, observability platforms, ServiceNow, Jira, GitHub, CI/CD tooling, and automated testing.
* Experience transitioning services from project delivery into stable production ownership.

Proficiency in English is required for this position due to the frequent communications that must be conducted in English with various stakeholders. This requirement is justified by the nature of the responsibilities and operational needs.

Title: Senior Manager - IT/OT Network Security - AA9
Senior Manager - IT/OT Network Security - AA9
Description:
Act as the single point of contact between District ICT Operations and Corporate IT for all IT/OT network and security matters. The role manages the relationship, coordinates incidents, escalations, changes and requests, and keeps both parties aligned.

**Key competencies**

* Managing cross-organizational relationships and building trust with Corporate IT leadership
* Calm, structured coordination during incidents and escalations
* Clear communication of technical issues, impacts and decisions to mixed audiences
* Influence and negotiation without direct authority
* Disciplined tracking, follow-through and governance reporting

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Single point of contact:** Serve as the primary interface with Corporate IT for all IT/OT network and security issues, requests and dependencies.
* **Incident and escalation coordination:** Coordinate incidents involving Corporate IT, including major incidents. Drive timely engagement, clear ownership and resolution, and manage escalations through agreed paths.
* **Change and dependency coordination:** Make sure District ICT changes, projects and design reviews that affect Corporate IT networks or security are raised, coordinated and approved through the right Corporate IT channels.
* **Security and access requests**: Coordinate firewall rules, connectivity, access and security requests with Corporate IT, and track them through to completion.
* **Engagement model:** Define and maintain the operating interface with Corporate IT: contacts, escalation matrix, OLAs, meeting cadence and responsibilities.
* **Governance and reporting:** Run regular service reviews with Corporate IT. Report on open issues, risks, dependencies and performance to the Associate Director.

  
  
**Requirements**

**Interactions/ Engagement**

* Corporate IT network, security and operations teams: Primary counterpart for all IT/OT matters
* Associate Director and District ICT leadership: Escalations, risks and governance reporting
* Major incident, change and L1.5 teams: Incident coordination and change alignment
* Design assurance, project and operational readiness teams: Corporate IT dependencies and approvals
* Vendors and MSPs: Issues that cross Corporate IT boundaries

**Key Technical Skills**

* 10+ years in IT or OT operations, including 4+ years in service or relationship management.
* Sound understanding of IT/OT network segmentation, connectivity and cybersecurity principles.
* Strong grasp of ITIL 4 incident, change and escalation management practices.
* Experience working with OLAs, escalation matrices and governance in multi-party environments.
* ITIL 4, CCNP or equivalent required; a cybersecurity awareness certification (e.g. CompTIA Security+) desirable.

Title: Director of Technology
Description:
We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this link directly: https://jobs.lighthousehiring.ai/aquila/2f05e71a-7b74-4a34-931e-675296556ded/1d820545-5942-4eb3-9dfd-604577511d1d?source=direct

**Who we are**

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

**About GoldCare**

GoldCare, a Gemini Group company within Aquila, develops specialized healthcare management software for community-based healthcare and long-term care organizations. Part of Constellation Software since 2014, GoldCare has built long-standing relationships with healthcare providers who rely on its technology to simplify their operations, improve efficiency, and focus less on paperwork and more on people.

**Who we need**

Reporting to the General Manager, we are hiring a Director of Technology to shape the next phase of GoldCare’s technology and product evolution. In this newly created role, you will define and execute our technology strategy, lead the modernization of our healthcare software platform, and establish the architecture, engineering practices, and technical capabilities that will support our future growth. Combining strategic leadership with hands-on technical involvement, you will lead our distributed Development and Quality Assurance teams, balancing the needs of our existing products and customers with the development of more modern technology solutions. You will work closely with Product Management to align technology strategy with product priorities and customer needs, playing a central role in how we build software, introduce new technologies, and evolve as a software business.

*This is a fully remote role based anywhere in Canada, with working hours aligned to Eastern Time.*

**What’s in it for you**

*Modernize technology that makes a difference*. You will join an established healthcare software business at a pivotal point in its evolution. You will have the opportunity to shape the future of our platform, modernizing business-critical software and exploring how emerging technologies can enhance its capabilities. What makes this opportunity particularly meaningful is the impact of your work beyond the technology itself. The decisions you make and the solutions you build will help community-based healthcare and long-term care organizations operate more effectively, reduce administrative burdens, and dedicate more time to the people in their care.

*The freedom to lead, build, and influence*. You want to remain close to technology without sacrificing the breadth and influence of a senior leadership role. Working directly with the General Manager, you will have the autonomy to challenge existing thinking, make architectural decisions, influence technology investments, and turn your ideas into reality. You will build on the knowledge and experience of an established team while introducing modern engineering practices, encouraging experimentation with AI and emerging technologies, and developing technical leaders. This is an opportunity to leave a lasting impact not only on what we build but on how we think, collaborate, and innovate as a technology organization.

*Broader exposure and career growth*. You will benefit from the autonomy of an entrepreneurial software business, backed by the stability, collective knowledge, and resources of Aquila and the broader Constellation Software network. You will have opportunities to exchange ideas with technology leaders navigating similar transformations, gain exposure to different software businesses, and learn from diverse approaches to innovation. As you shape GoldCare’s technology future, you will deepen your commercial understanding, expand your leadership capabilities, and position yourself for broader technology leadership opportunities over time.

**As our new Director, Technology, you will**

* **Own the technology roadmap.** You will establish a clear technology vision and translate it into a multi-year roadmap with defined priorities, investments, milestones, and measurable outcomes. You will balance modernization, technical debt, customer commitments, and platform stability, taking ownership of moving initiatives from concept through implementation and delivery.
* **Partner with Product Management**. You will work collaboratively with the Product Management team to shape the product roadmap, align technology investments with product priorities, and translate customer needs into scalable, practical software solutions. Together, you will evaluate opportunities, navigate technical and commercial trade-offs, and balance platform modernization with the delivery of new features and enhancements that create meaningful value for our customers.
* **Lead platform modernization.** You will assess our existing architecture, challenge technical assumptions, and explore alternative approaches to determine the best direction for our software. You will own architectural and technology stack decisions, guiding the evolution of our application architecture, APIs, integrations, data platforms, and cloud services. Working alongside our technical teams, you will actively participate in designing, developing, and validating solutions that strengthen the scalability, maintainability, and reliability of our platform.
* **Transform how we build software.** You will work alongside our distributed teams to develop, test, and deliver software. You will establish DevOps capabilities and take a hands-on approach to introducing and advancing CI/CD, automated testing, and Agile development practices. You will help the team move beyond reactive problem-solving, address the root causes of recurring challenges, and drive measurable improvements in software quality, productivity, and delivery.
* **Turn innovation into impact.** You will proactively explore how AI, automation, and emerging technologies can enhance our products and improve how we work. You will assess technical feasibility and business value, experiment with new technologies, build prototypes, and work alongside the team to translate promising ideas into practical solutions that benefit our business and customers.
* **Strengthen security and reliability.** You will guide decisions across cloud infrastructure, hosting, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and platform resilience. You will reduce technology risk, strengthen operational controls, and advance security and compliance readiness, including SOC 2-related requirements.
* **Build and empower technical teams.** You will lead our distributed Development and Quality Assurance teams, develop technical leaders, strengthen accountability, and address capability gaps. You will lead by example, sharing your technical expertise, demonstrating new approaches, and working alongside the team to solve complex problems. You will create an environment where people are encouraged to challenge assumptions, experiment, make informed decisions, and take ownership of solutions.
* **Connect technology to business priorities.** You will act as a trusted technology partner to the General Manager, proactively bringing forward ideas, recommendations, and opportunities to advance the business. You will articulate the commercial implications of technology decisions, communicate risks and trade-offs, and influence where we invest. You will also collaborate with technology leaders across the broader organization to exchange expertise, share learnings, and explore new approaches.

**You bring**

* **The technology leadership experience.** You have progressed through software engineering or architecture into senior technology leadership within an enterprise software business. You have led technical teams and managers, with accountability for technology strategy, investment decisions, engineering performance, and business outcomes. You know how to establish a technology vision, build support for it, and take an active role in bringing it to life.
* **The platform modernization expertise.** You have led the modernization of complex, business-critical software, navigating legacy architecture, technical debt, and existing customer commitments. You are comfortable challenging established architectural approaches, exploring alternatives, and making technology stack decisions with long-term implications. Your experience extends beyond defining the strategy to actively contributing to the design and implementation of technical solutions.
* **The hands-on technical depth**. You bring broad expertise across enterprise architecture, application development, APIs, integrations, data platforms, and cloud environments, complemented by an understanding of infrastructure, cybersecurity, and disaster recovery. Your expertise is not confined to a single technology stack, and you have intentionally remained close to the technology as your leadership responsibilities have grown. You are comfortable moving between strategic discussions, architectural design, coding, prototyping, and working alongside developers to solve complex technical problems.
* **The curiosity and drive to innovate.** You are genuinely curious about technology and how it can be applied to solve business and customer challenges. You have hands-on experience introducing modern engineering practices, establishing DevOps capabilities, and advancing CI/CD and automated testing to improve how software is built and delivered. You actively explore new approaches, experiment with emerging technologies, including AI and automation, and know how to translate promising ideas into practical solutions.
* **The business acumen.** You understand the commercial implications of technology decisions and can balance customer needs, financial priorities, operational demands, and long-term growth. You can evaluate investments, articulate complex technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences, and build alignment with senior leaders. You look beyond immediate challenges to understand their root causes, proactively bringing forward recommendations and taking ownership of seeing them through.
* **The ability to lead through change.** You have developed technical leaders, strengthened accountability, and built collaboration across distributed teams. You earn credibility through your technical expertise and willingness to work alongside others, demonstrating new approaches rather than simply directing change. You know how to bring people with you, respectfully challenge established thinking, and create an environment where people are encouraged to experiment, learn, and take ownership of solutions.

**Why join?**

GoldCare and Aquila are part of Constellation Software Inc., one of Canada's largest and most successful software companies and its most successful technology stock over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fibre, you will thrive at Aquila.

**Compensation**

At GoldCare and Aquila, we believe compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of both experience and impact. The salary range for this role is CAD $150,000 to $200,000 plus bonus.

Compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the scope and complexity of the role. We value open conversations about compensation and are happy to discuss our approach at any stage of the hiring process.

**Apply now.**

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have most of the qualifications we are seeking, and want to play an integral role in our success, apply to express your interest.

**About us:**

  

The University of Toronto is consistently ranked among the world’s leading research institutions, recognized for its commitment to innovation, academic excellence, and global impact. Team members benefit from a supportive and inclusive workplace that promotes professional growth and offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative projects that shape the future of student services at one of Canada’s most prestigious universities.

  

**Your opportunity:**

  

Reporting to the Manager, Academic Governance & Planning Systems, the Test & Deployment Lead will lead the development and adoption of an integrated quality engineering, test automation and application deployment practice across the University’s Student Information Systems (SIS) teams.  
  
The SIS portfolio collaborates with cross-functional teams, including developers, analysts, designers, and stakeholders, to support and enhance the University’s custom-built Student Information System, a foundational legacy platform that underpins key academic and administrative functions. In addition to maintaining and evolving existing systems, this role will play a central part in a major IT transformation initiative focused on modernizing the student information ecosystem. This is an exceptional opportunity to contribute to high-impact, mission-critical projects in a technically challenging and rewarding environment, while helping to shape the digital future of the University of Toronto.  
  
The role sets shared expectations, builds organizational capability and drives improvements in how applications are tested, integrated, released and supported across complex enterprise services.

  

You will partner with Agile Delivery Leads, Senior Full Stack Developers, application Technical Leads and central ITS platform and operations partners to embed quality throughout Agile delivery.  
  
You will guide and coach people across teams and influence delivery standards without assuming ownership of product backlogs, application architecture or central infrastructure platforms. The role combines strong technical judgment with people leadership, stakeholder influence and organizational change management.

  

**Your responsibilities will include:**

  

* Lead the SIS-wide quality engineering and application release practice: establish a multi-year improvement direction, practical standards, adoption roadmap and shared expectations for testing, CI/CD, release readiness and operational handover across teams.
* Coach and develop team members to build QA, test automation and deployment capability across developers, testers and delivery teams through mentoring, communities of practice, training and knowledge transfer.
* Champion whole-team quality within Agile delivery, working with Agile Delivery Leads to embed testability, acceptance criteria, automation, continuous feedback and release readiness into planning, refinement, reviews and retrospectives.
* Lead adoption and ongoing improvement ofapplication CI/CD practices, including build and test automation, versioned artifacts, environment promotion, approvals, traceability, deployment verification, rollback or forward-fix planning and integration with central ITS controls
* Establish risk-based quality approaches spanning API and contract testing, integration, regression, end-to-end, performance, concurrency, resilience and accessibility/security validation with accountable specialist teams.
* Partner with Senior Full Stack Developers and application Technical Leads on release and quality patterns for existing systems and modern domain services, APIs, asynchronous integrations and independently deployable applications; enable teams rather than taking over software architecture orcoding.
* Guide cross-team release coordination and quality dependencies for enterprise-scale changes, working alongside Agile Delivery Leads responsible for backlogs, team cadence and overall delivery plans.
* Set measurable quality and delivery outcomes; establish baselines and monitor escaped defects, automation reliability, deployment lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, recovery time and improvement in release predictability.
* Lead root-cause reviews and continuous improvement initiatives, using test outcomes, incidents, deployment evidence and team feedback to identify systemic issues and prioritize practical corrective actions.
* Build relationships and influence adoption across SIS, central DevOps, infrastructure, operations, cybersecurity, privacy, accessibility and business groups; resolve conflicts constructively and communicate trade-offs, risks, progress and options to leadership.
* Assess tools, improvement initiatives and resource needs; provide implementation options, cost/benefit and risk analysis, realistic estimates and phased recommendations that fit University constraints.

  

**Essential Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related discipline, or an acceptable combination of equivalent education and experience.
* Eight plus years (8+) of progressively responsible experience supporting the delivery, quality assurance, testing or deployment of complex enterprise software applications, including demonstrated leadership of modernization or practice-improvement initiatives.
* Three plus years (3+) of demonstrated people leadership and/or sustained functional leadership of multidisciplinary technology teams, with proven experience coaching, developing skills, setting expectations and influencing performance across teams.
* Proven success contributing to the end-to-end delivery or modernization of enterprise-scale technology platforms, including quality planning, integration and release readiness, deployment coordination, operational handover and delivery risk management.
* Demonstrated experience leading quality engineering, release-readiness or deployment improvement activities within Agile software delivery teams, collaborating with developers, testers, product stakeholders and Agile Delivery Leads through iterative planning and feedback cycles.
* Strong working knowledge of Agile frameworks and practices, such as Scrum and Kanban, and practical experience embedding quality engineering and release activities within Agile development and DevOps workflows without assuming the role of Scrum Master or Agile Delivery Lead.
* Demonstrated experience leading the implementation, adoption or substantial improvement of application CI/CD pipelines and release engineering practices, including automated build/test quality gates, controlled promotion, traceability and release verification; hands-on pipeline programming expertise is not mandatory.
* Demonstrated experience establishing or directing enterprise testing strategies and automated quality practices, including API/integration and regression testing, risk-based test coverage, defect management and release acceptance criteria.
* Proven ability to design and drive changes to standards, processes and ways of working across multiple application teams, including stakeholder consultation, change management, coaching, overcoming resistance and measuring sustained adoption.
* Experience defining and applying quality and delivery metrics to improve outcomes, such as automated test reliability, escaped defects, deployment lead time, change failure rate, deployment frequency, recovery time and release predictability.
* Practical understanding of source control, build and test automation, CI/CD workflows, environment promotion and enterprise release controls, with sufficient technical depth to evaluate approaches, review evidence and guide implementation specialists and developers.
* Working knowledge of API-based and integrated enterprise architectures and the testing, compatibility, data integrity and deployment dependencies that arise across interconnected and independently evolving applications.
* Excellent collaboration, communication, organizational and judgment skills, with demonstrated ability to influence diverse technical and nontechnical stakeholders, address competing priorities and deliver improvements without relying on direct reporting authority.

**Assets (Nonessential):**

  

* Experience helping organizations evolve toward composable, headless, domain-service,microservices or event-driven platforms, or modernizing legacy and mainframe-connected systems.
* Experience delivering high-volume transactional or student information services, including the constraints of major business-critical operational periods.
* Familiarity with cloud and containerized application delivery, Azure, enterprise deployment tooling, service contract testing, privacy-safe test data and automated security/accessibility checks
* Experience establishing QA communities of practice, skills development programs or organizational quality maturity assessments.
* Relevant training or certifications in Agile, quality engineering, DevOps, IT service management, organizational change or people leadership.

**To be successful in this role you will be:**

  

* A collaborative leader and capable coach
* A change champion who builds commitment across teams
* Pragmatic, evidence-driven and focused on measurable outcomes
* Skilled at balancing quality, delivery speed and operational risk
* An effective communicator and trusted partner
* Adaptable, self-directed and committed to continuous improvement

Title: Director – Landscape, Green Spaces and Parks
Description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
At Jacobs, we push the limits of what is possible to make the world smarter and more connected. We are seeking a Director – Landscape, Green Spaces and Parks to join our City Operations team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, overseeing the operational delivery, maintenance and continuous improvement of a major landscape, green spaces and parks portfolio.
  
  
**About The Opportunity**
Lead the operational management of a large-scale portfolio of urban landscapes, green spaces, destination parks and public realm assets within a major city development in Riyadh.
  
  
This is a senior operations and maintenance leadership role responsible for translating departmental strategy into effective service plans, planned maintenance programmes and measurable performance outcomes. You will ensure that parks, landscaped areas and public spaces remain safe, accessible, attractive, sustainable and operationally ready for residents and visitors.
  
  
Working closely with in-house teams, specialist service providers, contractors, utilities, events teams and other City Operations stakeholders, you will oversee horticultural maintenance, irrigation performance, public realm presentation, contractor delivery, asset condition, operating budgets and lifecycle planning.
  
  
You will also support the operational readiness and handover of new landscape and parks assets, ensuring that designs are maintainable, asset information is complete and appropriate maintenance arrangements are in place before operational acceptance.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Translate departmental strategy into annual operating plans, service standards, planned maintenance programmes and measurable performance targets for the assigned landscape and parks portfolio.
* Lead the operation and maintenance of trees, palms, shrubs, groundcover, lawns and seasonal planting, including soil improvement, pruning, plant nutrition, integrated pest management and plant replacement.
* Manage irrigation systems within the agreed asset boundary, including controllers, distribution networks and associated equipment, optimising performance based on plant demand, weather and soil conditions.
* Monitor water consumption, irrigation leaks and system performance, coordinating treated sewage effluent supply and water-quality interfaces with Utilities and other responsible stakeholders.
* Direct in-house teams, contractors and specialist service providers against agreed scopes, service levels and performance indicators, addressing service failures and driving corrective action.
* Maintain the presentation, safety and functionality of parks and public spaces, coordinating the inspection and maintenance of paths, hardscape, furniture, play and recreational assets, lighting, cleaning, waste and security services.
* Lead condition inspections and risk-based maintenance prioritisation, ensuring that tree defects, irrigation failures, damaged public assets and other hazards are made safe and resolved through approved procedures.
* Prepare and manage operating budgets, resource plans and lifecycle renewal forecasts, monitoring expenditure and identifying efficiencies without compromising safety, service quality or asset condition.
* Review landscape and public realm designs for maintainability, safe access, planting suitability, water efficiency, operational practicality and whole-life cost.
* Support commissioning and asset handover reviews, verifying asset registers, as-built information, maintenance manuals, warranties, training records and defect closure before recommending operational acceptance.
* Develop technical scopes, specifications, maintenance frequencies and commercial inputs for procurement, supporting tender evaluations, contractor mobilisation, performance verification and payment recommendations.
* Maintain accurate asset, condition and work-order information within the approved maintenance management system, using performance, failure and cost data to support renewal programmes and service improvements.
* Plan seasonal and event-related service enhancements, landscape protection and reinstatement activities, including contingency arrangements for water interruptions, extreme weather and major plant loss.
* Implement sustainability initiatives covering climate-appropriate planting, biodiversity, soil health, water conservation and green-waste recovery, tracking results against agreed targets.
* Provide clear reporting on landscape condition, plant health, water consumption, contractor performance, operational readiness, budgets, lifecycle requirements and material risks.
* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team, establishing clear responsibilities, capability requirements, training plans and a culture of accountability and service excellence.

Title: Product Manager I
Description:
Take a step forward and let Edenred surprise you.

Every day, we deliver innovative solutions to improve the life of millions of people, connecting employees, companies, and merchants all around the world.

We know there are hundred ways for you to grow. With us, you will expand your skills in a multicultural, challenging, and dynamic environment.

**Dare to join Edenred and get ready to thrive in a global company that will offer you endless opportunities.**

Edenred is all about meritocracy. You come as you are, and you contribute. Indeed, the Edenred Group recognizes, recruits and develops all talents and singularities.

We are committed to preventing all forms of discrimination and to providing all our candidates with equal opportunities regardless of their gender and gender expression, disability, origin, religious belief and sexual orientation or any other criteria.

**About Edenred**

Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.

Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.

Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.

True to the Group's purpose, “Enrich connections. For good.”, these solutions enhance users' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.

Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.

In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.

Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.

  

**The UAE CONTEXT**

Edenred UAE is a fast-growing payroll service provider serving more than 20,000 businesses and more than 2.2 million unbanked employees. We service over 10 banks and 35 financial institutions.

We offer a unique value proposition for companies to manage their payroll, and for employees to receive their salaries and use them in the simplest way — through multiple value-added services in our mobile app (money transfer, mobile recharge, card services and more).

  

**THE ROLE**

Most of our users receive their salary on a card we issue, send money home through our app, and pay for their week with a product our team built. For a large share of them, we are their first and only financial relationship. That raises the stakes on every decision — and makes this one of the more interesting product jobs in the region.

You will own product strategy and delivery for a product area inside an organisation that has the autonomy of a startup and the reach of a multinational. You set direction for your area, shape its strategy, and make day-to-day calls that are demonstrably aligned to a clear product vision — with the coaching and air cover to get it right.

Depending on where the business needs you most, you might begin in financial crime and compliance — making onboarding fast without weakening controls, catching fraud earlier, turning regulatory requirements into changes engineering can actually build. Or you might begin on the consumer side — remittance, cards, wallet, lending — working acquisition, activation, retention and monetisation problems for 2.2 million people.

The PMs who do best here are the ones who can hold a regulatory constraint and a growth funnel in their head at the same time.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own a product area. Identify the levers and problems that matter, build a now / next / later roadmap you can defend against real resource constraints, and treat company resources as your own.

* Set and evangelise a vision. Make sure your decisions and your squad's decisions stay aligned to it, and that everyone can explain the “why” without you in the room.

* Lead discovery. Decide independently what to ask and who to ask, know when research is and isn't needed, and turn what you learn into decisions rather than decks.

* De-risk deliberately. Define the riskiest assumptions behind an initiative, prioritise them, and pick the right test for each — balancing speed against certainty instead of defaulting to trial and error.

* Use data properly. Judge which metrics matter, read experiment results honestly, and make confident scale-or-pivot calls. You self-serve across Excel, CleverTap and SQL.

* Ship with engineering. Write crisp PRDs, mitigate feasibility risk early, hold the bar on specifications, and clear blockers before they bite.

* Drive outcomes, not output. Take initiatives, objectives and key results to completion on time, and be honest about what moved and what didn't.

* Work the room. Frame ambiguous problems, facilitate strong problem-solving discussions, manage stakeholder expectations, and pull in senior leaders when that's what unblocks the outcome.

* Communicate top-down. Present a cohesive narrative to data, design, engineering and senior business audiences, and make the trade-offs legible.

Stay close to a unique customer. Our users are underbanked, often first-time app users, sending money to families across several corridors. Every decision comes back to what they're trying to achieve.  

  

**YOUR PROFILE**

* 3+ years in product management - with a track record of independently owning a product or product area and shipping.

* Evidence you moved the numbers - KPIs and OKRs that mattered, not just features that launched.

* Range - Comfort operating in a regulated environment and appetite for consumer growth problems. Experience in payments, fintech, fraud, compliance or high-scale consumer products is a plus, not a requirement.

* Strong analytical instincts - You can set sensible thresholds, spot risk in data, size an opportunity, and check whether something is actually working.

* Technical fluency - Enough to discuss APIs, automation and trade-offs with engineers and be taken seriously.

* Excellent organisation, judgment and attention to detail - you can operate without direction.

* Communication and influence - You drive consensus, articulate recommendations and trade-offs to senior executives, and write specs engineers can build from without guessing.

Beyond the craft, we care a lot about how you work:

* Ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, speak up when something looks wrong, and follow through on what you commit to.

* Collaboration — you listen actively, build trust across teams, and bring people along rather than pushing work over the wall.

* Problem solving — creative and structured, using both data and judgment to land on an answer.

* Drive — proactive and entrepreneurial; you clear your own obstacles and ask for help early when you're stuck.

* Curiosity — genuinely interested in users, and in how the product works under the hood.

Senior candidates will also be expected to coach and mentor junior product managers, review their work, and contribute to hiring.

Title: Senior Manager - QA & Site Co-ordination - AA9
Description:
Lead the independent quality assurance and site co-ordination function for City Ops ICT assets throughout the project lifecycle. Establish and operate consistent quality controls, stage-gate checkpoints, inspection and testing arrangements, and evidence-based validation of operational requirements before handover and service transition. Maintain objective oversight of gaps, defects and remediation, while keeping delivery accountability with the relevant project, contractor, vendor or asset owner. Set the strategic QA direction, lead the assurance team and provide senior management with independent recommendations on quality, readiness and residual risk.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Independent, evidence-based judgement and challenge of incomplete readiness evidence
* Senior leadership of QA/QC governance, quality strategy, risk prioritisation and structured issue escalation
* Clear stakeholder communication, cross-vendor co-ordination and executive, audit-ready reporting
* Ability to direct field verification teams and manage site access, safety and inspection logistics
* Portfolio-level prioritisation, resource planning, supplier performance oversight and continuous improvement
* QA Governance & Independence
* Own and maintain the City Ops ICT QA/QC and gap-assessment framework, including standards, workflows, evidence requirements, severity classification, validation, prioritisation, closure and reporting.
* Define QA checkpoints, sign-off criteria, Site Inspection Plans, asset-specific checklists, test scripts, hold / witness points and acceptance evidence standards.
* Provide independent assessment of operational readiness and quality, separate from project delivery accountability; challenge incomplete or disputed evidence and escalate material acceptance risks.
* Lead the QA team, including field / testing and domain verification resources, and apply consistent methods across sites and packages.
* Set portfolio QA priorities, allocate assurance resources and provide senior leadership with independent recommendations on systemic quality risks and readiness.

* Site Co-ordination, Inspection & Testing
* Plan and co-ordinate site access, inspections, permits, inductions, vendor attendance, equipment and documentation for site verification activities.
* Direct and quality-assure document reviews, physical inspections, interviews and functional testing performed by Field and Test Engineers.
* Co-ordinate physical and functional verification of ICT infrastructure and systems, including cabling / fibre, switches, equipment rooms, CCTV / VMS, access control, UPS and associated power arrangements.
* Ensure inspection records contain checklists, photos, test results, calibration and safety evidence, with a clear pass, gap or not-applicable outcome.
* Operational Readiness & Handover Assurance
* Translate approved service, support, monitoring, resilience, cybersecurity, lifecycle and non-functional requirements into measurable acceptance criteria.
* Validate readiness evidence, test and commissioning results, as-built and configuration records, asset information, licences, warranties, training, O&M documentation and support arrangements.
* Provide an evidence-based recommendation on handover readiness, documenting exceptions, residual risks, conditional acceptance and corrective actions; do not replace the authorised acceptance decision-maker.
* Confirm outstanding defects, vendor obligations and support information are transferred into the appropriate QTech ITSM / ServiceNow and operational governance processes.
* Issue Management, Reporting & Escalation
* Own and maintain the Master Gap Register, Defect / Snag Register and Remediation Tracker as controlled, traceable records.
* Validate findings for evidence sufficiency, severity, ownership and corrective action; track target dates and verify objective closure evidence.
* Escalate critical / high findings, disputed classifications, safety concerns and unresolved readiness risks through agreed governance channels.
* Prepare dashboards, executive summaries and decision-ready reporting on quality status, ageing, dependencies, closure trends and handover risks; lead root-cause reviews and continuous improvement.
* Stakeholder & Team Co-ordination
* Co-ordinate inspections, validation workshops and readiness reviews with City Ops ICT, QTech, MDU / EBU, Districts, Cybersecurity, vendors, contractors and service integrators.
* Provide leadership, work direction and coaching to field / test engineers and support consistent technical and audit-ready quality records.
* Hold delivery partners accountable for evidence quality and remediation commitments while preserving independent assurance boundaries.
* Seven Stage-Gate Quality Checkpoints
* CP1 - Understand Project Scope: Confirm asset / system scope, site constraints, applicable standards, stakeholders and QA approach.
* CP2 - Define City ICT Operations Requirements: Translate operational, service and non-functional requirements into measurable acceptance criteria.
* CP3 - Review Procurement Packages: Review RFPs, BoQs and specifications for inspection, testing, handover, support and evidence provisions.
* CP4 - Review Material Submissions: Review technical / material submissions, methods and test plans; flag deviations and lifecycle impacts.
* CP5 - Verify Delivered Requirements: Witness inspections and tests, validate as-built / configuration evidence and track defects to closure.
* CP6 - Support Handover Acceptance: Review handover packs and readiness evidence; recommend acceptance, exceptions and corrective actions.
* CP7 - Service Management Transition: Confirm quality records, support procedures and open obligations are transferred into operational governance.

  
  
**Requirements**

**Minimum Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electronics or a related discipline.

**Professional Certifications**

Preferred: PMP / PRINCE2, ITIL Foundation and ISO 9001 auditor or equivalent QA qualification; advantageous: Lean Six Sigma and relevant technical / testing certifications.

**Skills**

* ICT QA/QC governance, inspection / test planning, stage-gate assurance and evidence-based acceptance.
* Practical understanding of ICT infrastructure, smart-city and physical-security systems, commissioning, operational readiness and service transition.
* Defect and gap classification, root-cause analysis, remediation tracking, registers, dashboards and audit-ready reporting.
* Site safety, permit-to-work, field inspection co-ordination, cross-vendor dependencies and stakeholder management.
* Independent judgement, clear escalation, strong written reporting and the ability to challenge incomplete evidence constructively.
* Experience leading gap / defect registers, site inspection programmes, acceptance criteria and management reporting.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electronics or related discipline.
* Preferred: PMP / PRINCE2, ITIL Foundation and ISO 9001 auditor or equivalent QA qualification; advantageous: Lean Six Sigma and relevant technical / testing certifications.
