Title: Middle East Tech Business Manager
Description:
**About the role**
------------------

Founded by Gabrielle Chanel in 1910, CHANEL is a French luxury house renowned for its timeless elegance and innovation across Fashion, Fragrance & Beauty, and Watches & Fine Jewelry.

The Europe Region brings together several markets to distribute CHANEL’s creations and deliver the ultimate luxury experience to our clients.

Headquartered in Dubai, the Middle East Market covers nine countries: United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Lebanon, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Bahrain, Kuwait, Egypt and Jordan.

We are looking for a Middle East Tech Business Manager to support both the operational excellence and continued technology transformation of the Market.

Reporting to the Head of Digital and Tech, the Middle East Tech Business Manager acts as **a Tech business partner for the Middle East Market, connecting local business priorities with the Europe Tech Roadmap.**

The role is responsible for ensuring the reliable, secure and effective delivery of IT infrastructure and technology services across the Market's business environments, including boutiques, wholesale operations, the distribution center and headquarters.

These services include end-user equipment, connectivity, servers, retail systems, meeting rooms, video-conferencing solutions and digital workplace technologies.

The Tech Business Manager leads a team of four people, one internal employee and three external resources. He/she is responsible for organizing, developing and evolving the team and its capabilities in line with changing business and technology needs, while managing the Tech budget, procurement activities, vendors and partners and ensuring a high level of service and delivery.

**What impact you can create at CHANEL**
----------------------------------------

Beyond operational excellence, the Tech Business Manager partners closely with Retail, business functions and Digital & Data teams to enable technology-driven transformation across the Market. The role contributes to Retail and business projects, identifies opportunities where technology can address business challenges, and supports the deployment and adoption of new technologies, including emerging AI capabilities.

As an ambassador for the Tech department, the Tech Business Manager ensures that the house technology strategies and standards are translated into relevant and effective solutions for the Middle East, while bringing local business needs and opportunities back into Europe Tech roadmaps.

**As an ambassador for the Tech department, act as a trusted Tech partner to the Middle East business, developing a strong understanding of business and Retail priorities, challenges and opportunities.**

Maintain close proximity to the business and Retail teams by regularly visiting boutiques and other sites, understanding user journeys and technology-related pain points, and proactively identifying opportunities for improvement.

Monitor user satisfaction with Tech services provided, identify areas for improvement and recommend appropriate actions.

Translate local business needs into clear technology requirements and use cases, **connecting the relevant local and Europe teams and contributing to the evolution of technology roadmaps.**

Proactively identify opportunities to simplify, automate and improve Tech services, enhancing both operational efficiency and employee experience. Ensure appropriate business continuity and resilience of critical Market technology services.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Operational Excellence / Run**

Enable local teams to work effectively by providing reliable devices, including tills, printers, laptops and mobile phones, infrastructure including network equipment and servers, and standard applications across boutiques, offices and other physical locations.

Ensure contractors and partners deliver high-quality Tech support and meet agreed Service Level Agreements.

Secure and continuously optimize Tech infrastructure and support operations across boutiques and wholesale businesses for all CHANEL divisions, Fashion, Fragrance & Beauty and Watches & Fine Jewelry, as well as Corporate functions including HR and Finance.

### **Accompany the Tech Transformation**

Contribute and maintain the Middle East Tech roadmap and project portfolio, including budget, and demands prioritization with Europe Region and Middle East business teams.

Oversee the local implementation of Tech applications and services within the Market, ensuring local requirements are understood and addressed.

Partner with Retail and business teams on technology-enabled transformation initiatives, helping translate business needs into technology solutions and ensuring their technical feasibility, integration and successful implementation.

Contribute to the exploration and implementation of new technologies that can enhance client, employee and business experiences, working closely with Digital, Data and Europe Tech teams.

Contribute to real-estate projects, primarily boutique openings and renovations, as well as office and logistics projects. Oversee the implementation of technology components, including hardware and software installation and validation, and manage suppliers and subcontractors in close coordination with Regional and Global teams.

### **AI & Emerging Technologies**

Act as the local Tech partner for AI and emerging technology adoption, working closely with Digital, Data, business teams and Europe Tech.

Contribute to AI acculturation across the Market by helping teams understand available capabilities, opportunities, boundaries and responsible usage.

Partner with Business & Digital teams to identify and assess relevant AI and technology use cases, supporting experimentation and a test-and-learn approach.

Support the technical assessment and implementation of prioritized use cases, ensuring appropriate integration, security, architecture and compliance.

**Connect local opportunities and learnings with Europe Tech teams.**

### **Cybersecurity & Compliance**

Implement cybersecurity guidelines in coordination with Global and Regional Cybersecurity teams and support initiatives to strengthen cybersecurity awareness among end users.

Ensure Global data protection and technology compliance requirements are appropriately implemented within the Market, working with the relevant teams and addressing local requirements where applicable.

Promote responsible technology usage across the organization, particularly as new digital and AI capabilities are introduced.

### **Team Management & Capability Development**

Develop and engage the team, creating clear responsibilities, effective ways of working and strong accountability for service and delivery.

Manage internal and external resources, ensuring the appropriate balance of capabilities, capacity and expertise.

Create a collaborative, service-oriented and forward-looking Tech culture, encouraging proximity to users, curiosity, continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

### **Budget & Partnerships Management**

Contribute to annual Tech budget planning, oversee procurement and track actual expenditure, providing management with appropriate visibility over technology costs, investments and priorities.

Identify and establish relationships and contracts with local technology partners when required, in coordination with the Europe Tech team.

Ensure external partners meet agreed service, quality, security and contractual commitments.

**Energizers**
--------------

* Proven ability to build relationships with and manage key stakeholders.

* Good Understanding of the organization’s goals and objectives.

* Be able to understand business challenges and how IT can help to solve them.

* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across teams and build strong relationships within an international and matrix organization to drive business outcomes.

* Results-oriented, with a can-do mindset and strong problem-solving skills, adapting quickly to deliver effective solutions while ensuring alignment with IT standards.

* Client-oriented, ensuring users feel supported and valued while communicating technical topics in a clear and accessible way.

* Ability to work well under pressure and manage internal and external collaborators.

**What you can bring**
----------------------

* Master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.

* Minimum of 10 years of experience in IT Management in a customer-facing role, with a proven track record of success.

* Excellent communication in English. The knowledge of another language of the Region is a plus.

* Strong knowledge of IT Service Management principles and IT operations.

* Strong experience of project management and ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and requests simultaneously.

* Knowledge of cloud-based technologies, networking, and database management.

* Knowledge of Microsoft Windows 11, M365 services and Linux operating systems and their management platforms.

* Knowledge of Service Now and Microsoft Intune is a plus.

* Certification in relevant IT fields is a plus.

**What you will gain**
----------------------

* Team spirit and an inspiring company culture.

* Individual development opportunities and training.

At Chanel, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to CHANEL.

We look forward to receiving your application (including references, notice period and your salary expectations) via our career website.

Title: Manager, Customer Value Management
Description:
We are looking for a CVM Manager to lead Samsung Gulf Electronics' Customer Value Management engagement with Telecom Operators across the GCC (UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman and Qatar). Based in Dubai, this regional role designs and runs data-driven base management and lifecycle programs that operators use to grow the value of their existing customers, positioning Samsung as a value partner that brings device, ecosystem and customer insight to those programs.

**How You Will Make An Impact:**

**Strategy & Operator Partnership**

* Act as Samsung's lead for CVM topics with operator CVM and base management teams across five markets, reporting to the Head of CRM & Analytics.
* Develop the GCC CVM strategy and annual joint operator plans, with agreed KPIs and governance in each market.
* Co-design base management and lifecycle programs covering segmentation, offers, channel mix and contact frequency, from acquisition and onboarding through retention, win-back and churn prevention.
* Lead quarterly business reviews, joint steering committees and commercial negotiations on scope, funding and timelines.

**Customer Insight & Analytics**

* Translate Samsung Customer Profile Insights into operator-ready use cases, such as device upgrade propensity, ecosystem affinity and next-best-offer recommendations.
* Apply AI and advanced analytics (propensity, churn and uplift models) with operator analytics teams, within agreed data-sharing rules.
* Structure test-and-learn programs with control groups, and report ROI monthly and in flight.

**Business Case & Growth**

* Build the commercial business case for each program, including Samsung investment, co-funding options and expected return.
* Drive Galaxy device upgrades and ecosystem adoption (Galaxy Watch, Buds, Tablets and services), TVs and loyalty, with measurable ROI in every market.
* Deliver a monthly CVM performance review with clear recommendations for senior leadership.

**Market Intelligence & Partnerships**

* Track telecom market dynamics (tariffs, competitor offers, 5G and fiber, eSIM, device financing and regulation) and adapt the CVM plan accordingly.
* Coordinate with Samsung Gulf product, sales, marketing, service, legal and privacy teams, and with HQ and RHQ CVM and data teams.
* Manage external partners (agencies, CVM platform vendors and data partners) to deliver on time and to budget.
* Build a regional GCC CVM playbook and share best practice across the Samsung CRM and analytics community.
* Keep all data sharing compliant with regional data-protection laws (UAE PDPL, Qatar PDPL, Bahrain PDPL) and operator privacy requirements.

**What You'll Need:**

* Minimum 7 years of professional experience, including at least 5 years in Customer Value Management, base management, retention, CRM or lifecycle marketing, with at least 3 of those years within a Telecom Operator or as a partner to one (OEM, agency or vendor).
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, Data Analytics or a related field. A Master's degree or MBA is preferred.
* Hands-on experience leading CVM, base management or lifecycle programs at a Telecom Operator, including campaign design, execution and ROI measurement.
* Solid command of telecom base KPIs: ARPU, churn, net adds, CLV, usage, upgrade rates and tariff migration.
* Experience with CVM or campaign platforms and marketing automation (e.g., Teradata, Adobe, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Amdocs or Netcracker), with working knowledge of telecom BSS and billing systems.
* Working proficiency in SQL and analytics or dashboarding tools. Knowledge of HTML and tag management is an advantage.
* Experience with propensity, churn or uplift modelling, or working alongside data science teams to put models into operation.
* Track record of building business cases for senior commercial leaders and running joint programs with external partners.
* Strong understanding of GCC telecom markets and customer behavior, with knowledge of regional data-protection and consumer communication rules. Arabic is a strong advantage.
* Self-starter who sets own priorities and delivers results without close supervision, with strong influencing and collaboration skills.

**Why You'll Love Working with Us?**

* Competitive salary and performance-based incentive plan for all levels
* Flexible working hours schedule
* Visa, a Top-Tier medical insurance plan, and life insurance
* 22 days of paid annual leave plus public holidays
* An additional day off for your birthday!
* Yearly air ticket allowance & monthly parking allowance (if applicable)

Title: Lead System Administrator
Description:
**About Us**

UMO is a stealth-mode FinTech venture aiming to evolve the way people experience money by building a unified, AI-powered, yet deeply human money platform across fiat, crypto, and investments – subject to regulatory approvals. The platform is being designed to break down traditional barriers to money across access, assets, and experience, enabling simpler, more adaptive ways for people to interact with financial services.

We are currently developing our MVP and navigating licensing requirements, with a multidisciplinary team of 100+ people representing 20+ nationalities. With our headquarters in the UAE, we are united behind a shared ambition and a relentless focus on serving our customers.

**About this role**

  

You will own internal IT end to end — identity and access, SaaS services, workstations and the corporate network that every colleague relies on daily. You'll lead a team of five administrators and take charge of the subscription budget, quarterly planning and renewals. We give you real decision-making authority: only spend above the limit, headcount or key vendor changes, risk acceptance and company-wide changes go up for approval. Everything else is your call, within the boundaries set out under "Decision Rights".

**You'll take ownership of:**

This is a hands-on lead role. Roughly 30% of your time goes to people, planning and alignment, and 70% to hands-on work: complex changes, incident investigation, configuration reviews, automation. You set up routine work so that it runs without you.

**1. Team and quarterly planning**

* Lead five administrators: 1:1s, goals, feedback. Run hiring for approved positions and, when necessary, parting ways — the latter agreed with your manager.
* Organize work across time zones: open incidents are handed over in writing to a specific person, and inconvenient hours are shared fairly. Three time zones cover about 13 hours of the working day, but not 24/7: you decide what truly requires a night-time or weekend response.
* Every critical system has a primary administrator and a backup who knows how to restore it.
* Each quarter, bring a plan: goals, owners, a support buffer and a list of what did not make the cut. Base it on feedback from engineers, recurring incidents and the renewal calendar. At the end of the quarter, show what was done, what was not and why. If urgent work comes up mid-quarter, say what moves and at what cost.
* Prepare a monthly report for the area: service and support health, access status, subscription spend and optimization results, key risks and items that need a management decision.

**2. Identity and access reviews**

* The identity provider is the central point of access provisioning: SSO, phishing-resistant MFA, role-based groups, SCIM. Hiring, transfers and terminations are triggered from the HR system.
* You verify revocation in the application itself. Deactivating a user in the identity provider does not end active sessions or revoke API tokens, local accounts and guest access. Systems without SCIM have an owner for manual revocation, and you make sure it is done.
* Access review frequency depends on risk: privileged and financial systems quarterly, everything else every six months. The system owner decides on each access, revocation is confirmed in the target system, and every exception has a reason and an expiry date. Results are retained as audit evidence.

**3. Corporate services and developer support**

* **Zero Trust access and DNS:** Zero Trust for internal tools (access policies, secure web gateway, device posture) and DNS for corporate domains. Policy changes roll out to a limited group first, and the on-call engineer has a rollback procedure. WAF and the product perimeter stay with DevOps.
* **Cloud, corporate side:** Cloud SSO integrated with the identity provider, role assignments agreed with DevOps, sandbox accounts, spend in corporate accounts. Organization structure and production belong to DevOps.
* **Corporate messaging:** Apps and integrations, guests and external channels, retention policies. Before a bot is installed, you know what data it reads and who owns it.
* **Collaboration suite:** Mail, calendar and documents: sharing rules, third-party OAuth apps, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, data transfer at offboarding.
* **Ticketing and knowledge base:** Permissions, projects and spaces, SSO sign-in. The ticketing system is the team's work queue, the knowledge base holds documentation.
* **Workstations:** MDM: encryption, updates, security policies, shipping a laptop to another country with zero-touch setup.
* Build self-service for developers: standard access is requested via chat or a ticket, approved by the resource owner and granted automatically for a limited time.
* Set support priorities: major outages and security incidents first, then requests that block teams from working.
* Together with DevOps, define clear ownership boundaries and drive shared requests to resolution: a ticket is closed when the problem is solved for the user, not when it has been handed to another team.

**4. Subscriptions and costs**

* Maintain the SaaS registry: owner, cost, number of seats, actual usage, renewal date and the last day the order can still be changed.
* Review paid seats separately from access reviews. Once a month, reconcile paid seats against activity. Long inactivity is a reason to check with the owner, not to reclaim the seat automatically: there are break-glass accounts and tools that are only needed once a quarter.
* Plan each contract review backwards from the last day the order can be changed or the renewal cancelled. By that day, the volume is agreed, the negotiation position is ready and the vendor has been notified if required. Example: 80 editor seats are paid for, 30 are actively used — we go to the vendor with 35 and a question about the pricing tier.
* Find shadow IT through OAuth grants and corporate card spend. In corporate cloud accounts, analyze bill growth by account and service together with the resource owner. Measure savings against invoices, separating realized savings from those expected at the next renewal.

**5. AI and automation**

For you, AI is the normal way the whole team works. What we expect:

* First-line support in chat: answers from the knowledge base with source links, request classification and ticket creation, handing unclear cases to a human.
* Preparation of access reviews and license reviews: AI reconciles exports from the identity provider, the HR system and applications and produces a list of anomalies for an administrator to verify.
* Measure the impact: compare time before and after rollout, including the time spent reviewing and correcting errors.
* Set the rules: what data may be shared with a model and where only a human makes the decision. AI does not grant privileged access or reset MFA: an administrator does that, verifying the employee's identity before any MFA reset.
* The whole team knows how to use these tools, not just you.
  

**About you:**

  

* **Leadership:** 2+ years of directly managing system administrators or IT engineers, including a distributed team. You have hired, given difficult feedback and changed priorities mid-quarter in a way the team understood.
* **Okta, in depth:** SSO, SCIM, lifecycle management, MFA policies, Workflows. You have implemented it or significantly restructured it, not just created users.
* **Cloudflare, AWS, Slack, at a working level:** Cloudflare Zero Trust and DNS; AWS IAM, IAM Identity Center, billing and Cost Explorer; Slack administration: apps, guests, Slack Connect. For each, you can walk us through a change you made yourself: how you tested it and what you did when something broke. Kubernetes, CI/CD and product networking are not required.
* **Google Workspace, Atlassian Cloud, Kandji:** Administration of Google Workspace (sharing, OAuth apps, SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and Atlassian Cloud (Jira, Confluence: permissions, projects, Okta sign-in). Kandji or another MDM for macOS.
* **AI, advanced level:** You have built an LLM-based automation that your colleagues actually used. In the interview, you will show what was built, how you evaluated errors, where you kept a human in the loop and how much time it saves. "I write prompts in ChatGPT" is not what this role needs.
* **Scripting and APIs:** Confident in Python or similar, and able to review other people's code.
* **Access and audit:** You have taken access reviews through to actual revocation and answered auditors' questions.
* **Money:** You have managed SaaS renewals and can name the amount you saved and explain where it came from.
* **Communication:** Fluent English for vendors, documentation and the team.
  

**Can get you a few bonus points**

  

* Fintech or another regulated industry; PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001.
* Terraform for Okta, Cloudflare and AWS.
* Okta Identity Governance or similar, SaaS management platforms.
  

**The UMO Standard**

* **Dynamic Work Environment:** Vibrant offices and strong local teams across Lisbon, Dubai, Kyiv, and Lviv — with openness to remote for the right fit.
* **Rest & Recovery:** 24 days of annual leave, dedicated paid sick leave, and observance of Public Holidays to keep you at your best.
* **Recharge Week:** After your first year with us, enjoy two consecutive 4-day work weeks annually — a built-in reset to help you sustain peak performance for the long run.
* **Full Setup:** Top-of-the-line hardware and a home office stipend so you can do your best work anywhere.
* **Growth Ecosystem:** A dedicated learning budget and room to grow as the company grows.
* **Impact & Ownership:** Your work directly shapes the product and company direction — not just executes it.

Title: Strategic Account Manager
Description:
**About Orium**
---------------

Orium builds smart, modern commerce solutions for enterprise brands. We're the leading composable commerce consultancy and systems integrator in the Americas, with more composable launches than any firm in the region, and a member of the MACH Alliance. We combine AI, data and composable systems so people and intelligent agents can work together, and we partner with best-in-class technology providers including commercetools, Stripe and Contentstack across three lines of business: Commerce, DXP and Agentic.

We're a remote-first company with team members across the Americas. A certified BCorp for over a decade, we're based in Toronto, and in June 2024 we acquired the Mexico-based ecommerce agency Gluo.

**About the Opportunity**
-------------------------

Orium is seeking a senior Strategic Account Manager to be the trusted partner for some of our most important enterprise clients. You'll own a small portfolio of complex accounts, be the person clients call when things get hard, and help them see their problems in a new way.

You're at your best in the room with senior stakeholders, whether you're leading a workshop, resetting expectations or making the case for what comes next. You'd rather go deep with a handful of clients than chase new logos, and you measure success by the trust you earn and the accounts you grow.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own 5 to 8 priority enterprise accounts as the main commercial contact and trusted advisor
* Act as the senior escalation point, leading honest conversations when expectations, scope or budgets need resetting, and getting relationships back on track
* Lead and participate in client workshops, steering committees, roadmap planning and quarterly business reviews, challenging assumptions and reframing problems when a client is heading the wrong way
* Drive account growth through renewals and expansion across our Commerce, DXP and Agentic practices, including partner-led opportunities with commercetools, Stripe and Contentstack
* Shape new opportunities with our delivery and strategy teams, from problem statement through pitch and SOW
* Help clients move from project work into ongoing optimization and managed services
* Develop and maintain account plans and forecasts in partnership with sales leadership
* Maintain strong working relationships with delivery teams to keep engagements on scope, high quality and aligned to client goals and KPIs
* Use AI tools for account research, meeting prep and opportunity spotting
* Travel to meet clients and partners across the Americas as needed

**Skills and Qualifications**
-----------------------------

* 5+ years in client-facing, revenue-accountable roles such as Account Director, Client Partner, Strategic Account Manager or Customer Success leader
* Experience at a professional services firm, agency, systems integrator or B2B SaaS company
* A track record of managing senior enterprise relationships through difficult moments, and coming out with more trust than before
* Experience working with B2B clients
* Confidence leading workshops and executive conversations, and the creativity to turn what a client asks for into a better problem to solve
* Proven ability to grow accounts through renewals and expansion, and comfort owning a revenue number
* Strong commercial judgment across scope, margin and forecast
* Knowledge of the digital commerce landscape, including composable commerce, modular DXP and emerging AI and agentic technologies, is an asset
* Experience with modern digital tools and an openness to integrating AI-powered solutions into your daily work\*
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to critically evaluate AI-assisted decisions and workflows\*
* A mindset of continuous learning and the ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and trends\*
* Based in Canada

* AI expectations will vary by role. Some positions focus on AI exploration and experimentation, while leadership roles may drive AI adoption and strategy.

**Is this Role a Fit for You?**
-------------------------------

The role emphasizes trusted client relationships, commercial acumen and creative problem solving. We value people with a maker's attitude, collaborative energy and entrepreneurial spirit. You'll find fulfillment in the role if you...

* **Are passionate about client relationships.** You can't sleep properly if we might miss a commitment, and you're the first to pick up the phone when something goes sideways.
* **Stay calm and direct in hard conversations.** You know that honest, well-timed conversations build more trust than avoiding them.
* **Love reframing the problem.** You get curious about the need behind the request and enjoy helping clients see a better path forward.
* **Have an interest in making the business work.** You're an entrepreneur at heart and see account growth as the result of delivering real value.
* **Prefer depth over volume.** You'd rather build long-term relationships with a few clients than chase new logos.
* **Thoroughly enjoy collaborative work.** You partner closely with delivery, strategy and sales, and you put the team's success first.
* **Are naturally curious about AI.** You look for ways to use AI and automation to work smarter, without losing the human touch.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

* Enjoy a flexible schedule of full-time hours. As a remote-first organization, we care about the work you do, but it's up to you to choose where and how you do it.
* Explore ongoing opportunities for professional development: training, conferences, certifications and in-house peer mentorship.
* Experiment with new techniques, wear multiple hats and learn about new disciplines.

Job Description :

**This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S**

We are standing up a product-led, agile-based operating model for Infrastructure, and we are looking for a Release Train Engineer and Portfolio Delivery Lead to run delivery across the organization. This person works across five agile teams (platform areas), carries portfolio-level visibility, and helps define and own the operating model as we build it. It is a foundational role: you will not inherit a mature train, you will help stand one up.

**About the role**

Infrastructure & Cloud is moving from a project-based structure to a product-led model built on five agile teams (platform areas) spanning cloud, network, reliability, developer experience, and data. The Release Train Engineer is the connective tissue across those teams: the person who makes cross-team delivery predictable, keeps dependencies and risks visible, and gives leadership a clear line of sight into flow and progress. You will partner closely with the product director, who owns product direction and the roadmap, while you own the cadence, the flow, and how the teams execute together.

**What you will do**

**Run the train**

* Facilitate PSI planning and the planning cadence across the five teams, including readiness, cross-team syncs, demos, and retrospectives.
* Establish and hold a consistent delivery rhythm across teams that do not run on the same clock today.

**Manage flow, dependencies, and risk**

* Surface and manage cross-team dependencies, bottlenecks, and risks before they slow delivery.
* Keep work moving across team boundaries, and escalate what needs leadership attention.

**Portfolio and Quarterly Planning**

* Partner with Product Management, Business Teams, and Engineering leadership to facilitate quarterly planning, roadmap reviews, prioritization discussions, and portfolio planning activities.
* Facilitate quarterly planning, capacity planning, and commitment management across the portfolio, ensuring priorities, staffing, and delivery commitments remain aligned.

**Own portfolio visibility and governance**

* Own portfolio-level rollup and reporting across the teams: intake, status, and progress against priorities. Set the reporting standards and requirements, and work with ADO administrators who build the views.
* Prepare and facilitate executive-level portfolio reviews, including delivery status, dependency management, capacity planning, risks, and commitment tracking.
* Give leadership a single, reliable view of what is in flight, what is at risk, and what is landing.
* Partner with the product director and product owners on prioritization and sequencing.

**Coach and build the practice**

* Coach product owners, delivery managers, scrum masters, and delivery leaders on ways of working across the teams.
* Raise the agile maturity of a newly formed organization.

**Help define the operating model**

* Help design, stand up, and take ownership of the operating model itself, including the playbook, ADO standard, and PSI cadence developed with external partners: cadences, decision rights, intake, and the standards the teams work to.
* Be at the forefront of a new organization as it forms.

**Measure and improve**

* Define and track delivery metrics, and drive continuous improvement across the train.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience leading delivery, portfolio or program management, agile transformations, release trains, or large cross-functional programs.
* Portfolio or program leadership: managing dependencies, flow, and reporting across a set of teams, not a single team.
* Proven ability to coordinate delivery across geographically distributed teams, multiple leaders, and competing stakeholder groups.
* Strong facilitation, and the ability to hold a cadence across teams and personalities.
* Change-management and stakeholder-management skill, with comfort influencing without direct authority.
* Fluency with agile tooling and portfolio rollup, for example Azure DevOps.

**Preferred**

* Experience as a Release Train Engineer, agile program manager, delivery director, PMO leader, or transformation lead running delivery across multiple agile teams (SAFe certification or equivalent experience a plus).
* Experience leading operating model transformations, organizational change initiatives, or product operating model implementations.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, including experience establishing standards, portfolio reporting, dependency tracking, and executive dashboards.
* Background in infrastructure, cloud, or platform engineering environments.
* Coaching or mentoring experience with agile roles.

Title: Senior Manager - Operational Readiness - AA9
Description:
Lead the end-to-end handover process for District ICT Infrastructure services moving from delivery into live operations. The role ensures operational onboarding, documentation, support contracts, and knowledge transfer are completed to the required standard before service commencement.
  
  
**Key competencies**

* Designing handover governance and applying it consistently across systems, vendors and projects
* Service transition and operational onboarding expertise
* Planning knowledge transfer and developing operational competency
* Commercial awareness of support contracts, warranties and third-party obligations
* Clear risk reporting, decisive escalation and confident chairing of reviews
* Proven experience across core ICT infrastructure domains, including compute, storage, backup, networking and structured cabling

**Key Responsibilities**
**Handover Governance & Control:**

* Define and manage the handover governance framework for District ICT systems entering live operations
* Establish required handover deliverables, review checkpoints, sign-off criteria, and escalation principles
* Ensure handover governance is applied consistently across different District ICT Systems, vendors, and projects
* Maintain control over readiness status, approval pathways, and acceptance conditions

**Operational Onboarding & Service Activation**

* Oversee onboarding of services into ICC, ServiceNow, and related operational support processes
* Ensure support workflows, service structures, escalation paths, and operational contacts are established before go-live
* Confirm that service records, operational inventories, support dependencies, and relevant tool configurations are complete and usable
* Verify that the receiving operations environment is prepared to support the new or changed service from day one

**Documentation, Knowledge Transfer & Support Readiness**

* Ensure delivery teams provide complete documentation packs, SOPs, operating procedures, support guides, and technical records
* Lead the planning and execution of knowledge transfer to BAU teams, including operational training and competency development
* Confirm that operational teams understand the service, support model, known risks, and recovery procedures ahead of service commencement
* Ensure training gaps and documentation issues are identified early and addressed before handover sign-off
* Ensure Data Inputs into ITAM & CMDB

**Contracts, Risks & Reporting**

* Oversee support contract registration, warranty coverage transition, and support responsibilities for externally supported components
* Ensure contractual support obligations are reflected in the live support model and understood by operational teams
* Confirm third-party support contacts, service windows, and escalation commitments are documented and activated
* Track commercial dependencies that could affect service support after go-live

**Handover Risk & Management Reporting**

* Maintain a consolidated view of handover readiness, open risks, unresolved actions, and acceptance blockers
* Chair handover reviews and provide management with clear recommendations on transition readiness
* Escalate incomplete deliverables, support model gaps, or residual risks that may compromise stable BAU operation
* Drive closure of post-handover stabilization issues where formal follow-up is required

**Interactions/ Engagement**

* Delivery teams and system integrators: Handover deliverables, documentation and open actions
* ICC and BAU operations teams: Onboarding, training and day-one support readiness
* ServiceNow, ITAM and CMDB owners: Service records, asset data and tool configuration
* Vendors, OEMs and third-party support providers: Contracts, warranties and escalation commitments
* Procurement and contracts teams: Support obligations and commercial dependencies
* Senior management: Readiness recommendations, risks and escalations

**Requirements**

* 10+ years in IT or OT operations, including 4+ years in service or relationship management
* Sound understanding of IT/OT network segmentation, connectivity and cybersecurity principles
* Strong grasp of ITIL 4 incident, change and escalation management practices
* Experience working with OLAs, escalation matrices and governance in multi-party environments
* ITIL 4, CCNP or equivalent required; a cybersecurity awareness certification (e.g. CompTIA Security+) desirable

Title: Executive Director, Utilities (RE1)
Description:
The Executive Director, Utilities leads the City Operations utilities mandate across Qiddiya City, covering power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, ICT, water bodies, lagoons and other utility systems within scope. The role is accountable for improving the operational management and resilience of existing interim networks, water bodies and lagoons; protecting continuity of service during construction; defining the city-wide utilities strategy, ownership model and operating standards; and ensuring permanent utility and water assets are planned, designed, delivered and accepted in line with City Operations and Qiddiya City Authority requirements. Reporting to the City Chief Operations Officer, the role coordinates closely with planning, design, delivery, district and asset teams, QTech, Smart City, utility providers, regulators and O&M partners to manage material service, capacity, water-quality, commercial and reputational risks.

**Utilities Strategy and Asset Ownership**

* Develop and implement the City Operations strategy for all utilities, water bodies and lagoons, including service outcomes, water quality, resilience, governance, ownership, operating and cost model, standards and long-term investment priorities.
* Determine which interim and permanent utility assets will be adopted by City Operations and which will be owned or operated by utilities, districts, assets or other third parties, with clear decision rights and accountability.
* Improve the operational management, asset information, condition oversight and service performance of existing interim power, potable water, renewed water and ICT networks.
* Develop and implement a protection and continuity strategy for live interim utility networks during construction, recognising that outages create a material operational and reputational risk for Qiddiya.
* Maintain an accurate city-wide utilities asset register and GIS record, including surveys of existing interim networks and requirements for any relocation arising from development works.
* Advise the City Chief Operations Officer and governance on utility priorities, delivery dependencies, capacity constraints, temporary solutions, investment needs and material operational risks.

**Planning, Design and Operational Assurance**

* Coordinate with planning, design and delivery teams to accelerate permanent utility assets needed for growing city-wide operational, development and major-event requirements.
* Define City Operations requirements and assure their incorporation into utility strategies, project briefs, designs, specifications, delivery plans and permanent-asset operating models.
* Verify that interim and full-build infrastructure can meet peak utility loads, including concurrent major-event scenarios and increased city footfall, with adequate redundancy and recovery arrangements.
* Lead operational assurance of critical dependencies and interfaces, including permanent and temporary power, potable and renewed water capacity, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, utility corridors, ICT connectivity and data-centre requirements.
* Coordinate space planning for utility operational centres, O&M yards, workshops and equipment and spare-parts storage, confirming the required number, location and functionality across Qiddiya City.
* Participate in multidisciplinary stage-gate reviews and challenge solutions to optimise safety, service continuity, maintainability, whole-life cost, efficiency and operational readiness.

**Readiness, Handover and Asset Acceptance**

* Establish utility readiness, testing, commissioning, handover and operational acceptance requirements, including permits, asset data, GIS records, operating procedures, warranties, spares, training and defect closure.
* Assess acceptance evidence and recommend City Operations acceptance only where ownership, operating responsibility, funding and service interfaces are clear.
* Aggregate city-wide O&M requirements and lead the technical and operational strategy for a multi-year city-wide utilities O&M services procurement, coordinating with Commercial, Procurement, Finance and Legal.
* Coordinate mobilisation and transition arrangements for interim and permanent networks, including temporary service extensions where delays to permanent assets require continued use of temporary power, water or ICT solutions.
* Ensure adopted assets are captured in the asset management system and GIS with complete, accurate and usable information for safe operation and maintenance.

**Performance, Risk and Lifecycle Management**

* Establish KPIs and executive reporting for availability, outages, reliability, water quality, water-body and lagoon condition, capacity, losses, consumption, compliance, incidents, cost, complaints and recovery performance.
* Maintain a consolidated utilities risk and dependency register covering delivery slippage, temporary-network fragility, corridor and land constraints, capacity shortfalls, construction interfaces and unbudgeted temporary solutions.
* Develop lifecycle, renewal and investment plans based on criticality, condition, service demand, resilience, regulatory requirements and whole-life value.
* Confirm the operational data required for smart utilities, align the Siemens utilities integration study with QTech and Smart City initiatives, and define requirements for monitoring, analytics and future digital-twin capability.
* Ensure emergency, outage, business continuity and recovery plans are coordinated with City Operations, districts, assets, utility providers, safety, security and event functions.

**Commercial, Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Define the utilities cost-recovery model, including cost allocation, metering, tariffs or charges, billing inputs, subsidy requirements, subsidy period and governance for costs levied on operational assets.
* Lead the utility component of the city service charge in collaboration with the Executive Director, City Asset Management and Finance and Control, ensuring transparent and auditable recovery mechanisms.
* Draft and implement service level agreements between City Operations and districts or assets for utilities adopted by City Operations, including service standards, responsibilities, escalation, outage communication and performance reporting.
* Develop City Operations codes, standards and guidelines for construction in the vicinity of live utility assets, including permits, protection measures, access controls and incident response.
* Manage strategic interfaces with authorities, regulators, Saudi Electricity, water entities, telecoms providers, developers, districts, operators and specialist O&M service providers.
* Ensure statutory, technical, environmental, commercial and contractual obligations are identified, governed and evidenced across all adopted utilities.

**Leadership and Capability Building**

* Build and lead a capable municipal utilities team with clear accountability, effective governance and disciplined delivery.
* Develop Saudi talent through structured recruitment, mentoring, role exposure, succession planning and knowledge transfer from advisers, delivery partners and operators.
* Promote collaboration, technical rigour, commercial discipline, innovation and continuous improvement.

  
**Requirements**

**Education and Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, utilities, infrastructure, asset management or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in engineering, asset management, business or a related field is advantageous.
* Relevant professional registration or accreditation in engineering, utilities, asset management or project management is preferred.

**Experience**

* Substantial executive leadership experience in city-wide utilities, infrastructure asset management or utility network development within a complex city, municipality, mixed-use destination or major development programme.
* Demonstrated experience managing live interim or temporary utility networks while permanent infrastructure is planned and delivered in an active construction environment.
* Strong experience across utility strategy, planning, design assurance, construction interfaces, testing, commissioning, handover, operational acceptance and service mobilisation.
* Proven experience in network resilience, outage management, peak-demand planning, lifecycle investment, GIS and asset information, operational data and regulatory compliance.
* Demonstrated experience developing utility O&M procurement strategies, SLAs, performance regimes, tariffs, metering, billing, cost-recovery or subsidy models.
* Proven ability to manage interfaces among developers, delivery teams, authorities, regulators, utilities, districts, operators and service providers; experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC is strongly preferred.

**Technical and Functional Expectations**

* Expert understanding of city-wide utility asset management, live-network operations and governance of networked infrastructure.
* Strong working knowledge of power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, ICT and associated corridors, facilities and operational dependencies.
* Ability to assess demand, capacity, reliability, redundancy, pressure and flow constraints, metering, efficiency, service continuity, emergency recovery and whole-life cost.
* Strong understanding of GIS, asset registers, operational technology, smart-utility data, analytics and digital-twin opportunities.
* Clear understanding of asset-owner, developer, regulator, network operator, O&M manager, district, asset and service-provider accountability boundaries.
* Strong commercial judgement, procurement capability, risk management, data-led decision-making and executive reporting.

----------------------------------

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues! Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

**About the Role:**

The **Manager, Workforce Planning & Business Optimization** will be responsible for developing the forecasting, capacity modelling, performance analytics, workforce intelligence, and business integration capabilities required to support Enterprise Contact Centre service delivery across current and future channels. The role combines workforce planning expertise with advanced analytics, reporting automation, AI/automation measurement, and enterprise technology integration to enable better decisions on staffing, service levels, cost-to-serve, and transformation readiness.

This role will build the analytical and integration foundation needed to support omni-channel operations across phone, email, assisted chat, workflow, digital servicing, and AI-enabled interactions. It will own the business integration lifecycle - from use-case definition and requirements through data/API integration, testing, operational readiness, adoption, monitoring, and benefits realization - while partnering with Technology and platform teams on solution delivery. It will provide executive-ready insights that connect workforce assumptions to client experience, advisor experience, operational performance, technology outcomes, and enterprise transformation priorities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build accurate and scalable workforce models across phone, email, chat, digital channels, workflow queues, and AI-enabled work.
* Own the business integration lifecycle for WFM analytics and AI capabilities, from use-case evaluation and requirements through testing, implementation, adoption, monitoring, and benefits realization.
* Translate cloud-based and AI-enabled technical capabilities into practical workflows, functional requirements, data requirements, and operational processes.
* Improve connectivity across WFM, CCaaS, CRM, workflow, data, and enterprise platforms through governed APIs, data flows, and reusable integrations.
* Automate reporting and reduce reliance on manual downloads, spreadsheets, and one-time analysis.
* Validate the realized benefits and service impacts of automation, and AI/digital workers.
* Ensure new capabilities are scalable, reliable, resilient, secure, privacy-aligned, supportable, cost-effective, and compliant with internal standards.
* Provide decision-grade insights for monthly, quarterly, annual, and business planning cycles.
* Support service-safe transformation by identifying workforce, integration, data, and adoption risks early and recommending mitigation options.
* Advance segmentation and capacity models across IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments to align staffing with changing volume mix, service expectations, and reporting requirements.
* Build sustainable capability through integration standards, documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Economics, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in workforce planning, contact centre analytics, operations analytics, business intelligence, data science, systems integration, AI enablement, or related function.
* Experience building forecasting, capacity, performance, or scenario models and applying them to operational or strategic decisions.
* Transformation Experience operationalizing, automation, AI, or technology-enabled capability in a production or enterprise environment.
* Advanced Power BI or equivalent reporting experience, strong SQL, and advanced Excel skills.
* Experience translating business needs and analytical outputs into functional, data, or integration requirements and recommendations for operational or executive decision-making.
* Experience defining, implementing, or supporting data/API integrations across WFM, contact centre, cloud, or enterprise platforms.
* Working knowledge of cloud-based data/AI environments, system architecture concepts, data quality, security, privacy, and technology governance.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or advanced certification in Data Science, Business Analytics, AI, Technology, or a related discipline.
* Experience in financial services, wealth management, or other regulated environments, with exposure to omni-channel contact centre operations.
* Proficiency with workforce management platforms (Verint, Calabrio, NICE, Genesys), cloud technologies (AWS, Salesforce, Azure), and advanced analytics tools (Python, R, Power BI, Looker, SQL).
* Experience implementing AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives, including systems integration, operational readiness, and benefits realization.
* Strong understanding of data governance, cybersecurity, privacy, and responsible AI practices.
* Experience partnering with senior leadership to influence strategic workforce planning, technology roadmaps, and business transformation initiatives.

As this position is posted in Montréal, Toronto and Winnipeg, we specify that bilingualism (French, English, both oral and written) is required for Quebec only for the frequent interactions with English.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is **$77,500 - $105,000** which is determined based on skills, knowledge and experience and geographic location. Title: Senior Director of Professional Services Enterprise Delivery & Implementation| West Coast| Remote
Description:
Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best-in-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.

Ellucian is seeking a dynamic **Senior Director of Professional Services Delivery** to join our Professional Services organization. This role involves leading and overseeing the implementation of Ellucian solutions, supporting higher education institutions in Canada and the eastern United States. These strategic programs range from 1.5 to 2 years. Bring your strategic vision, enterprise program governance, execution, and leadership skills to Ellucian and make a significant impact! At Ellucian, we offer a comprehensive SaaS portfolio that helps higher education institutions navigate change, achieve transparency, and drive efficiency.

**Where You Will Make an Impact**

* Manage the Professional Services Field Delivery organization.
* Share responsibility for the North American Professional Services P&L (revenue and expenses of assigned projects) and Customer Satisfaction.
* Own financial forecasts related to delivery revenue and margin, collaborating closely with the Finance Business Partner.
* Identify business growth opportunities by leveraging knowledge of the Higher Education industry, business processes, and software products.
* Assist the Customer Success team in developing solutions and selling the value of project management services during the sales cycle.
* Drive consumption of PS orders (backlog) to accelerate time to value and maximize project profitability.
* Ensure effective execution of service delivery and achievement of customers’ desired outcomes.
* Implement project quality assurance by employing standardized processes and best practices.
* Assess risks, define mitigation plans, manage demand, and anticipate resource bottlenecks.
* Establish early-warning project management and risk management practices.
* Provide critical issue management and proactively lead project escalations, implementing measures to prevent future issues.
* Drive the vision and execution of Professional Services.
* Build strong, long-lasting relationships with customers, delivering high-value, outcome-based services that result in referenceable clients.
* Motivate, coach, and transform the Delivery team to an outcomes-based service model, delivering high NPS and project profitability.
* Promote the use of blended delivery (e.g., using Ellucian CoEs in India and Mexico or partners/subcontractors).
* Proactively engage with the North American Professional Services organization consulting practices to ensure timely delivery to contract and customer satisfaction/NPS.
* Resolve escalations by leading cross-functional team resolutions to mitigate project risks and issues.
* Monitor the health status of the Delivery region and ensure proactive risk management.
* Improve NA regional delivery team dynamics and performance through leadership, mentoring, and motivation.
* Ensure regions leverage repeatable, standard practices/processes.
* Understand the Professional Services marketplace and drive new implementation approaches throughout the organization.
* Work collaboratively with the Services team to develop and improve strategies, policies, and procedures; support and promote the use of delivery methodologies and best practices.

**Developing Our Teams**

* Lead change management activities within the Field Delivery organization to enable transformation and team growth.
* Address performance concerns with delivery leaders and provide timely performance evaluation input.
* Focus on proactive communications, cascading messages through regional leadership.
* Own the accuracy of the regional financial forecasting process (revenue, bookings, margins, expenditures, etc.).
* Monitor regional delivery KPIs (supply & demand, backlog, project profitability, PM utilization, and project health).
* Establish and monitor delivery compliance and assurance metrics underpinning project health.
* Foster a culture of skills development and employee career advancement.
* Build positive working relationships with Sales, Pre-sales, Customer Success & Support, Cloud Operations, Managed Services teams, and the Office of the COO, operating under the “One-team” approach motto across Ellucian to enhance customer service excellence.

**What You Will Bring**

* + A minimum of 12 years of progressive professional experience, including personnel management, technical leadership, and P&L ownership.
  + Demonstrable experience in resource planning and optimization; revenue recognition and EBITDA budgeting, and action planning resulting from actively managing budgets, costs, and performance.
  + Consulting or leadership position in a Professional Service Organization of a SaaS software company is required, with specific experience in moving applications from on-prem to Cloud/SaaS.
  + Project Management and Operations experience in running Professional Services in software companies.
  + Demonstrable experience in interfacing commercially and technically with partner organizations, outsourcing companies, and global coordination of remote resources and contractors.
  + Extensive experience in implementing large systems like ERPs, CRMs, Billing, HR, Logistics, or Custom Business Applications.
  + Strong business acumen, with deep expertise in process improvement, negotiation, go-to-market strategies, financial management, data and analytics, driving transformation, and strategic change.
  + Ability to work cross-functionally across a matrixed organization.
  + Ability to quickly summarize and communicate complex information to multiple audiences.
  + Highly effective interpersonal skills, bringing your authentic self to work, building trust and credibility with others.
  + Ready for travel up to 50% (e.g., customer meetings, events, training, etc.).
  + Demonstrates a clear ability to interact and influence management and contributors at all levels of the organization.
  + Excellent communication and collaboration skills; ability to communicate and influence effectively with peers, direct reports, and other teams.

Title: Sr Director, Platform Services
Description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

Building trusted markets — powered by our people

  
  

At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.

  
  

We’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.

  
  

To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model.

  
  

**Location Overview**

Cboe’s New York office is located in the heart of one of the world's most dynamic financial districts, offering employees an exciting, fast-paced environment at the forefront of global trading and finance. Situated in Manhattan, our office provides easy access to Wall Street, major financial institutions, and a network of innovative fintech companies. With a central location, Associates can enjoy excellent transportation options, as well as the vibrant culture, dining, and entertainment that New York City is known for.

Our office fosters a collaborative atmosphere with a high-energy vibe, giving employees the best of both worlds: the close-knit camaraderie of a focused team and the expansive opportunities of a global organization.

  

**Role Overview**

Cboe’s platform teams run the technology that the BIDS, Clearing and FX businesses depend on, and the Sr Director, Platform Services leads the organization that operates it. You will own the platform service offering for each business unit, treat its engineering teams as your customers and be accountable for how reliably it runs.

You will choose the platform products, service tiers and topologies each business receives from the configurations Platform Engineering supports, then deliver and operate them across Kubernetes, managed databases, Kafka, Linux, DevOps infrastructure and hardware. This is a chance to build a customer-focused, SRE-driven operating model for mission-critical market infrastructure, with real influence over how Cboe’s engineering teams ship.

Your responsibilities will be:

* Own the platform service portfolio and roadmap for each business unit, with application engineering teams as your direct customers: intake, service reviews, capacity planning and feedback. Act as Platform Engineering’s primary customer, bringing in business-unit requirements and escalating needs the supported catalog cannot meet.

* Choose the platform products, service tiers and topologies each business unit receives from the configurations Platform Engineering supports, and record the reasons behind each choice.

* Publish and commit to service levels, objectives and indicators for each business unit, and give consumers advance notice of material platform change.

* Operate the Kubernetes, managed database and Kafka platforms, along with Linux fleets, server and storage hardware, and CI/CD infrastructure (such as GitHub Enterprise, Jenkins, Harbor and GitOps controllers), including lifecycle, patching and provisioning against application team declarations.

* Lead Site Reliability for the platform: SLOs, error budgets, platform on-call, incident leadership within the platform and joint post-incident reviews with application teams.

* Partner with Information Security, Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit on control and regulatory obligations (such as Reg SCI and SOC), including audit evidence and break-glass custody.

* Lead and develop a team of engineers, and manage vendors and capacity planning.

The ideal candidate has

* 12+ years of technology experience, including 5+ years leading large infrastructure, SRE or platform operations organizations, ideally including leaders of leaders.

* A proven record delivering and operating mission-critical, high-availability platforms for internal engineering customers in financial services, capital markets or a comparable regulated environment.

* Experience running platform services as a product: service catalogs, tiering, published service levels and customer engagement.

* Deep knowledge of Kubernetes and cloud-native operations, plus Linux fleet operations, Kafka, managed databases and CI/CD and GitOps infrastructure, with strong SRE practice (SLOs, error budgets, incident command and post-incident review).

* Strong stakeholder skills, including managing a supplier and customer relationship with an internal engineering organization, plus experience with budgeting, vendor management and talent development.

* Preferred: experience with trading, clearing or FX systems and Reg SCI or SOC control environments; hybrid cloud and on-prem, multi-region and hardware lifecycle experience.

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or a related field (advanced degree a plus).

Benefits and Perks

We value the total wellbeing of our people – including health, financial, personal and social wellness. We believe standard benefits like health insurance and fair pay are given at any organization. Still, you should know what we offer:

* Medical Coverage

* Prescription Drug Coverage

* Additional Medical Benefit

* Dental Coverage

* Vision Coverage

* 401K or Pension Company Match

* Spending Accounts

* Life and AD&D Insurance

* Retirement Savings Plan

* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

* Voluntary & Additional Benefits

* Paid Time Off

We’re reimagining the future of the workplace by focusing on what matters most, our people. Our journey is an inclusive one. We’re investing deeply in leadership programs and career development initiatives that ensure everyone has an equal chance to succeed.

  
  

We work with purpose, solving problems with ingenuity, collaboration, and a lot of passion. We’re an engaged and excited team connecting markets across borders and embracing growth in all its forms to achieve incredible outcomes.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment based on any legally protected characteristic, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status. We are committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued and respected.

  
  

**This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.**

  

**Salary Ranges (applicable for US locations only)**

At Cboe, we are committed to providing a competitive, transparent, and market‑informed total rewards program. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $276,250-$357,500, with actual compensation determined by job‑related factors such as skills, relevant experience, education, internal alignment, and location.  

This role may also be eligible for annual incentive compensation and, where applicable, participation in Cboe's long-term equity programs.

Title: MDM Project Manager / Scrum Master
Description:
Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering. Since 2000, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government organizations worldwide. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled MDM Project Manager / Scrum Master to join our innovative and dynamic team.

**MDM Project Manager / Scrum Master | About You**

As a MDM Project Manager / Scrum Master, you will own the integrated delivery plan and governance for a complex MDM and data-modernization initiative. You will coordinate business, data, platform, security, engineering, testing, and leadership stakeholders while ensuring milestones, budget, scope, risks, dependencies, UAT readiness, and transition activities remain on track. You combine disciplined project management with practical Agile leadership and can create transparency, resolve blockers, facilitate timely decisions, and keep a multi-workstream data program moving toward measurable business outcomes.

**MDM Project Manager / Scrum Master | Day-to-Day**

* Own and maintain the integrated delivery plan covering discovery, solution design, data profiling, development, testing, deployment, training, hypercare, and handover.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, milestones, resources, actions, risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and change-control activities across the program.
* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release-readiness sessions.
* Coordinate MDM architects, technical leads, developers, testers, business analysts, data engineers, data owners, stewards, and platform teams around shared priorities and commitments.
* Lead weekly program-governance meetings, working sessions, status reviews, steering-committee preparation, and stakeholder escalation processes.
* Manage approvals and decision tracking for business requirements, entity definitions, matching thresholds, survivorship rules, data-quality standards, security readiness, and production deployment.
* Coordinate SIT, reconciliation, UAT readiness, defect closure, training, knowledge transfer, reverse shadowing, and operational handover activities.

Title: Senior Manager_Warehousing and  Distribution
Description:
**Job Title: Senior Manager\_Warehousing and Distribution**

**Department: Logistics & Supply Chain**

**Job Objective**

This role is responsible for owning the day-to-day logistics execution across the company's operations. The role acts as the operational control point between vendors, freight providers,3PL warehouses, customer service, and internal supply chain teams, ensuring efficient stock movement, timely order processing, and clear visibility on logistics performance across wholesale, retail and marketplace channels.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Operations Leadership & SLA Ownership**

* Own end-to-end logistics execution KPIs, including inbound OTIF, warehouse SLA, outbound dispatch performance, return rates and exception resolution time.
* Lead daily and weekly operational governance with 3PL warehouse and transport partners, holding them accountable to contractual service levels.
* Act as the senior escalation point for execution issues impacting customer deliveries, brand launches and marketplace performance.
* Manage and develop direct reports, ensuring clear ownership and a strong execution culture.

**2. 3PL Warehouse & Service Provider Governance**

* Serve as the primary operational interface with 3PL warehouses and fulfilment partners.
* Govern receiving,order processing, picking, packing, dispatch and returns handling across all 3PL sites.
* Run regular performance reviews, drive corrective action plans, and lead contract renegotiation cycles where required.
* Onboard new 3PL partners and new lanes, including standard operating procedures, system integration and pricing schedules.

**3. Transport & Carrier Management**

* Own the relationship with freight forwarders, carriers and courier providers across inbound and outbound flows.
* Drive parcel carrier tender cycles, securing competitive rates and reliable service.
* Monitor shipment schedules, transport bookings, proof of delivery, transit-time performance and exception management.
* Lead freight optimisation initiatives across modes (sea, air, road) to balance cost, speed and service reliability.

**4. Inbound, Outbound & Inventory Movement**

* Oversee the daily flow of goods from suppliers into warehouses, and from warehouses to wholesale customers, retail stores, and end consumers.
* Coordinate stock transfers, urgent replenishments, and shipment prioritisation aligned to launch calendars and merchandising plans.
* Ensure accurate goods-in-transit visibility and timely system updates between WMS, ERP and partner platforms.
* Support stock migrations and inter-DC consolidations as required.

**5. Returns, Claims & Issue Resolution**

* Lead operational management of returns, refused deliveries, shipment discrepancies and warehouse claims.
* Coordinate with customer service, warehouse partners and carriers to ensure timely closure and minimal financial leakage.
* Identify recurring issues and implement structural fixes through SOP changes, process redesign or partner reviews.

**6. KPI Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Own and maintain logistics dashboards covering OTIF, warehouse SLAs, dispatch lead times, return rates, claims and operational exceptions.
* Provide regular operational reporting to senior management on performance, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Drive continuous improvement projects in execution discipline, automation and process efficiency.

**7. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with planning, customer service, finance, IT and commercial teams to ensure logistics execution supports business priorities.
* Align shipment priorities with customer deadlines, launch calendars and replenishment plans.
* Maintain clear, structured communication across internal teams and external logistics stakeholders.

**Key Competencies**

* Builder mindset – energised by setting up new processes, partners and KPIs.
* Hands-on operational discipline.
* Strong execution and follow-up rigour.
* Ability to lead, coach and hold partners accountable, including under pressure.
* Problem-solving and structured escalation management.
* Resilience under transformation and ambiguity.
* Strong written and verbal communication across cultures and time zone

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering or related field.
* 6–10 years of relevant logistics operations experience, with at least 3 years in a leadership or managerial position.
* Strong, hands-on track record in 3PL warehouse governance, multi-carrier transport management and shipment execution.
* Demonstrated experience leading transformation, transitions or operational stand-ups.
* Prior experience in fashion, luxury, footwear, retail or premium consumer goods is highly preferred.
* Multi-country logistics experience preferred
* Familiarity with ERP and WMS systems and logistics KPI reporting.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Corporate Security is looking for an experienced, self-motivated, corporate security leader who embodies Amazon’s Leadership Principles, in particular, Customer Obsession, Ownership, Earn Trust, and Bias for Action, to join the team as an Area Security Manager for the Mid-Atlantic and Mid-West region.
  
  
The Area Security Manager reports to a Regional Security Manager, who leads a team of security experts. The Area Security Manager is responsible for implementation of all elements of the Corporate Security program at all Amazon corporate locations in their area of responsibility. The Area Security Manager supports the Regional Security Manager with delivery and oversight of the day-to-day security operations at multiple sites across multiple locations in a highly ambiguous and dynamically fluid environment. The Area Security Manager conducts security assessments, ensures that the corporate sites meet or exceed all requisite security standards, and manages incidents and supporting crisis response. Finally, the Area Security Manager provides security consultancy to local business leadership, develops plans to mitigate gaps in security controls, and manages the guarding and access control programs.  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Deliver best-in-class security services focused on enhancing the safety and security of all Amazon employees, contractors, and visitors.
  
  
Manage day-to-day security operations for a diverse portfolio of sites and customers with unique requirements.
  
  
Manage a team of security personnel.  
  
Implement and improve security plans, policies, and programs.
  
  
Coordinate security incident response.
  
  
Respond to customer security concerns.
  
  
Monitor the external threat environments in the defined area and take measures to minimize security risk to the business to the dynamic security environment.
  
  
Successfully align ACS metrics, goals, and strategic direction across the geographic area to support the overall team and organizational mission.
  
Earn trust through key customer and stakeholder engagements, and liaison with external partners.
  
  
Be the trusted security advisor and subject matter expert in the assigned area of responsibility, through high quality communication and excellent briefing skills.
  
  
Communicate accurately and in a timely manner with stakeholders at the tactical and strategic level.
  
  
Build and maintain close relationships with peers at other security functions at Amazon to exchange and share security concerns and collaborate on closing gaps and building best practices.
