Build relationships through coordination with internal and external security partners including local law enforcement.
  
  
Develop and monitor performance metrics to track and improve individual, team, system, and site performance. Implement effective, predictable, and measurable processes and procedures to be communicated clearly among Amazon stakeholders.
  
  
Develop and deliver plans, based on risk assessments, to close any potential gaps in security controls.
  
  
Conduct site security assessments and identify trends in findings and develop and implement measures to address systemic issues.
  
Plan and lead drills, tabletop exercises, and other security readiness activities across sites.
  
  
Manage cross-functional projects and operations. Drive team(s)/partners to meet program and/or product goals.
  
  
Conduct initial incident investigations, triage incidents and collaborate with specialist security teams to support the customer.
  
  
Coordinate corporate security support to events.

Title: MANAGER, CUSTOMER TECHNOLOGY IMPLEMENTATIONS
Description:
**WHO WE ARE**

GreenShield is a proudly Canadian, national non-profit health care and insurance organization, driven by our mission of Better Health for All. We believe health care is a right, not a privilege, and we are committed to improving health outcomes, advancing health equity, and building a future where every Canadian can reach their full health and well-being potential.

Title: Locating Operations Manager
Description:
**Company / division** Danella Line Services, Inc.

**Location** Delaware, field-based (service area: Delaware and Maryland's Eastern Shore, Cecil and Harford counties)

**Employment type** Full-time, on-site/field

**Reports to** Regional Manager, Delaware

**About the Role**
==================

At Danella, we believe in developing and retaining the best people and providing the best value services to our customers. We take pride in everything we do to maintain the nation's infrastructure by connecting people and resources.

Danella is hiring a Locating Operations Manager for our Locating Division, based in Delaware. Our locators mark underground electric, gas, fiber and telecom facilities for utility and cooperative customers across Delaware and Maryland. This position runs day-to-day locating operations so that every 811 ticket is completed safely, on time and profitably.

The Locating Operations Manager works directly with the Regional Manager, a team of locate supervisors, the field workforce, and our accounting and payroll staff. You will be responsible to manage the daily numbers: tickets completed, production per locator, overtime, timesheets, idle time, ticket deadlines and billing data. This role suits a hands-on leader who is able to hold supervisors accountable and develop teams.

**Responsibilities**
====================

The Locating Operations Manager is responsible for meeting our customers' on-time, quality and safety requirements while controlling labor cost. Strong communication with supervisors, locators, accounting and leadership is essential.

* Lead daily locating operations for 80+ locators and a team of locate supervisors across Delaware and Maryland
* Run a daily operations meeting with supervisors to review the prior day's production, overtime, idle time and open tickets, and assign follow-up
* Set clear production expectations (tickets per locator per day and per hour) and coaching locators who fall short of safety or production
* Monitor ticket boards through the day, rebalance workloads, reassign tickets when locators call out, and route emergency tickets to the closest available locator
* Manage ticket due times and extensions to meet on-time requirements and avoid late-ticket and no-response penalties, including end-of-day board checks on a rotating evening and weekend schedule
* Make daily overtime decisions based on production data: approve overtime where it protects on-time performance, and limit it where it does not
* Review and approve locator timesheets daily, verify hours against vehicle telematics, correct discrepancies, and make sure timesheets are submitted on time
* Maintain the daily roster of who is working, off, called out, in training or on hourly assignments
* Track idle time, late starts and mileage by locator, and follow up on outliers with supervisors
* Prepare weekly and monthly billing data by customer, including ticket counts, billing codes, emergency and after-hours work, and over-footage extra charges, and reconcile ticket-system data with accounting before invoicing
* Know the terms of each customer contract (on-time targets, extra-charge rules, audit, damage and penalty terms) and bring pricing or commercial questions to company leadership
* Review customer KPI reports and penalty notices each month, check them against our own data, and prepare disputes where the data supports one
* Recruit, onboard and train locators and supervisors, including trainee rotations and refresher training
* Promote a safe work environment, including safe vehicle parking and idling practices, highway work zones and required safety sweeps
* All other duties as assigned

  

**Qualifications**
==================

What is required:

* 3+ years of experience in leading underground utility locating or damage prevention programs
* Working knowledge of 811 / One Call processes, ticket due times, extensions and marking standards; experience with Miss Utility tickets in Delaware or Maryland strongly preferred
* Experience managing to production and on-time KPIs on unit-price or production-based contracts
* Experience with a ticket management system
* Comfort working from live data: dashboards, timesheet systems and vehicle telematics with strong Microsoft Excel skills
* Willingness to learn new software, including AI-assisted reporting tools
* Valid driver's license with a clean driving record
* Ability to pass a background screening, physical and drug test
* Strong supervisory, leadership and team management skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including difficult conversations about performance
* Strong organizational skills, with attention to detail and accuracy
* Calm, steady and solutions-focused under pressure
* Highly responsible, accountable and dependable

**Availability**
================

* Full-time, field-based role with daily travel across Delaware and Maryland
* Participation in a rotating evening and weekend on-call schedule for end-of-day ticket board checks and urgent tickets

**Workplace Policy**
====================

Danella maintains a workplace that is completely free of drugs and alcohol, and employees are subject to random drug testing.

**What We Offer You**
=====================

* Paid on-the-job technical and professional training
* Defined career path for future growth
* Competitive wages and great benefits, including a 401(k) plan match

Title: Senior Project Manager
Description:
**About Us**

Proserv is a global controls technology company with a heritage stretching back more than 60 years. We provide industry-leading solutions to improve the reliability, optimise the performance and extend the life of critical infrastructure across the energy sector.

Our team not only has the talent and technological expertise to deliver these transformative goals, but day-to-day, we hold to a clear set of FRESH Proserv values that underpins everything we do around the world.

So, if you believe you not only have the skills and know-how needed for this role, and you are a team player; keen to do things the right way; possess an inquisitive and creative mind; prioritise giving top-quality service and you enjoy helping and collaborating with colleagues or clients – then we really want to hear from you.

**What You Need to Know**

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for the safe, compliant, and profitable delivery of Proserv's Wellhead Control Panel (WHCP), Hydraulic Power Unit (HPU), and associated topside control system projects, from contract award through to final close-out.

Serving as the primary point of contact for clients, the role leads multidisciplinary project teams and coordinates activities across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, document control, logistics, finance, and field services to ensure successful project execution. The Senior Project Manager is accountable for managing scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and cash flow, while driving performance and ensuring timely decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.

The role provides technical leadership across hydraulic, mechanical, electrical, and control system disciplines, ensuring all design requirements, interfaces, battery limits, and acceptance criteria are clearly defined and effectively managed. Key project deliverables include engineering design documentation, hydraulic and electrical schematics, bills of materials, quality records, Design Verification Testing (DVT), Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Integrated Factory Acceptance Testing (IFAT), final certification packages, and successful equipment delivery.

Working closely with clients and internal stakeholders, the Senior Project Manager plays a critical role in achieving operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and commercial success while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, and within budget.

**What We Are Looking For**

Some of the Key Accountabilities:

* Lead the safe, compliant, and profitable execution of Wellhead Control Panel (WHCP), Hydraulic Power Unit (HPU), and associated control system projects from contract handover through to final close-out.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, building strong relationships and ensuring effective communication throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop and maintain project execution plans, ensuring delivery against agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality, and performance requirements.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary project teams across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, quality, logistics, finance, document control, and field service functions.
* Monitor and control project costs, revenue, cash flow, forecasts, risks, and change management activities to achieve commercial objectives.
* Provide leadership and direction to project teams, ensuring timely decision-making, issue resolution, and escalation of key risks and opportunities.
* Ensure compliance with contractual, regulatory, HSE, and quality requirements throughout project execution.
* Oversee the preparation, review, and approval of project deliverables, including engineering documentation, technical drawings, testing, certification, and final handover packages.
* Manage customer and stakeholder expectations, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and successful project outcomes.
* Support project reviews, lessons learned, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational performance and delivery excellence.
* Ensure successful completion of Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Integrated Factory Acceptance Testing (IFAT), commissioning support activities, and final project close-out.
* Contribute to business growth by identifying commercial opportunities, supporting bids and proposals, and maintaining strong client relationships.

**Qualifications / Skills & Experience**

Essential

* Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation, Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Controls, Hydraulic or a related engineering discipline; an equivalent recognized technical qualification may be considered with relevant experience.
* Typically 12-15 years' experience in project engineering or project management within oil and gas controls, with demonstrated responsibility for multidisciplinary project delivery.
* Practical experience with WHCP, HPU, hydraulic control systems, instrumentation, electrical panels or comparable engineered control packages.
* Sound understanding of hydraulic calculations, accumulators, pumps, valves, tubing systems, hazardous-area equipment, electrical and ICSS interfaces, testing and commissioning requirements.
* Proven ability to manage scope, schedule, cost, risk, change, quality, documentation, procurement, manufacturing and client interfaces across the full project lifecycle.
* Strong commercial awareness, including cost forecasting, margin protection, milestone invoicing, variation management and contractual correspondence.
* Experience using D365 or a comparable ERP platform together with MS Project, Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
* Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to lead technical and commercial discussions and produce clear management and client reports.
* Ability to work collaboratively across regional and global teams and to visit Proserv, supplier and client facilities as required.

Preferred

* PMP, PRINCE2 or an equivalent recognised project-management qualification.
* Experience with Primavera P6, Power BI and structured project-control reporting.
* Knowledge of relevant client specifications, ISO management systems, IEC/ATEX hazardous-area requirements and functional-safety or SIL principles applicable to wellhead controls.
* Experience with DVT, FAT, IFAT, third-party inspection, final documentation dossiers and site commissioning support.
* Previous delivery experience in the Middle East and with EPC contractors and national or international oil companies

**Why Choose Us**

At Proserv, we are guided by our core FRESH values, which shape our culture and drive our success. Be a part of a global company that values innovation, technology, and continuous learning where you will have opportunities for professional development and growth within the energy sector.

* Attractive compensation package
* Medical coverage

Title: Drilling Engineering Manager
Description:
**About DrillDocs**

Founded in 2020, DrillDocs helps offshore drilling teams make better decisions in complex well construction environments. We combine edge computer vision, smart cameras, and advanced cloud data analytics to deliver continuous, real-time measurements of Cuttings Returns Rate (CRR), Accumulated Cuttings Recovery (ACR), Cuttings Size Distribution (CSD), and Cavings / Unidentified Falling Objects (UFOs) directly from shale shakers.

Our mission is to establish our proprietary platform, CleanSight, as the recognized **Standard of Care** for offshore and high-risk drilling operations worldwide—transforming uninstrumented shaker returns into actionable wellbore stability and hole-cleaning intelligence that eliminates non-productive time (NPT) and prevents costly downhole incidents.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and technically credible **Drilling Engineering Manager** to serve as our senior drilling engineering authority and operational leader. In this pivotal role, you will report directly to the **Operations Manager** and lead both the **Drilling Engineering / Customer Support Engineering** group and the **24/7 Remote Monitoring (RM) team**.

You will bridge the gap between cutting-edge computer vision data and offshore drilling execution. Your mission is to provide expert wellbore analysis, lead real-time advice during critical drilling events, guide remote analysts in logging structured operational data, and partner directly with operator drilling teams to embed our real-time measurements into standard operating procedures and daily wellsite decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities1. Drilling Engineering Advisory, Hole Section Analysis & Optimization**

* **ROP Optimization:** Champion real-time drilling frameworks to include pack-off detection and systematically identify intervals where Rate of Penetration (ROP) can be safely increased based on real-time Cuttings Returns Rate (CRR) and shaker evacuation capacity.
* **Circulation Clean-Up Cycle (CBU) Optimization:** Champion structured clean-up frameworks (e.g., Terminate-on-Baseline clean-up cycles), comparing real-time cuttings evacuation against theoretical bottom-up volumes to safely optimize circulation times prior to tripping.
* **Real-Time & Post-Operations Analysis:** Monitor and evaluate active hole sections to demonstrate and quantify exactly where shaker telemetry provides operational decision-making value, both in real time and during post-section reviews.
* **Wellbore Dynamics & Hydraulics:** Analyze drilling mechanics, hydraulics, cuttings return rates, and cavings alerts to detect early indicators of tight hole, pack-off risks, borehole instability, and formation washouts.

**2. Leadership & Management of the Remote Monitoring (RM) Team**

* **24/7 Remote Operations Center (ROC) Leadership:** Directly manage, mentor, and schedule the global Remote Monitoring Analyst team staffing our 24/7 operational center.
* **Support & Quality Control:** Oversee live shift handovers, incident escalation pathways, and alert verification to ensure rig crews and operator engineering offices receive technically rigorous, timely notifications.
* **Workflow Automation & Capacity Building:** Partner with software engineering to automate routine manual logging and backfilling, elevating analyst focus toward capturing high-value operational logs, caving events, and clean-up data.
* **Performance & Training:** Establish and track standard Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Quality Management (SQM) protocols across the RM roster.

**3. Client Technical Representation & Workflow Institutionalization**

* **Technical Relationship Building:** Build strong, peer-to-peer technical credibility with operator drilling superintendents, wellsite supervisors, operations geologists, and asset drilling engineers.
* **Standard Operating Procedure Integration:** Guide the formal adoption of real-time shaker metrics into operator governing documentation, including Rig Action Plans (RAPs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and Daily Drilling Reports (DDRs).
* **New Deployment Onboarding:** Lead the drilling engineering onboarding and crew orientation for newly mobilizing offshore assets, conducting pre-spud walkthroughs and defining alert thresholds.
* **Routine Operational Syncs:** Conduct recurring technical syncs with operator lead engineers to review interval performance, answer complex operational inquiries, and communicate new software capabilities.

**4. Advanced Visualization & Product Requirements**

* **Analytics Platform Deployment:** Evaluate and configure customer-facing analytics and real-time visualization environments (such as SDP Live, Corva, and Grafana) to ensure clients have optimal dashboard layouts for their specific operational roles.
* **Unified Hole-Cleaning Dashboards:** Collaborate with system architects and data engineering teams to design composite plots correlating Cuttings Returns Rate (CRR), Accumulated Cuttings Recovery (ACR), theoretical hole volume, PWD/ECD, and lithology.
* **Product Feedback Loop:** Act as the internal "voice of the drilling customer," converting field observations into structured functional requirements for the technology and software development teams.

**5. Case Histories, Industry Papers & Knowledge Repository**

* **Operational Evidence Ledger:** Build and govern a comprehensive corporate repository documenting every clean-up cycle advisory, caving event, and verified downhole anomaly across the fleet.
* **Attributable Value Documentation:** Partner with executive leadership to author and publish quantitative technical case studies that calculate tangible time and dollar savings (e.g., avoided stuck-pipe NPT and saved rig circulation hours).
* **Technical Publications:** Author and co-author peer-reviewed technical conference papers (SPE/IADC) with operator engineering teams to establish the technology's value in the broader scientific and industrial literature.

**Candidate Qualifications**

**Required Experience & Skills**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Petroleum Engineering, Drilling Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* **Drilling Domain Experience:** 10+ years of progressive offshore drilling engineering experience with an exploration & production operator, or top-tier directional drilling/service provider.
* **Offshore Drilling Mastery:** Hands-on offshore drilling experience with a deep technical understanding of offshore drilling environments (floaters and premium jackups), including wellbore hydraulics, hole cleaning mechanics, stuck-pipe prevention, and borehole stability.
* **Team Leadership:** Demonstrated experience managing, mentoring, or leading drilling engineers and technical operations/monitoring personnel either onsite in a 24/7 operational or in a real-time operations center (RTOC) environment.
* **Technical Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of authoring concise technical reports, operational procedures, or peer-reviewed engineering literature.
* **Data Literacy:** Strong proficiency in evaluating time-series drilling data (WITSML, EDR, PWD, mud logs) and working with digital analytics dashboards.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Computer Literacy & Coding:** Overall computer literacy with practical coding experience (e.g., Python, SQL, or R) for data analysis and process automation.
* **Startup Culture:** Comfort operating in an agile, distributed technology startup culture utilizing collaboration tools such as Asana and Google Workspace in a virtual environment.
* **Travel & Certifications:** US/Canada/UK/Europe passport and willingness to travel 30%-40% per year with BOSIET/HUET training.
* **Publications:** Direct authorship or co-authorship of peer-reviewed SPE or IADC conference papers.
* **Solids Control & Shakers:** Hands-on familiarity with solids control equipment, shale shaker operations, and cuttings/cavings characterization.
* **Oilfield Analytics Platforms:** Experience with digital oilfield analytics platforms (e.g., SDP Live, Corva, Grafana, Petrolink).
* **Service Company Background:** Prior experience working with a major oilfield service company.
* **Languages:** Fluency in a second language relevant to international offshore operations.

**What We Offer**

* **Competitive Compensation:** Competitive base salary ($150,000 to $210,000) commensurate with experience, plus bonus and equity participation options.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Premium medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage; 401(k) retirement plan.
* **Flexible Remote Model:** Fully remote working environment with periodic travel for client technical meetings, company business conferences, and operational visits.
* **High-Impact Leadership:** Direct influence over the strategic and operational trajectory of a rapidly scaling industrial AI and energy technology company.

Pay: $150,000.00 - $210,000.00 per year

Own the operational blueprint for scaling markets through distinct growth phases — from launch (0–5K orders/day) through rapid growth (5K–20K) to mature operations (20K+). * Identify when manual processes become unsustainable and scope automation requirements — auto-dispatch rules, automated vendor scoring, self-serve CS tools — then work with Product/Tech to build them.

* Act as primary Operations liaison for Product and Tech — translate real scaling pain points into product requirements and feature requests.

**Business Operations Manager**

*• Business Development • Dubai, UAE • Justlife*

Right now, thousands of people in the UAE book a cleaner through Justlife and expect them to show up on time, do excellent work, and leave their home better than they found it. That promise only holds if the cleaners are there, trained, motivated, and routed efficiently — which means someone has to own the daily operating reality of that supply chain: keeping cleaners deployed, partners accountable, costs disciplined, and quality high.

This is an operations role, not a strategy role. You'll run the DTC home cleaning business end-to-end — 300+ cleaners across multiple partner companies, a small on-ground team of account executives and roster agents, and **measurable improvement in on-time performance, completion rates, and contribution margin within your first six months**. Every day you'll make decisions that move the numbers: which partner hires next, how to incentivise productivity, where fuel and routing waste money, whether we're hitting our supply plan. This is what it means to own a real business line.

**You'll love this role if you...**

* You think in unit economics and get frustrated when a cost lever stays hidden in a spreadsheet instead of being fixed
* You've run a large field or blue-collar workforce (directly or through partners) and know exactly how to hold external teams accountable without being their boss
* You're energised by problems you can see and touch — you'd rather spend an hour in a van or at a partner accommodation than sit in a meeting
* You build teams that work without you, and you actively coach people into bigger roles
* You obsess over data quality because you know bad reports kill decisions, and you'll learn SQL or Power BI yourself rather than wait for someone to build your dashboard

**What you'll own**

* **Drive sustained improvement in on-time %, completion rate %, promise-kept %, and absent rate %** by building daily operating discipline — reviewing metrics with the team each morning, identifying blockers, and acting on them before they compound into service failures.
* Lead and develop the on-ground operations team (2 account executives and 4 remote roster agents): set clear priorities, review performance daily, coach individuals toward higher capability, and manage accountability.
* Own supply planning and growth: forecast cleaner headcount needed against demand by city and partner, manage onboarding pace and allocation across partner companies, and reduce time-to-deployment so new hires contribute faster.
* Manage partner companies as senior counterparts: run monthly business reviews, hold them to service-level agreements and commercial terms, reconcile statements of account with finance monthly, and escalate issues before they become crises.
* Design and drive cost and process projects that improve contribution margin — incentive structure redesigns, fuel and fleet controls, van routing optimisation, cleaner orientation and training — taking each from idea to measurable result.
* Build and maintain reporting that surfaces what's driving performance: which partners are slipping, where attrition is highest, which cost levers moved margin, what's blocking supply. Act on what it shows.
* Spend meaningful time in the field — in vans, accommodations, and partner sites — so you understand problems first-hand and your team sees you do the same.

**What tells us you're the one**

* You've **measurably improved operational metrics across a large field workforce** — *tell us a specific program you ran (incentive redesign, routing optimisation, vendor onboarding, training rollout, etc.) and the metric that moved as a result: completion rate up X%, on-time performance improved Y%, attrition fell Z%, or margin lifted by N%*.
* You can spot cause and effect: when a metric moves, you know whether it's partner execution, process design, incentive misalignment, or something else — and you know how to test your hypothesis before rolling out a fix.
* You've managed blue-collar, field-based, or logistics workforces (home services, facilities management, staffing, last-mile delivery, quick commerce) — or run marketplace operations where supply quality depends on external partners. Results matter far more than years, but 5–7 years of this kind of work is the sweet spot.
* You're fluent in data: you can build operating reports independently, interrogate a spreadsheet without help, and use SQL, Power BI, or AI tools to automate manual reporting so you have time to think.
* You speak fluent English, written and spoken. Bonus: you speak languages common to the workforce in the UAE (Tagalog, Urdu, Arabic), or you have prior experience operating in the UAE market in home services, logistics, or staffing.

**Why Justlife**

* **Scale and impact:** You'll run a real, revenue-generating business line serving thousands of customers across the UAE, managing hundreds of cleaners and multiple partner companies, with direct line of sight from your decisions to customer satisfaction and margin.
* **Clear growth path:** this role is a launchpad into broader category leadership, multi-city operations, or general management as we scale across the GCC.
* **Close partnership with leadership:** you'll work alongside the Business Development lead and the founding team, with real influence on strategy and resource decisions.
* **A fair, performance-driven culture:** you'll be measured on the metrics you own, recognised through our JustHeroes program, and rewarded for results — not politics.
* **Startup benefits:** a birthday day off (JustHoliday), free Justlife service credits, referral bonuses, and regular team experiences.

***Join the tribe and let's become #everydaybetter, together.***

Title: Manager, Business Operations Analyst

* A united, values-driven culture that genuinely cares about people, collaboration, and community.
* A comprehensive total rewards package, including Traditional Spending Account (TSA) and Health Care Spending Account (HCSA) coverage to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being.

* **ServiceNow Expertise (Mandatory):** Proven, hands-on experience acting as a Business Analyst on **ServiceNow implementations**, with a deep understanding of the platform's workflows and capabilities.

* Strong change management capabilities to drive continuous improvement and adapt to evolving business needs.
* Demonstrated commitment to delivering an exceptional customer experience and a proven ability to build long-term, trusting relationships with clients.
* Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and adapt to evolving market and operational requirements.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a data-driven approach to decision-making.

Title: Director of Channel Partnerships
Description:
**Director of Channel Partnerships**

Referral & Revenue-Share Partnerships | Kleer Circle (kleercircle.com)

**The Opportunity**

Kleer Circle is hiring a Director of Channel Partnerships to build and scale a revenue-generating network of referral and audience partners serving high-income professionals and business owners. You will personally source, negotiate, close, and activate revenue-share and referral partnerships with wealth managers, CPA firms, financial publishers, podcasts, cost segregation companies, and other aligned organizations.

Our target customers are high-earning W-2 professionals and business owners who earn several hundred thousand dollars annually and pay $50,000 or more in annual taxes. We are looking for someone who can identify the organizations and trusted advisors already serving these customers - and turn those relationships into productive, revenue-generating partnerships.

You will own the full partnership lifecycle: sourcing, outreach, negotiation, deal structure, closing, activation, and expansion.

This is a hands-on, new-partner acquisition role - not primarily an account-management position. You must have personally sourced and closed partnerships that produced measurable revenue, not simply managed relationships after agreements were signed.

We need someone who has successfully built this type of channel before - not someone who wants to learn partnership sales on the job.

**What You Will Own**

**Source and close strategic partners**

- Identify and prioritize partners whose clients or audiences closely match Kleer Circle's ideal customer profile.

- Build a repeatable outbound motion targeting decision-makers at advisory firms, financial services businesses, publishers, podcasts, and other relevant organizations.

- Run the entire sales process, from first outreach through signed agreement and launch.

- Build relationships with owners, executives, advisors, and audience operators who can become meaningful distribution partners.

**Structure commercially sound deals**

- Develop and negotiate revenue-share, referral, affiliate, co-marketing, and other partnership arrangements appropriate to each relationship.

- Model partnership economics, including acquisition costs, revenue potential, partner payouts, and contribution margin.

- Establish clear expectations for promotion, lead qualification, attribution, reporting, payment terms, and accountability.

- Coordinate with leadership and legal or compliance advisors to ensure proposed arrangements are appropriate before launch.

**Turn signed agreements into revenue**

- Build activation plans with each partner, including introductions, email campaigns, webinars, podcast integrations, and other relevant initiatives.

- Work with internal teams to create partner messaging, sales materials, and effective prospect handoffs.

- Track the funnel from partner activity through qualified leads, closed customers, and collected revenue.

- Expand productive relationships, fix underperforming programs, and exit partnerships that do not justify the investment.

**Build the partnership function**

- Establish the CRM discipline, pipeline reporting, forecasting, and operating cadence for the channel.

- Create repeatable partner recruitment, onboarding, and management playbooks.

- Bring market feedback to leadership to improve positioning, offers, and conversion.

- Help define when and how to add resources as the channel demonstrates repeatable results.

**Who You Are**

You have a demonstrated record of personally sourcing, structuring, closing, and growing revenue-generating channel partnerships.

- Proven success negotiating revenue-share, referral, affiliate, or comparable performance-based commercial agreements.

- Experience reaching affluent consumers, high-income professionals, business owners, or closely related customer segments through trusted intermediaries.

- Relevant relationships (or ability to create these relationships) across wealth management, accounting, financial media, investing communities, real estate services, or adjacent markets.

- Demonstrated success in advisor partnerships (such as CPAs and wealth managers) or audience partnerships (such as newsletters, podcasts, and publishers), with credible evidence you can execute across both.

- Strong financial judgment: you can distinguish an attractive partnership announcement from an economically attractive distribution channel.

- The ability to sell to sophisticated counterparties and navigate multiple stakeholders without losing momentum.

- An operator's discipline around follow-through, attribution, forecasting, and measurable results.

- The willingness to do the work yourself - from prospect research and outbound outreach to contract negotiation and partner activation.

Experience in tax-related services, wealth management, alternative investments, financial publishing, or other trust-intensive businesses is especially relevant.

**What Success Looks Like**

You will be measured on business outcomes - not networking activity or the number of agreements signed.

- Partner-sourced collected revenue and contribution margin.

- Qualified pipeline generated through partners.

- Number of active, productive partnerships.

- Time from signed agreement to first qualified opportunity and first revenue.

- Partner-level acquisition economics and conversion rates.

- Revenue growth and durability across the partner portfolio.

**How to Apply**

Submit your resume and a brief summary of two or three partnerships you personally sourced and closed. For each, include:

- The partner type and target customer.

- Your specific role in sourcing, negotiating, and activating the relationship.

- The commercial structure, described at a level that respects confidentiality.

- The revenue or other measurable business results generated.

- How long the partnership took to become productive.

We care most about what you have built, what it produced, and whether you can do it again.

Pay: $250,000.00 - $350,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

Title: NetOps Engineering Manager

Description:

This leader combines deep network engineering expertise, strong people leadership, and a modern NetOps mindset. * Ensure accurate documentation, standards, procedures, and operational runbooks.

* Manage vendor relationships, support audits and compliance initiatives, and help align engineering priorities with organizational goals.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience); advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in enterprise networking, infrastructure services, and IT operations, including network engineering and operational leadership responsibilities.
* Strong expertise in enterprise WAN routing, LAN switching, wireless networking, network access controls, data center connectivity, segmentation, high-availability design, and performance troubleshooting.
* Experience with network automation and NetOps practices, including Azure DevOps, source control, automation pipelines, Ansible, Python, and infrastructure-as-code concepts.
* Demonstrated success leading teams in 24x7 production environments, including incident response and operational support.
* Proven people leadership or management experience, including coaching, performance management, mentoring, and team development

Title: Strategic Sourcing Manager, Technology and Software
Description:
The **Strategic Sourcing Manager, Technology and Software** owns category strategy, the supplier model, and commercial outcomes for an assigned category or category cluster, translating business priorities into sourcing strategies that optimize cost, quality, service, risk, and overall value. This role partners with senior business stakeholders to understand demand, define category buying rules and buy channels, and serves as the primary face of Strategic Sourcing for the categories it owns.

  
  

The Strategic Sourcing Manager leads complex and high-risk sourcing deals, including RFx, total cost of ownership analysis, negotiation, and contracting, and governs strategic and critical suppliers through renewal and exit. The role analyzes the category portfolio for sole source, high-risk, and critical suppliers and owns the strategies, exit plans, and mitigation actions for them, agreed with the Critical Vendor Program Lead and business stakeholders. The role remains accountable for value realization through go-live and provides a development path toward the Director, Strategic Sourcing role.

Within the Strategic Sourcing organization model, this role is the Category Lead tier, owning a $75M–$125M category or category cluster, primarily US-based where key stakeholders sit.

  

**Primary Job Accountabilities/Responsibilities**

* Develop and own the category strategy, supplier model, and sourcing roadmap for assigned categories, aligned with enterprise business objectives and financial goals.
* Define the buy channel strategy for assigned categories with business stakeholders and agree it with Operations, supporting Operations with tracking and governance of adoption. Operations owns implementation.
* Own the stakeholder relationship and act as the primary face of Strategic Sourcing, partnering with senior leaders and functional stakeholders to understand business requirements, demand, market conditions, and opportunities to improve value.
* Lead complex and high-risk sourcing deals, including RFIs, RFPs, competitive bids, supplier evaluations, and contracting strategies, developing negotiation strategies based on supplier economics and should-cost analysis and leading commercial negotiations for significant supplier relationships.
* Identify and deliver sustainable cost savings, cost avoidance, and other sources of measurable business value, maintaining an agreed savings pipeline and tracking benefits through go-live.
* Govern strategic and critical suppliers, including segmentation, performance management, renewals, and exits, and monitor performance against contractual commitments, service levels, financial expectations, and other key performance indicators.
* Analyze the category portfolio to identify sole source, high-risk, and critical suppliers, and develop strategies, exit plans, and mitigation actions for them, agreed with the Critical Vendor Program Lead and the business stakeholder, guiding suppliers on required risk mitigations.
* Partner with Legal, Finance, Risk, Information Security, Technology, Compliance, and other stakeholders to identify and manage contractual, operational, financial, regulatory, and third-party risks.
* Assess external markets, supplier capabilities, industry trends, and economic conditions to inform category strategies and business decisions.
* Work with Sourcing Managers and pooled Global Capability Center (GCC) analysts supporting the category, agreeing priorities and quality standards and ensuring a clean implementation hand-off.
* Develop business cases and recommendations for significant sourcing and supplier decisions and present recommendations to senior leadership.
* Promote appropriate competitive sourcing, purchasing discipline, and contract compliance, and keep Operations updated on category strategy, preferred supply, spot buys, tail spend, renewals, and buy channels.
* Support broader transformation initiatives involving procurement technology, spend analytics, supplier management, automation, and process optimization.

**Strategic Sourcing & Category Management**  
Sets category strategy, demand, and buying rules based on business requirements, spend analysis, supplier markets, and risk.

  
  

**Commercial & Financial Acumen**  
Applies supplier economics, should-cost, and total cost of ownership analysis to build effective sourcing and negotiation strategies.

  
  

**Negotiation & Contract Strategy**  
Leads complex and high-risk negotiations and develops commercial strategies that balance economics, service, flexibility, performance, and risk.

  
  

**Supplier & Third-Party Management**  
Governs strategic and critical suppliers, builds mitigation and exit plans for sole source and high-risk suppliers, and drives accountability for performance, value realization, and risk management.

  
  

**Strategic Partnership & Influence**  
Builds credibility with senior stakeholders, challenges requirements, and influences decisions across organizational boundaries without relying solely on direct authority.

  
  

**Market Intelligence & Analytics**  
Uses spend data, market intelligence, benchmarking, and supplier insights to identify opportunities and support fact-based decision-making.

  
  

**Transformation & Continuous Improvement**  
Challenges existing approaches and identifies opportunities to improve sourcing processes, technology, governance, and category performance.

  
  

**Collaboration & Development**  
Works effectively with Sourcing Managers, pooled GCC analysts, Operations, and stakeholders, and sets clear priorities and quality standards for category work.

  

**Scope & Decision-Making**

Operates with a high degree of autonomy within an assigned $75M–$125M category or category cluster and is accountable for supplier and stakeholder outcomes. This role has no direct reports. Escalates non-standard risk, value, and commercial positions that extend beyond the category to the Director, Strategic Sourcing.

**Key Performance Metrics**

* Category strategy in place for each assigned category, and sourcing pipeline updated at all times.
* Savings pipeline agreed with the Director, Strategic Sourcing, working toward annual savings of 6%–8% of addressable spend.
* Approximately 80% of category spend under management, with 80%+ contract compliance.
* Phased plan to deliver a buy channel strategy for assigned categories, agreed with Operations and stakeholders, with adoption building over time toward 70%–80% of category spend (Operations owns implementation; Sourcing supports tracking and governance).
Risk and exit plans in place and agreed with the Critical Vendor Program Lead for all sole source and critical suppliers in the category.  

**Required Experience, Skills, and Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in category management, strategic sourcing, procurement, supplier management, or a related discipline.
* Deep category and market expertise, with demonstrated experience developing, executing, and optimizing category strategies.
* Strong knowledge of supplier economics, should-cost analysis, and negotiation strategy, with experience leading complex commercial negotiations.
* Demonstrated experience in RFx design, contracting, and total cost of ownership analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with, challenge, and influence senior stakeholders, supported by sound commercial judgment.
* Strong financial, analytical, problem-solving, and business-case development capabilities.
* Strong understanding of contract management, supplier governance, and third-party risk principles.
* Experience within a complex, global, highly regulated, or financial-services organization is preferred.
* Professional procurement or supply-chain certification (such as CPSM, CIPS, or equivalent) is preferred.
* Experience identifying sole source and critical suppliers and
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Enterprise Architecture, IT Operations, Information Security, Technology Finance, Legal, and business stakeholders to align sourcing strategies with enterprise technology roadmaps, cybersecurity requirements, financial objectives, and organizational priorities.
* Strong understanding of technology-related contractual provisions, including software licensing rights, data protection, cybersecurity requirements, intellectual property, service-level agreements (SLAs), audit rights, limitation of liability, termination rights, and exit and transition provisions.
* Demonstrated ability to engage, challenge, and influence senior technology and business stakeholders, translating complex technical requirements and supplier proposals into commercially sound sourcing strategies and recommendations.
* Strong financial, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience evaluating software pricing models, supplier proposals, cost-benefit analyses, technology investment business cases, and multi-year contractual commitments.
* Experience managing strategic technology supplier relationships, including supplier performance management, governance, commercial risk assessment, contract lifecycle management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Understanding of emerging technology trends, including artificial intelligence (AI), cloud computing, automation, cybersecurity, and evolving enterprise software delivery and licensing models, and their implications for technology sourcing strategies
* Experience identifying sole-source, highly concentrated, and business-critical software suppliers, including evaluating vendor lock-in, switching costs, operational dependencies, and potential risk mitigation and exit strategies.

Title: Director
Description:
The Americas GSI team builds and runs Rubrik's go-to-market with the world's largest system integrators, including Accenture, Deloitte, Cognizant, HCLTech, Infosys, Kyndryl, TCS, Wipro, LTIMindtree, and others.

We make Rubrik part of how GSIs deliver cyber resilience to enterprise customers: sourcing pipeline, co-selling with Rubrik's field, and building joint offerings and managed services around Rubrik.

Our structure has three parts: Global Account Managers (GAMs) who own executive relationships with each GSI, specialty sellers who drive workload-specific motions such as Microsoft 365 and Identity Resilience, and BDMs who convert partner relationships into pipeline, deals, and enabled partner teams.

We work daily with Rubrik AEs, SEs, Regional Directors, Marketing, Partner Programs, Product, and the Microsoft and cloud alliance teams, and we are part of a global GSI organization.

**What This Role Will Be Doing****:**

* Build and lead the BDM organization for the Americas, and own the Sell-Through and Sell-With motions across all strategic GSIs.
* Sell-Through: drive GSI-led and services-led deals where the partner is the primary route to the customer, including partner-sourced new-logo (PSNL) and partner-sourced expansion (PSX) opportunities, deal registration, and managed service offerings.
* Sell-With: orchestrate co-sell between GSI account teams and Rubrik's AEs, SEs, and Regional Directors on named accounts, with clear account ownership, joint plans, and minimal channel conflict.
* Set a common operating model for all BDMs: target account planning, pipeline generation, weekly deal reviews, forecast, and Salesforce data quality.
* Work with the GAMs, who report to the RVP, so every GSI has one coordinated plan covering executive relationships, pipeline, enablement, and joint offerings.
* Align BDMs with the specialty sellers on joint solution plays such as Microsoft 365 and Identity Resilience, so partner motions are consistent and not duplicated.
* Own pipeline and bookings targets for the BDM organization, and report progress, risks, and wins to the RVP, global GSI leadership, and executive stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**:
  
  
*Leadership and Team Building*

* Hire, coach, and develop BDMs; set clear goals, territories or partner assignments, and performance expectations.
* Create a culture of accountability, urgency, and collaboration with AEs, SEs, GAMs, and specialty sellers.
* Build repeatable playbooks for pipeline generation, partner engagement, deal support, and win capture.

*Pipeline and Revenue*

* Own a quarterly pipeline and bookings plan across all GSIs, with a clear split between sell-through and sell-with.
* Drive account mapping and target list creation with each GSI and Rubrik's field, prioritized by customer fit, partner presence, and deal potential.
* Run the weekly cadence: pipeline reviews, deal inspections, commit and forecast, and escalation of blockers.
* Hold the team to disciplined Salesforce hygiene, including partner attribution, account categorization, and deal registration.

*Partner Programs and Enablement*

* Ensure each GSI has a joint business plan, named target accounts, executive sponsors, and quarterly milestones.
* Lead sales and technical enablement for GSI sellers, architects, and delivery teams on Rubrik's Cloud Resilience, Identity Resilience, and Microsoft 365 value.
* Partner with Product, Product Marketing, and Partner Programs on joint offerings, pricing and packaging guidance, and repeatable assets.

*Field Alignment and Visibility*

* Establish rules of engagement with Rubrik Sales Leadership and Regional Directors on account ownership, deal registration, and partner involvement.
* Plan joint campaigns, workshops, and executive briefings with Marketing and each GSI.
* Publish win stories and references; provide a weekly and quarterly view of partner performance to leadership.

**Why This Role, and Why Rubrik, Right Now**:

* Build a function, not maintain one. You will define how Rubrik runs sell-through and sell-with across every strategic GSI in the Americas, with real latitude to set the operating model and build the team.
* A category with urgency behind it. Ransomware, identity attacks, cloud complexity, and AI adoption have made cyber resilience a board-level priority, and GSIs are leading much of that work.
* One platform, several partner plays. Rubrik's story spans data protection, cyber recovery, Cloud Resilience, Identity Resilience, and Microsoft 365, so your BDMs can bring GSIs a bigger and more strategic conversation than a single-product vendor can.
* GSIs are a strategic priority, not a side channel. GSI leadership reports into the Chief Solutions Officer organization, with dedicated GAMs, specialty sellers, and BDMs working as one team on the same accounts.
* Leadership visibility. You report to the Americas GSI RVP in a global GSI organization, and early wins will be seen by senior leaders and shape how Rubrik works with GSIs worldwide.
* Momentum and scale. Rubrik is a publicly traded company with a growing enterprise footprint, giving you resources, credibility with partners, and room to grow.

**Required Qualifications****:**

* 12+ years in enterprise software, cybersecurity, or data protection, including 5+ years leading partner, alliance, or business development teams.
* Proven record of building and scaling teams that generate pipeline and close six- and seven-figure deals through GSIs or large services partners.
* Deep understanding of how GSIs operate: account teams, practices, delivery, and services-led deal structures, and how to drive both sell-through and co-sell.
* Experience working across direct sales and partner organizations, including territory and account ownership and channel conflict management.
* Strong forecasting, operating rhythm, and Salesforce discipline; ability to run a metrics-driven team.
* Excellent executive presence, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work across time zones with partner teams in the US and India; travel of approximately 30-40%.

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Established relationships with major GSIs, such as Accenture, Deloitte, HCLTech, Cognizant, Infosys, Wipro, Kyndryl, TCS, and LTIMindtree.
* Background in data protection, cyber resilience, or cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with Microsoft, AWS, or Google Cloud co-sell and marketplace motions.
* Familiarity with MEDDPICC and partner-led deal registration processes.

Title: MSSP Manager (Cybersecurity Managed Security Services)
Description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

**\*\*\*Position is Contingent Upon Award\*\*\***
-------------------------------------------------

**About the role**
------------------

Peraton is hiring an MSSP Manager for a managed security services program supporting a federal critical infrastructure customer in the Pacific Northwest. The program protects the customer's corporate and operational technology (OT) networks and supports compliance with federal and electric-sector cybersecurity requirements.

The MSSP Manager leads the Peraton team across eight service areas: security assessment, digital forensics and incident response, communications and data analysis, Splunk expert consulting, tools and infrastructure support, 24x7x365 Security Operations Center (SOC) operations, technology evolution and automation, and surge support. The MSSP Manager is Peraton's Management Representative and the single point of contact to the customer's Contracting Officer (CO) and Contracting Officer's Representative (COR). The customer provides objectives and service levels to the MSSP Manager, who assigns and supervises the work of Peraton staff. Technology evolution and automation has no separate position: the MSSP Manager owns AI governance, the SOC Lead owns SOAR and detection automation, and the Tools and Infrastructure Specialist administers the XSOAR platform.

The position requires experience managing a 24x7 SOC or managed security program and taking over an operation that is already running.

**What you will do**
--------------------

Program leadership and contract performance

* Serve as the Management Representative, with full authority to adjust schedules, reallocate staff across service areas, and commit Peraton to corrective action
* Receive all customer objectives, service level agreements (SLAs), and priorities, and assign the work to service area leads
* Maintain Peraton's independent contractor role: customer staff set outcomes, and Peraton supervises Peraton staff
* Lead development of the SLA matrix with the customer within 30 days of award, and track performance against it
* Own the reporting rhythm: daily operations status, weekly status reports, monthly reports, and quarterly business reviews
* Lead the kickoff meeting within 5 business days of contract award, the communications and escalation matrix within 5 business days, the RACI (responsibility) matrix within 10 business days, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) within 90 days of contract commencement
* Track staffing, travel, tools, and contract deliverables against contract requirements

Security operations

* Provide direction for 24x7x365 SOC operations, including shift structure, handovers, on-call rotation, and minimum staffing on every shift
* Set and manage SOC performance measures, including mean time to detect, investigate, recover, and resolve (MTTD, MTTI, MTTR)
* Oversee monitoring, analysis, and response using SIEM (Splunk), EDR, SOAR, and related tools, working with the dedicated Splunk Architect, who is responsible for Splunk content and platform engineering
* Oversee the collection and use of log, network flow, packet, context, and threat intelligence data, and recommend new data sources
* Lead escalation of significant incidents, including suspected nation-state activity and events involving federal partners, and coordinate evidence handoff to the customer's Forensics Team
* Recommend security changes (firewall and IDS/IPS rules, access control lists, patching, certificates, privileged access) through the customer's change management process
* Keep SOPs, playbooks, and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) current as threats and technology change

People and staffing

* Lead a team of about 20 analysts, engineers, assessors, and forensic specialists through service area leads
* Confirm every team member is fully qualified, credentialed, and cleared before they start work
* Replace any team member the customer finds unqualified or unsuitable within 20 business days, while keeping coverage in place
* Run the access lifecycle with the security team: onboarding, badging, required training, regular login checks, lost badge reporting within 1 hour, access revocation notice within 4 hours, and badge return within 24 hours
* Monitor staff conduct and system use against customer policies, and keep the records
* Manage performance, retention, cross-training, and succession so the team keeps its depth

Surge, transition, and technology

* Activate and lead surge support when the customer requests added capacity for major incidents, critical zero-day vulnerabilities, urgent assessments, or audits, without pulling staff from base operations
* Oversee transition-in from the current provider, led by the Transition Lead, including knowledge transfer and Day 1 readiness, and maintain the transition-out plan
* Own AI governance for the program and serve as the point of contact for the NIST AI Risk Management Framework
* Prepare the documentation the customer's COR needs before approving any AI or machine learning tool, covering the tool's function, data processing, and security controls
* Ensure AI tools act only in an advisory role: an analyst approves any containment action, case closure, or formal report, and the factors behind each AI recommendation can be explained
* Ensure customer data is not used to train or improve AI models and does not leave customer networks without explicit authorization, and that AI use complies with DOE orders and federal requirements
* Track new security technologies and recommend upgrades and integrations to the customer, working with the SOC Lead and the Tools and Infrastructure Specialist
* Review and approve reports, data call responses, and threat briefings before they go to the customer

##### **Qualifications**

**Required:**
-------------

* U.S. citizenship
* Ability to pass a Public Trust background investigation and a drug screening before start
* Ability to obtain and maintain a DOE L clearance (an active DOE L or DoD Secret is strongly preferred)
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, cybersecurity, information technology, or a related field
* 12 or more years of cybersecurity experience, including at least 5 years leading a 24x7 SOC, managed security service, or similar operations team
* Active industry cybersecurity certification at start, such as CISSP or CISM
* Working knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, NIST SP 800-37 Rev. 2, NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3, NIST SP 800-171, NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, NERC CIP, FedRAMP, FISMA, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework
* Hands-on understanding of SIEM operations, ideally Splunk, and of incident response and threat analysis
* Experience managing to contract SLAs and deliverables for a government or regulated customer
* Clear writing and speaking, with the ability to explain technical issues and risk to executives and contracting staff

**Desired:**
------------

* Master's degree in a related field
* Experience with electric utility, energy, or other OT/ICS environments
* Experience with DOE security programs, including facility clearance and personnel security processes
* PMP, or other cybersecurity certifications such as CISM, CISA, GIAC GCIH, GSLC, or CEH
* Experience leading a contract transition for a 24x7 operation

**Job Description**
-------------------

Job Summary
-----------

Reporting to the Public Health Chief of Staff, the Manager, Public Health Communications and Engagement makes an impact on health and health equity by influencing the population’s health-related behaviours, motivating stakeholders around Departmental priorities, and leading an engaged and cohesive team of Public Health communicators and engagement professionals. The Manager is a key member of the Public Health Senior Leadership Team, responsible for developing and implementing Public Health & Emergency Services’ external health communication and branding strategies, internal communications and culture-building efforts, and leading community and stakeholder engagement. The role enhances departmental objectives by leading strategic communications counsel and tactical support to internal clients. This role also provides senior advisory support to the Medical Officer of Health/Commissioner, the Chief of Emergency Medical Services/Director of Emergency Services, and the Senior Leadership Team.

Education
---------

* University degree in communications, public relations, journalism, health sciences or related discipline
* Master’s degree in communications, public relations, journalism, health sciences or related discipline required.

Knowledge
---------

* Eight (8) years’ professional experience in issues management, internal communications, public relations, public affairs/relations, social marketing, community consultation and media relations; experience in public health or a health care setting is preferred
* Five (5) years’ experience in leading people in a large, complex organization is preferred
* Demonstrated experience in managing relationships with elected officials at various levels (municipal, provincial and federal).
* Knowledge of project management, social marketing, communications marketing, health communications, issues management and public relations theory, special events planning and speech writing, crisis communications, risk communications and change management
* In-depth knowledge of communications technologies and practices, social media, web and multi-media approaches.
* Knowledge of the principles underpinning health behavior change is preferred
* Professional accreditation in Public Relations or other communications-based professional organization is preferred

Responsibilities
----------------

Provides leadership and management direction to staff responsible for the external communications and engagement activities of the department. This includes but is not limited to media relations, social media, digital engagement, community, primary care and stakeholder engagement, public health branding, and reputation management. (30% of time)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Establishes the vision and strategy for communications and engagement to enable Public Health & Emergency Services to achieve its goal of impact on health and health equity
* Leads the development and implementation of external communication strategies, conducting research, analysis, environmental scans and testing of new communication channels and tools to support and manage Public Health & Emergency Services’ external communications
* Establishes Public Health & Emergency Services’ brand and monitors resonance and reputation in the community
* Leads the development of Public Health & Emergency Services’ digital engagement and media relations strategies, conducting ongoing media relations activities for Public Health & Emergency Services, including preparing media products, organizing media conferences, and identifying and encouraging opportunities for positive media coverage
* Leads the development and implementation of Public Health & Emergency Services’ media relations program, which includes proactive and reactive engagement
* Works closely with municipal, provincial or federal communication counterparts to deliver joint announcements at media events or special events that involve or impact the Niagara Region
* Formulates and implements strategic communications plans to support Public Health & Emergency Services in building effective relationships with its external clients and stakeholders
* Monitors trends, issues and legislation that affect Public Health & Emergency Services or its stakeholders and recommends approaches or responses to address issues identified
* Researches, analyzes, plans, develops and implements communications plans and strategies designed to assist Public Health & Emergency Services in building positive relations with the public
* Advises the Medical Officer of Health, the Public Health Chief of Staff, the Chief of Emergency Medical Services, and the Senior Leadership Team on political and reputational risk management
* Contributes to Public Health & Emergency Services’ government advocacy efforts through liaising with the Strategic Communications and Public Affairs team
* Leads alignment of the department’s community outreach activities and provides department leadership to all health promotion activities
* Leads staff responsible for outreach and collaborations with primary care and the health care sector and physician recruitment

Manages people resource planning for the division or operating unit, determining ideal organizational structures, identifying desirable role and skill mix requirements and ensuring ongoing work quality and deliverability of results. (30% of time)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Enables results with the organization’s human capital strategy to foster employee engagement.
* Directs and provides leadership for the activities and coaching of direct reports, providing work direction, setting priorities, assigning tasks/projects, determining methods and procedures to be used, resolving problems, ensuring results are achieved, and managing staff recruitment, performance, and skill development activities
* Ensures alignment and coordination of activity and quality of output between teams under their direction
* Ensures focus is service excellence, communication/transparency, innovation, and data integrity and work flow integration.
* Ensures staff has the information and resources to make successful plans and decisions.
* Ensures all people related issues, including recruitment, grievances and labour relations issues, are aligned to HR and Corporate standards and practices.
* Helps to break down barriers to employee success, ensuring collaboration and cooperation with other teams within their division and department
* Ensures Occupational Health & Safety policies, programs and practices are implemented, and maintained. This includes workplace inspections, monitoring, accident reporting and investigations, and ensuring any observed hazards or lapses in the functioning of OH&S processes, and other OH&S concerns are responded to promptly.
* Ensures all individuals under supervision have been informed of hazards and instructed on the necessary risk control and emergency response measures;

Leads internal communications in Public Health. Enables Public Health & Emergency Services leadership with building engagement, supporting culture and disseminating information across all levels of Public Health through communication strategies, creative services employee engagement expertise. (20% of time)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Leads the development and implementation of communication plans and strategies to support strategic business and operational activities and ensure consistency in key messages
* Leads the Public Health & Emergency Services employee engagement activities through the development and implementation of the department’s internal communications strategy, identifying engagement opportunities for staff at all levels.
* Ensures the implementation and evaluation of relevant elements of the Public Health & Emergency Services strategic plan
* Participates in Senior Leadership Team meetings, advising the Medical Officer of Health, Associate Medical Officers of Health, the Public Health Chief of Staff, Chief of Emergency Medical Services, and Directors on strategic business decisions, and confidential or sensitive issues
* Ensure all policies and standards related to communications, community outreach, and employee engagement are successfully incorporated, understood, and communicated
* Develops and prepares reports, briefs, and Regional Council committee reports as required
* Identifies and implements ongoing and issue-specific internal communications strategies for Public Health & Emergency Services to ensure that department and corporate strategic goals are being met.
* Anticipates potentially contentious issues that could face the Corporation or department and advises on best methods of proactively and positively addressing them
* Reviews and advises on major initiatives and measures undertaken within Public Health & Emergency Services
* Ensure ongoing communications and effective relationships with the Strategic Communications and Public Affairs team

Leads crisis and outbreak communications for Public Health & Emergency Services, identifying and monitoring potential risks to the Department and Corporation, and developing contingency plans to respond. (15% of time)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Member of Public Health & Emergency Services Emergency Operations Centre (EOC)
* Backup communications member of the Niagara Region Emergency Operations Centre (REOC) unless the emergency is a health crisis or outbreak where Public Health is the lead for communications and information
* Provides leadership to anticipate and address potential controversial, politically-sensitive obstacles and/or conflicts that may impact Niagara’s success and reputation; assessing potential risks; developing strategies to address issues and remove barriers.
* Leads the development of the outbreak communications strategy, which includes risk communications, key message development, media relations, multi-modal digital engagement, internal communications, stakeholder relations and evaluation. Provides direction to Communications and Engagement staff, as well as other Public Health staff in the implementation of the strategy.
* During health-specific crisis or outbreak, provides counsel to the CAO, REOC, and Council
* During health-specific crisis or outbreak, directs local area municipality communication strategy and works in collaboration with communication counterparts.
* During health-specific crisis or outbreak, directs communications strategies for stakeholders including school boards and post-secondary institutions.

---------------------------------

* Develops, manages, and administers annual and multi-year Capital and Operating budgets for the operating unit ensuring support of Council’s objectives, financial transparency and accountability, monitoring budget adherence, identifying and explaining variances, and financial reporting is effectively managed in compliance with corporate financial policies
* Ensure goods and services are acquired in accordance with the procurement policy. Authorize the acquisition of goods and services for the operating unit and direct reports in accordance with the procurement policy and procedures

---------------

Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.  
  
Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.  
  
Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

* Support, mentor, and motivate your hourly workforce

* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

As an Area Manager II at an Amazon fulfillment center, you'll act as a strategic leader overseeing upto 80 associates while driving department level operational improvements. You'll conduct planning sessions with your team, coaching them through operational challenges while developing their leadership capabilities. On a typical day, you'll partner cross-functionally with teams such as Quality, HR, and Safety to implement scalable process improvements that could impact 200+ associates across multiple workflows.
